# KOTOR 1: super-deep character write-ups (Oct 19, 2026)

## Bastila Shan
*Corpus coverage: 724 own lines (every line, no length filter) · 200 lines naming them by name, alias or epithet · 29 pronoun references resolved from context · 241 lines addressed to them · 81 narration lines · 89 duplicate/variant lines merged (noted inline). Every «quote» is script-verified.*
### Background and history
Bastila is a young Jedi with rare Battle Meditation. Vandar: «Even among the Masters and the Council it is rare to find one so skilled in the art of Battle Meditation.» [K1/Jedi_Enclave]. She was on the strike team that captured Revan [K1/Bastila]. Her father was a treasure hunter pushed by her mother: «She pushed my father into treasure hunting.» [K1/Bastila]. The Republic fleet's few key victories are credited to her Battle Meditation (Dorak) [K1/Jedi_Enclave].
### Personality and motivations
She is proud and quick to anger: «I've always struggled for control over my passions.» [K1/Bastila]. She is duty-bound to guide Revan, and she is drawn to Revan through the bond: «Maybe it's the bond we share.» [K1/Bastila]. Malak accuses her of wanting the dark side: «you wanted to taste the dark side for yourself!» [K1/Hangar].
### Arc (scene by scene)
- **Taris:** captured as a swoop-race prize, rescued, then the escape.
- **Dantooine:** the Council reveals the bond. She assists Zhar's training.
- **Star Map worlds:** companion dialogue, including meeting her mother Helena in Anchorhead's cantina (narration) [K1/Bastila].
- **Leviathan:** holds off Malak so the party can escape, and is captured.
- **Star Forge:** turned by Malak; boasts of her new power [K1/Command_Center] and uses Battle Meditation against the Republic.
  - **Light ending:** Revan redeems her through the bond, or she is defeated. Redeemed, she aids the fleet.
  - **Dark ending:** she becomes Revan's apprentice and partner, and her Battle Meditation serves the Sith.
### Relationships
- **Revan:** bond; romance for a male Revan.
- **Carth:** friction.
- **Jolee:** a mentor's skepticism.
- **Malak:** captor and corruptor.
- **Her mother:** estranged.
### Abilities (lore)
- Battle Meditation, a strategic morale and coordination effect on whole fleets: «she can swing the tide of nearly any battle» [K1/Jedi_Enclave].
- Lightsaber combat. Uses Throw Lightsaber (narration, Temple fight).
- The Force bond.
### Feats
- Turns key battles for the Republic (Dorak) [K1/Jedi_Enclave].
- Part of Revan's capture [K1/Bastila].
- Saved Revan's life through the bond.
- Holds off Malak long enough for the escape [K1/Hangar].
- Coordinates the whole Star Forge battle [K1/Command_Center].
### Power-scaling statements
- «I have a greater command of the Force than all but the most powerful Jedi Masters.» (fallen Bastila) [K1/Command_Center]
- Carth: «Bastila is as powerful as they say... she's the one who defeated Darth Revan, after all.» [K1/Carth] (rumor framing)
### Duels and fights
| Fight | Page | Outcome and context |
|---|---|---|
| vs Malak | K1/Hangar | A delaying action; she is captured. |
| vs Revan | K1/Temple_Summit / Star_Forge | She loses or is redeemed. |
### Verdict implications
- **Battle Meditation:** a strategic hax that does not translate to duels.
- **Duelist rating:** mid-tier. Clearly below Revan and Malak; roughly comparable to Uthar or Yuthura.
- **Confidence:** medium.
### Open questions
- Her post-K1 fate (K2 shows her joining Carth if Revan was male) is K2-dependent.

- «But words alone cannot save one from the dark side. Come, we should continue with the task at hand. When the time comes I only hope we are all strong enough to do what we must.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Why? I could not accomplish this on my own, I need the aid of others – especially one who is strong in the Force. The bond between us made you a natural choice. Is that not enough for you?» [K1/Bastila]
- «I said we were brought together for our mission: to stop Malak. I hardly think the Force would be pushing us towards a romantic involvement when the fate of the galaxy is at stake! Please try to stay focused. I doubt the Council would approve if they knew we were busy discussing our mutual attraction when we should be saving the galaxy from Malak.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Mutual attraction? I never said... it's just an expression! Whatever our feelings... uh, I mean... whatever *your* feelings, you have to try to ignore them. Don't let this complicate things.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Finding the missing pieces of the Star Maps is our only hope of locating the Star Forge and defeating Malak. The Council explained all this quite clearly.» [K1/Bastila]
- «I admit, there were times that I wondered if this is more than just a mission to stop Malak. There were times when I wondered if this was also a way for the Council to test my own abilities.» [K1/Bastila]
- «I wondered if the Council wanted to see how I would help and guide you on our quest. I wondered if they were testing me to see if I was ready to become a Jedi Master myself. - «You must learn to trust in the wisdom of the Council. Your destiny will come in its appointed time. You mustn't be so impatient.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Come on, come, let's move on... there's much to be done.» [K1/Bastila] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «*Must* you be so frustrating? I admit, I had a moment of foolish pride. But I'm over it. Now I am focused on my true responsibilities.» [K1/Bastila]
- «I am simply trying to help you and complete this mission, and yet you battle me at every turn!» [K1/Bastila]
- «Fun?! Fun?! Driving me insane is your idea of a good time?» [K1/Bastila]
- «I started it? You were the one who brought up the issue of the Council! You were the one who questioned our mission! You're the one who mocked me for thinking I was being tested!» [K1/Bastila]
- «I must admit: I simply don't know how to deal with someone like you.» [K1/Bastila]
- «You... you are a very odd man, do you know that? I simply don't know how to deal with you. All I want to do is help you, but you seem determined to drive me mad.» [K1/Bastila]
- «I don't know if I should be outraged that you keep joking about serious matters, or I should be grateful that you can always lighten the mood.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Unfortunately it isn't as easy as that. But your point is well taken.» [K1/Bastila]
- «I do. I have been trying to come up with the best way to say this for some time, but I suppose I should just come out and say it. The truth is, I have come to depend on you. Not just for the sake of the mission, but for my own sake as well. I am... I am glad you are with us.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Now you're teasing me. You know very well what I said.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Well, yes. Surely that is not so surprising.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Did I? I am trying to be sincere, here. It occurred to me that I may have been too critical of you. Too demanding, at times.» [K1/Bastila]
- «No, I'm not. Why must you make this so difficult for me? Can't you just accept a simple compliment?» [K1/Bastila]
- «I am trying my best. You are not making this easy for me, you know.» [K1/Bastila]
- «I see. Is there nothing I can do to make it up to you? I would rather we were friends.» [K1/Bastila]
- «I... you know I can't feel that way about you. About any man. It isn't permitted. I am a Jedi, I must resist these temptations. But I still want to consider you a friend. We could... we could never be anything more, though. That... that isn't allowed.» [K1/Bastila]
- «I know my manner can be a bit taciturn. I know you must be getting sick of my lectures about the dark side and... and everything else.» [K1/Bastila]
- «I spent all my years being hounded by my instructors. Being told so often how gifted and important I was until I was sick of it. I remember when I was younger I used to swear that I would never become as self-absorbed and stodgy as the Jedi Masters. It's ironic, really.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Yes, well... there's no need for you to agree so whole-heartedly.» [K1/Bastila]
- «That's kind of you to say, but I know for myself that it's not really true.» [K1/Bastila]
- «I suppose not. But I am becoming like that, though it's not easy for me to admit.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Being controlled has kept everyone around me at an arm's length; even those like yourself who are most in need of my understanding and compassion.» [K1/Bastila]
- «But maybe it's time to change that. You deserve to know how much I respect and admire you. I had to tell you how much I care for you. As a friend, of course.» [K1/Bastila]
- «But maybe it's time to change that. You deserve to know how much I respect and admire you. I thought... I just thought I should tell you.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Please, it's... it's not allowed. I have to remain true to the Jedi ideal. If this is going to cause a problem maybe... maybe I shouldn't have said anything.» [K1/Bastila]
- «What? But I... alright. Have it your way, if that's what you'd prefer. We needn't talk further.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Well, that was not nearly so difficult as I feared. Thank you for hearing me out. I feel... I feel much better. But enough soul searching for now. We should probably continue on with our mission.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Am I so transparent? I suppose I shouldn't be surprised, considering our bond. Yes, there is something I would like to ask, if you'll permit it.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Don't even start with that. You're the one who asked. I wasn't even going to say anything. But now that you've brought it up, I see I shouldn't have waited as long as I have.» [K1/Bastila]
- «In our time together I've been watching you. I've seen your tendency towards giving in to your darker emotions. You do as you please, for the most part. - «I doubt my old Master would approve of your advice. Besides, I'm not like you. I must always be on guard against such outbursts.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Is it? The thought of what could happen to me if I lose control... somehow I think life could be very long, indeed.» [K1/Bastila]
- «That... that's a relief to hear. That you would even be willing to risk so much is... is very brave. Braver than I could be.» [K1/Bastila]
- «In our time together I've been watching you. You are a true servant of the light, you follow the tenets of the Jedi Order despite the lure of the dark side. And with so little training. For me it has always been a constant battle. Don't you find it difficult at all? You make it seem so easy. Or is that only an illusion?» [K1/Bastila]
- «And that's enough for you? If only it were as easy for me. If only the right path was always clear.» [K1/Bastila]
- «That's a relief to hear. I have never found the Jedi path an easy one to walk, and it's good to know I'm not alone.» [K1/Bastila]
- «You don't? Sometimes I find that it is nearly all I can think of. I have never found the Jedi training easy to master.» [K1/Bastila]
- «I've always struggled for control over my passions. I've always been too quick to anger, too quick to get involved. My instructors constantly berated me for it. - «I don't know. Would the power I used to kill Darth Malak be too tempting to keep using? Would I become the kind of evil I want to destroy?» [K1/Bastila]
- «But what comes next? After using all that power, would you decide to impose your own view on the universe? The dark side corrupts your very thoughts.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Yes, of course. You're right. I... I have to remember my training. The Masters know well the corrupting influence of the dark side, although it is hard for me to imagine.» [K1/Bastila]
- «I suppose I do. Part of me thinks that it would be worth anything to vanquish evil, even if it meant giving in to my base emotions.» [K1/Bastila]
- «The very thought that I could become as evil as Malak; I just can't fathom it. It just doesn't seem possible. How could I... no, wait. I'm sorry. I shouldn't even be asking you this. The Jedi teachings are clear; who am I to question them? And even worse, who am I to try and make you question them?» [K1/Bastila]
- «These are dangerous thoughts, the indulgence of a vain mind. Please, forget I ever mentioned this. Let's just return to our mission.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Yes, I did end that quite abruptly, didn't I? Perhaps a Master could have addressed my questions with the proper wisdom. But I never should have brought it up here. Not with you. - «Perhaps you are not being truly objective, then. There is no need to spare my feelings on this point.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Please don't make light of this. The very fact that I am plagued by this doubt is yet further evidence of my inadequacy.» [K1/Bastila]
- «The fact of the matter is that I have never possessed much skill at controlling myself. With the bond that joins us, it seems I have even less.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Whether you will continue on your current path and fall to the dark side, I don't know. But it is increasingly obvious I am unable to guide you properly.» [K1/Bastila]
- «You have maintained the path of the light side. But it has been in spite of my influence, not because of it. It is increasingly obvious I am unable to guide you properly.» [K1/Bastila]
- «I don't know. I think... I think I may have made a very big mistake.» [K1/Bastila]
- «That is kind of you to say, but I think the evidence speaks for itself. I think... I think I may have made a very big mistake.» [K1/Bastila]
- «I simply hope that you are not the one who pays the price, ultimately, for the fact that I can't help you enough.» [K1/Bastila]
- «No, I suppose you don't. At this point I imagine I'm doing you more harm than good.» [K1/Bastila]

- «That's a kinder response than I deserve. And I can see there is wisdom in your words.» [K1/Bastila]
- «You... you continue to be there for me, don't you? Even after I keep pushing you away, you're still around when I need you most. You're like no man I've known before. And you're nothing like what I expected you to be after... after the Council sent us on this mission together.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Perhaps you can help me. And I will try to help you, if I can. Hopefully this will all work out, for the both of us. And for the sake of the mission.» [K1/Bastila]
- «I... I need time to think about all this. Things are... they are not going as I thought they would.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Well, just... different, I suppose. Things are not going as I thought they would. I... I need time to think about all this.» [K1/Bastila]
- «We should... we should continue on with our mission, for now.» [K1/Bastila]
- «You have been patient with me, haven't you? I suppose you deserve an answer. But you have to understand how difficult this is for me to say.» [K1/Bastila]
- «With all my training, I should be able to control myself better than this. But you're not anything like I expected. You're not like any man I've ever met before. - «I don't know. It shouldn't be so hard to not think of you. It should be easy to not think of you. I should have discipline! Jedi discipline!» [K1/Bastila]
- «Every time I try to call on all my teachings to calm myself, they fail me. You have such power, such passion! I don't know if it's due to the bond between us, but I'm drawn to you.» [K1/Bastila]
- «The Force is a part of you, as is your power. But that's not what attracted me to you. It's more than that. Maybe it's the bond we share. It gives us a certain... intimacy. - «Oh, I thought... No, this is good. I'm glad you told me. This makes everything much easier. Don't worry - I can put this behind me. Let's just continue on with what we must do. It is better this way.» [K1/Bastila] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «And go where? I am needed here, just as you are. There is nothing that is more important than what we are doing. Which is why we need to resolve this.» [K1/Bastila]
- «What I have been trying to tell you is that I've reached a decision. But this is not the proper place for this discussion. I think... I think we should have some privacy for this. We can talk about this the next time we return to the Ebon Hawk.» [K1/Bastila]
- «[[../Bastila#Kiss» [K1/Bastila] *(+3 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Yes, I promised you an answer when we reached the Ebon Hawk, didn't I? But I'm afraid you won't like it. We should have some privacy for this.» [K1/Bastila]
- «I can't deny that there are parts of you I am drawn to. Your power, your will. You are so much stronger than I am.» [K1/Bastila]
- «You're stronger than I am, and there's no point in telling me otherwise. You will be a great Jedi, I think. I hope.» [K1/Bastila]
- «In some ways you make me feel weak, like I am caught up in the wake of our destiny. But at the same time, you make me feel stronger, more alive.» [K1/Bastila]

- «I hope you can put this behind you. You need to focus on stopping Malak, as difficult as that may be. Come, we should continue our mission.» [K1/Bastila]
- «Please, don't say it like that. You make it sound like I was using you! Don't you realize how difficult this was for me?» [K1/Bastila]
- «Why do you think I came to this decision? I know how hard this is for both of us! You just kept pressing forward, so I had to be the one to step up and do the right thing!» [K1/Bastila]
- «You're the one who can't face the truth! Malak has to be stopped. How can I do that if I let myself be blinded by my feelings for you?» [K1/Bastila]

- «Oh, my!» [K1/Bastila]
- «Okay, you've made your point. Now shut up and kiss me, you fool!» [K1/Bastila]

- «We've... we've already been over this. It was a moment of weakness, a stumble brought on by unbridled passions. But my emotions are firmly in check once more. So, until our mission is over we need to act with discretion. We shouldn't speak of this anymore... not until Malak is defeated!» [K1/Bastila]

- «Thank you or informing me. I really must be going, now.» [K1/Bastila]

- «There were extenuating circumstances. And I can assure you it took far more than a handful of Vulkars to subdue me.» [K1/Bastila] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Bold talk from a broken-down mercenary who was serving at Davik's heel. I'd call you his pet kath hound, but they have enough loyalty not to turn on their masters.» [K1/Bastila] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «I was not spoiled! I was given the same training as everyone else in the Order! You are nothing but a... no. I must not do this. There is no emotion; there is peace.» [K1/Bastila] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Enough, Mandalorian. I won't rise to your bait any more. The game is over. Let us continue on with what we were doing.» [K1/Bastila] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «No, I was conscious. But my Force powers were exhausted from using my Battle Meditation in the battle for the ''Endar Spire''. Without my help you might never have gotten off the ship alive.» [K1/Bastila] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «My lightsaber was... misplaced. I couldn't find it after the crash. I looked *everywhere* in that pod. The Vulkars came and overwhelmed me even as I was searching for my weapon.» [K1/Bastila] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «This is no laughing matter! During the crash my lightsaber must have... it must have fallen from my belt and rolled under my seat! The Vulkars probably found it there when they searched the wreckage.» [K1/Bastila] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «I hardly consider myself a legend, Carth. Though I will consider your advice when I relate these events to the Jedi Council. There is no need for them to know *every* detail of what transpired.» [K1/Bastila] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «That was nearly five years ago. I was still an apprentice, my Battle Meditiation hadn't even manifested itself. Yet even then I had the wisdom to obey the will of the Council. Unlike Revan.» [K1/Bastila]

- «There was something lurking out there, something that devoured Revan and Malak – and many other Jedi. Had the Council sent us all into the unknown, how many more would have fallen?» [K1/Bastila] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «We did not abandon you! But the Council were not about to throw lives away foolishly. In time, we would have aided you against the Mandalorians. But you couldn't wait. - «Jolee, may I have a moment? There is something I wish to speak to you about.» [K1/Bastila] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «I know you have... issues... with the Order. But you are a Jedi, Jolee. You command the Force. Without the guidance of the Council how can you avoid falling to the dark side?» [K1/Bastila] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «I see you are quite adamant. No doubt you've had ample time to think on this during your long seclusion. I guess it was foolish of me to think I could sway your position so easily.» [K1/Bastila] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «I would never use the Force for such petty and trivial revenge! The mere thought of it is preposterous!» [K1/Bastila] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «I am not stuck up. I merely have the years of training to give me the wisdom and understanding to see how childish such an act would be.» [K1/Bastila] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*

- «How can you be sure of that? Father is an experienced --» [K1/Cantina]

- «It doesn't seem to have anything to do with what she's asking. Are you actually sick, Mother?» [K1/Cantina]

- «You're probably right. There are more important things to do. Mother can wait.» [K1/Cantina]
- «We have more important things to do. Still... my father is dead. Just because we find the holocron doesn't mean I have to give it to her.» [K1/Cantina]
- «Father recorded all his personal thoughts in that holocron even when I knew him. Having it would be like having him with you. I don't see why she deserves it, however. She drove him to his death. I loved him... and I didn't even have a chance to say goodbye.» [K1/Cantina]
- «I don't know. Part of me would keep it just so she didn't get it. I don't like that part of me.» [K1/Cantina]
- «It does, doesn't it? I can't seem to help myself.» [K1/Cantina]
- «Yes... maybe. I don't feel good about it, still.» [K1/Cantina]
- «I would have thought my Jedi training would have put me past this kind of pettiness. I wish... I really don't want to think about this.» [K1/Cantina]
- «Please, let's just keep going.» [K1/Cantina]
- «I have my doubts as to whether she's actually sick.» [K1/Cantina]
- «Mother used to lie about many things to get her way. She is a selfish woman who pushed my father into doing what she wished.» [K1/Cantina]
- «I told you that my mother and I never got along. Obviously that has not changed. And now Father is dead. That... leaves a hurt inside, you just can't imagine. I haven't seen him in so long...» [K1/Cantina]
- «Yes, I... thought I had let go of that anger. All my training, and it comes back so quickly...» [K1/Cantina]
- «I don't want to talk about this any more. Let's... keep going.» [K1/Cantina]
- «I have the holocron, Mother. I'm just not sure I want to give it to you.» [K1/Cantina]
- «I've never denied you anything, Mother. You may think I don't remember what it was like before I left for the order, but I do. You were the one who pushed Father to go on one treasure hunt after the other. You loved living in wealth. You think I don't remember the fights? You were eager to send me to the Jedi, even though I didn't want to go. You took Father away from me, and now this holocron is all I have of him.» [K1/Cantina]
- «No. I don't wish to argue with you any more, Mother. It's time we parted ways, now, for both our benefit.» [K1/Cantina]
- «On the contrary, I've learned much. I've learned, for instance, when it is best to walk away from a situation that can lead only to conflict.» [K1/Cantina]
- «Farewell, Mother. May the Force be with you.» [K1/Cantina]
- «You don't know her. My mother is notoriously deceptive when she wants something. Why should she have the holocron?» [K1/Cantina]
- «I... perhaps not. I can remember my father well enough. But I ask you: why should she have it?» [K1/Cantina]
- «I find it difficult to believe anything you say, Mother.» [K1/Cantina]
- «*Sigh* You're right. It shames me, but I just... I find it difficult to... let go of the past. I'm... sorry, Mother.» [K1/Cantina]
- «So that's why you gave me to the Order?» [K1/Cantina]
- «Your treatments.» [K1/Cantina]
- «I'm so sorry, Mother. I don't know what to say...» [K1/Cantina]
- «I know, Mother. Thank you. I'm glad we talked, too.» [K1/Cantina]
- «Where are you going to go?» [K1/Cantina]
- «Here. Take these 500 credits. It's all I have. Go to Coruscant and find a doctor. I'll meet you there after... after what I have to do.» [K1/Cantina]
- «Please, take it. I... want to see you again. When we can talk.» [K1/Cantina]
- «I'll try. Farewell, Mother.» [K1/Cantina]
- «Yes, but I don't feel any better. After all my training, I would have thought myself above such anger. For it to come so easily disturbs me greatly. I don't need a holocron to remember my father, and I will never see Mother again. Have I learned nothing? It... no, I don't want to talk about this. Thank you, but I must think about what I have done.» [K1/Cantina]
- «Yes. That brought me a lot of peace. More than I thought it would have. Thank you for urging me towards it. After all my training, I would have thought it would have been easier. Apparently I still have much to learn.» [K1/Cantina]
- «It's not that hard to understand if you listen. It's just... odd.» [K1/Cantina]
- «Your sarcasm is not appreciated, Carth.» [K1/Cantina]
- «No doubt with good reason.» [K1/Cantina]

**[K1/Carth]**
- «*That* is none of your concern, Carth, and you would do well to leave the matter be.» [K1/Carth]
- «That was nearly five years ago. I was still an apprentice, my Battle Meditation hadn't even manifested itself. Yet even then I had the wisdom to obey the will of the Council. Unlike Revan.» [K1/Carth]

**[K1/Command_Center]**
- «Master, why have you summoned me? Without my Battle Meditation there is a chance the Republic capital ships could break through and attack the Star Forge itself!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «Revan? But...» [K1/Command_Center]
- «Y-yes, Lord Malak.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «Of course, Master. I will not fail you again.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «The only fools are those who still follow Malak. Open your eyes and see the true Lord of the Sith: Revan has returned!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «The Star Forge is under assault from the entire Republic fleet! If I don't use my Battle Meditation to turn the tide, Admiral Dodonna's capital ships will destroy the Star Forge. I have to stay here in the command center so that I can best use my Battle Meditation against our enemy. If I don't the Star Forge will be lost! You must go to face Malak without me. Find him, kill him and reclaim the title of Dark Lord of the Sith!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «Revan - I knew you'd come for me.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «Sadly, I know this is true. Had you reclaimed the power of your previous identity I would be your apprentice, not Malak's. But you rejected the dark side.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «You are wasting your time. I have seen the Jedi for what they are: weak and afraid. The Sith are the true Masters of the Force. You have forgotten that lesson, Revan.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «I have no doubt of that. I was no match for you in the Temple, but when I fled I knew you would follow me here.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «Now you must pay the price. Here on the Star Forge the power of the dark side is at its strongest. This time you will not defeat me!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «I see now why Malak followed you. Even though you are only a shell of your former self, you are still a formidable opponent. I can't even imagine the power you must have wielded when you were the Dark Lord. You were a fool to give it all up and follow the light side.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «Then it's time for you to prove it!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «The dark side has made me stronger than I ever was before! I have a greater command of the Force than all but the most powerful Jedi Masters. As Malak teaches me the greatest secrets of the Sith, I will unlock more of my potential. Eventually there will be no limit to what I can accomplish with the Force!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «Have you forgotten the ways of the Sith already, Revan? Eventually I will challenge my Master. If I am worthy he will die by my hand and I will become the new Sith Master.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «Jedi propaganda. The dark side is only a tool, and Malak will train me in its use. Eventually I will surpass my Master and challenge him. If I am worthy he will die by my hand.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «Then I will take on my own apprentice and the cycle will begin again. This is the way of the Sith, it is how we assure our leaders are always the strongest and most worthy!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «No, Revan, it is you who are doomed!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «No, Revan. You are the one who will die here!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «You are growing weary, I can sense it! Your strength falters, the light side is failing you while the power of the Star Forge re-energizes me! Soon this will all be over!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «The dark side will always triumph over the light! Malak has assured me of victory! You can't defeat me here on the Star Forge! YOU CAN'T!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «You dare spew those Jedi lies in my face? You will die screaming, Revan!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «What type of trick is this?» [K1/Command_Center]
- «I am a Sith apprentice now. You place too much faith in what I used to be... and for that you shall pay!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «No, this is not possible! You have rejected the dark side, you are a weak and pathetic servant of the light! How can you still stand against me? Why can't I defeat you?» [K1/Command_Center]
- «Yes, I see you speak the truth. I am no match for you. Please, for the sake of what we once shared, do not make me suffer. End my life quickly. There is no other way.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «Do it. Quickly...» [K1/Command_Center]
- «What other choice do you have? I have fallen to the dark side, I am the apprentice to the Dark Lord himself. You cannot let me live.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «No... I'm not strong enough. There is too much anger inside me now. Too much hatred and fear. I can no longer find peace in the Force.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «[Success] You... always had more strength than I did. I told you that. I felt so... helpless before your destiny. You were Revan and I couldn't tell you... it was agonizing! Even worse when I began to... feel closer to you. I despised myself for it. And even now I... feel your strength. It... does help me. Thank you, I think I can face the end, now. If you are the one to end it for me.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «[Success] I doubt mere words can help me now, but to appease you I will recite them: There is no emotion: there is peace. There is no ignorance: there is knowledge. There is no passion: there is serenity. There is no chaos: there is harmony... Strange, but even now I find comfort in these words. I... suppose old habits die hard. There is no death: there is the Force. Thank you, Revan. I am ready to face my fate now.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «You were a special case. The Council had no other choice. They needed you alive so they could discover the location of the Star Forge. It was an act of desperation. It was my responsibility to watch over you, to make sure you did not slip back into your evil ways. I was supposed to protect you from the dark side.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «But at what cost? In protecting you, I fell to the dark side myself. Is that the price of a Jedi's redemption? Must another of the Order fall to save me? I cannot allow that to happen. Please, this is too painful. Strike me down. End this now, quickly. There is no other way.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «I... I suppose you are right. Yet the path I have chosen is that of the dark side. I don't see any way I could atone for what I have done. I deserve to die.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «It's true I possess... feelings for you. But was it only an illusion brought about by our bond? And what was the cost? Please... this is too painful. End it now, quickly. There is no other way.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «[Success] I... I know a flicker of the light still burns within me. Malak felt it too. He knew it could only be extinguished if I killed you. But what good is a single flicker of light against the sea of darkness I am drowning in? I can never atone for my betrayal.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «[Success] You... love me? Heh. I... there was a time I yearned for and yet dreaded to hear those words. I loved you, too, but I could never... face who you were. Malak knew how I felt. Any part of the light that was within me would be extinguished when I killed you. But what good is love? It cannot save me from the sea of blackness I am drowning in. I have betrayed everything I ever believed in! How can I atone for that?» [K1/Command_Center]
- «[Failure!] No! That bond is what took me down this path to begin with! It poisoned me... I hated myself for loving you and now I have betrayed everything!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «[Failure] The Jedi code is nothing but words, the babblings of senile old Masters! The code cannot help me now!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «[Failure] There is nothing in my heart but the blackness of the dark side! I am sick of your preaching, Revan!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «I ask you for an honorable death, but you are too weak to even grant me that! No more words! This must end with blood!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «Yes, I... could join you in your battle against the Dark Lord. That alone would not make up for all I have done, yet... it would be a step in the right direction. But how would you be able to trust me? How do you know I wouldn't turn on you when you faced Darth Malak? How do you know the dark side wouldn't make me betray you again?» [K1/Command_Center]
- «You play a dangerous game. Are you certain you wish to take this risk? I could end your life and gain Malak's favor with a single stroke of my lightsaber.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «You are brave... and foolish. The dark side has wholly consumed me, and you will suffer for failing to see that!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «A wise decision. You cannot trust me, and you cannot bring yourself to execute me. I see now there is only one way this can end. The time for words is done! Defend yourself!» [K1/Command_Center]
- «You are brave... and some would say foolish. But you are also right. The dark side has not wholly consumed me. I cannot raise my blade against you.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «I... I must know something, first, before that happens. I must ask you something. Will there be a place for me in your future? Do you... do you love me?» [K1/Command_Center]
- «I see. Thank you for your honesty. It's probably for the best that it goes no further. You saved me and I will always be grateful.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «And... and you said you loved me. This may not be the best time to say it, but...» [K1/Command_Center]
- «I love you, too. With all my heart.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «After this? No, nothing could make me feel safer than to be loved by you.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «You should go. Malak awaits. This isn't over, yet... for any of us.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «I should stay here, though. If we face Malak I am afraid his dark presence will overwhelm me. It would not be wise to expose myself to such temptation.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «I'm sorry, but the risk is too great. I am not wholly free of the dark side's shadow. Not yet. But you are more than a match for the Dark Lord. I understand that now.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «Yes, that would be for the best. You don't need me to defeat Malak, anyway. Now I understand that a true Jedi is a match for any Sith. Even the Dark Lord himself.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «I will stay here in this chamber and use my Battle Meditation to aid the Republic fleet. I am their only hope of destroying the Star Forge and ending the Sith menace. You must go and face Malak, but you have to hurry. Once I turn the battle in the Republic's favor we won't have much time to escape the Star Forge before it is destroyed.» [K1/Command_Center]
- «Good luck... and may the Force be with you.» [K1/Command_Center]

**[K1/Courtyard]**
- «That was beneath you. I hope in the future you will strive to be better than this.» [K1/Courtyard] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «There is no need for you to make fun of her. She is obviously desperate.» [K1/Courtyard]
- «Carth! Enough!» [K1/Courtyard]
- «I think we understand. Love can do strange things to anyone.» [K1/Courtyard]
- «Well, if his ego is similarly halved he should be just about right.» [K1/Courtyard]

**[K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]**
- «*whisper* The Force should not be used for profit and personal gain. As Jedi we should be above such things.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Perhaps you should reconsider leaving Zaalbar behind. This is, after all, his homeworld.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «We know very little of this planet. I also sense that Zaalbar has much that is unresolved here... it may be beneficial to aid him in this respect.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «Is this about power, then? You would rather make a decision for the sake of making it than make it wisely? I am only suggesting that both we and Zaalbar would benefit from his company while on Kashyyyk. You do want to find the Star Map, don't you?» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «An honest man and a good mechanic. Seems like you got a favorable trade, sir.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «Feeding this man's hatred is an act of malice and petty evil. The Council would not approve of your actions here, and neither do I.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «[Force Persuade] You wish to tell us more about this agreement with the Wookiee leadership.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «It's not our place to judge, Carth. As he said, it would change nothing anyway.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «Of course not. I would gladly end it, had I the power. However, we are here for other reasons, if you will recall.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «Shipped as slaves to work as soldiers and heavy laborers in Czerka camps, no doubt.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]

**[K1/Czerka_Office]**
- «*whisper* Czerka may be a corrupt organization, but that doesn't justify us using the Force for personal gain.» [K1/Czerka_Office]

**[K1/Dantooine]**
- «Dantooine... it seems like a lifetime since I last set foot on her surface, though in truth it has only been a few months. We should be safe from Malak here... for now, at least.» [K1/Dantooine]
- «Even the Sith would think twice before attacking Dantooine. There are many Jedi here, including several of the most powerful Masters of the Order. There is great strength within this place.» [K1/Dantooine]
- «We can't just keep running; Malak will find us eventually. We need to regroup; we need a plan.» [K1/Dantooine]
- «We can get supplies here and recuperate. The Academy is a place of mental and spiritual healing; something we could all use after what we've been through.» [K1/Dantooine]
- «She will find a way to come to terms with her grief. She is stronger than she appears. We just need to give her time.» [K1/Dantooine]
- «Now I must go speak with the Council. I need their advice on... recent developments. After I have met with them I will meet you outside the ship.» [K1/Dantooine]
- «I have spoken briefly with the council; they request an audience with you. We should go at once.» [K1/Dantooine]
- «I'm sorry, Carth, but I cannot tell you. All I ask is that you trust in the Force and the wisdom of the Council.» [K1/Dantooine]
- «Come, they are expecting us. I will lead you to the Council chambers.» [K1/Dantooine]
- «Dantooine is a peaceful and pastoral planet. There are few large communities. Mostly what you will find here are ranchers and farmers. I find it a tranquil place like few in the galaxy. The perfect site for the Jedi enclave. You will like it here.» [K1/Dantooine]

**[K1/Grove]**

**[K1/Hangar]**
- «Darth Malak!» [K1/Hangar]
- «[[../Bastila#First» [K1/Hangar]
- «Tatooine» [K1/Hangar]
- «Kashyyyk» [K1/Hangar]
- «Manaan» [K1/Hangar]
- «Korriban» [K1/Hangar]
- «Revan visited each of these worlds searching for clues to reveal the hidden location of the Star Forge.» [K1/Hangar]
- «[[../Bastila#Second» [K1/Hangar]
- «It's true. I was part of the team sent to capture Revan... to capture you. When Malak fired on the ship you were badly injured. We thought you were dead. Your mind was destroyed, but I used the Force to preserve the flicker of life in your body. I brought you to the Jedi Council. They were the ones who healed your damaged mind.» [K1/Hangar]
- «I wanted to tell you, but the Council forbid it! They were afraid you might return to the dark side if you discovered your real identity!» [K1/Hangar]
- «The Jedi hold all life sacred, even that of a Sith Lord. I could not just let you die, Revan. Not if it was possible to save you.» [K1/Hangar]
- «We couldn't simply restore your true identity; Revan was too dangerous. But locked inside your mind was information the Republic needed: the secrets of the Star Forge. The Council created an identity for you: a soldier under my command. Your subconscious memories were supposed to lead me to the Star Forge; there was no other way to get the information.» [K1/Hangar]
- «When I used my Force powers to keep you alive on that bridge it created our bond. I convinced the Council that I could use that bond to draw out your memories and lead us to the Star Forge.» [K1/Hangar]
- «I used my Force powers to heal you on that bridge; we share a bond. I convinced the Council I could use our bond to draw out your memories and lead us to the Star Forge.» [K1/Hangar]
- «NO! I wanted to help you, Revan. I thought this mission would redeem you; that it would atone for your past crimes. How else could you be saved?» [K1/Hangar]
- «That was a risk the Council chose to take. I had to try and draw out the secrets of the Star Forge. It was our only hope of stopping the Sith! There was no other choice.» [K1/Hangar]
- «You had to be healed so I could try and draw out the secrets of the Star Forge - it was our only hope of stopping the Sith! It was a risk the Council chose to take.» [K1/Hangar]
- «How can you say that? Malak nearly killed you, but the Jedi Council gave you another chance to live! They gave you a chance to redeem yourself by defeating the Sith!» [K1/Hangar]
- «This isn't over, Malak!» [K1/Hangar]
- «For the Jedi!» [K1/Hangar]
- «I'll hold Malak off. You two get out of here! Find the Star Forge!» [K1/Hangar]

**[K1/Hunting_Lodge]**
- «These... things... are just looking for trouble. Be careful.» [K1/Hunting_Lodge]
- «He seems pretty forward, period.» [K1/Hunting_Lodge]

**[K1/Javyar's_Cantina]**

- «I'll "get in a twist" if I think it is called for, Carth. I simply suggest we should use caution if we intend to participate in this... business.» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]
- «It sounds to me like the woman was defending herself.» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]
- «[Force Persuade] I think it is time you forgave her. You are partly to blame for her behaviour.» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]

**[K1/Jedi_Enclave]**

- «Proof? Surely the entire Council can feel the strength of the Force within this man... and I have already related to you the events that took place on Taris...» [K1/Jedi_Enclave]
- «As you wish, Master Vandar. We shall return to the Ebon Hawk and leave you to your deliberations.» [K1/Jedi_Enclave]
- «If you have questions, you should direct them towards the Jedi Council members.» [K1/Jedi_Enclave]

**[K1/Kashyyyk]**
- «The Force has given us a... a vision. Like the one we shared on Dantooine. Did you see it? Of course... you must have. The Force is strong with us both.» [K1/Kashyyyk] *(+3 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Another vision. The Force is guiding us, helping us retrace the steps of Malak and his old Master. Leading us ever closer to the Star Forge.» [K1/Kashyyyk] *(+3 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «You felt it, yes? Another vision? The Force continues to work through us; showing us the Star Maps unearthed by Revan and Malak.» [K1/Kashyyyk] *(+3 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Kashyyyk is a lush but simple and undeveloped world. I would not have expected to find the alien technology of a Star Map here.» [K1/Kashyyyk]
- «The visions are as much yours as mine – and they are the key to finding the Star Forge and stopping Malak!» [K1/Kashyyyk] *(+3 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «The Wookiees of Kashyyyk make their home high among the wroshyr branches; only their bravest warriors dare to descend into the forbidding depths of the forest. If the Star Map is located far beneath us on the planet's surface, as our vision seems to suggest, it is unlikely the Wookiees even know of its existence. No doubt things will become more clear once we discover the Star Map's location.» [K1/Kashyyyk]
- «Kashyyyk is a planet where most of what you see is actually foliage that has grown to enormous heights. No one has ever been to the true surface of the planet below. Beyond that, there is little else I can tell you.» [K1/Kashyyyk]

**[K1/Korriban]**
- «There are some who believe Korriban is the birth place of the Sith... this planet is an evil place. There are secrets here best left uncovered.» [K1/Korriban]
- «You are right, of course. We cannot turn away from the path we have started on... no matter where it may lead.» [K1/Korriban]
- «During the vision I felt cold and trapped; almost as if I was buried alive. It felt... it felt like we were in some kind of tomb. No doubt things will become more clear once we discover the Star Map's location.» [K1/Korriban]
- «Hmmm... maybe you're right. Most of the dark Jedi would only know me by name, but there are a few among them who might recognize my face. For the safety of our mission I must remain on the Ebon Hawk while we are on this planet.» [K1/Korriban]
- «Korriban is a sparsely populated planet controlled by the Sith. It feels... wrong. There is an old evil here that permeates the Force. We can't risk having any of the dark Jedi Masters recognize me. For the sake of the mission I must remain hidden in the Ebon Hawk while we are on this world. Beyond that, there is little else I can tell you.» [K1/Korriban]

**[K1/Leviathan]**
- «What happened? What's going on?» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Do you recognize the ship?» [K1/Leviathan]
- «That is not the way of the Jedi. Vengeance, anger, emotion: these things lead to the dark side!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Talk of an escape is somewhat premature, don't you think? We don't even have a plan to get out of this mess yet!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Maybe Admiral Karath doesn't know how many of us there are on board. We all have special talents; talents we could exploit so that one of us could stage a rescue. We just have to figure out who has the best chance to avoid capture so that they can come and rescue us later. It's a long shot, but it's our only hope.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «The admiral will be watching the three of us far too closely for any plot involving you, me or Carth to succeed. It's going to be up to one of the others to get us out of this.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Is that wise? We need someone inconspicuous for this task, and Wookiees tend to draw a lot of attention... especially from arresting troops. Maybe you should go with someone else.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «We will never serve Malak or the dark side! The Sith will be destroyed, Admiral Karath... as will you if you don't turn away from this path.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Don't waste your breath, Saul! We won't answer any of your questions.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «What are you saying? Physical pain is nothing compared to the suffering of the galaxy if Malak should defeat the Jedi!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «My pain is meaningless. Tell him nothing!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «AHHHH!!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «No! Don't say anymore!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «NO! AHHH!! NO!! AUGH! The pain - THE PAIN! AHHHH!!! AUGH!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Why? Why are you telling him this?» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Words that betray the Jedi Order bring me more pain than any torture ever could!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «For the sake of the Republic don't tell him anything!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «No! How could you betray the Jedi like this?» [K1/Leviathan]
- «No! AHHH!!! AUGH! NO!!! I beg you... No! Mercy!!! NO!!! AUGH!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Don't try to move too quickly, you might not be fully recovered yet. Admiral Karath had his guards continue to torture you even after you passed out.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «The dark side has perverted him, Carth. Once you start down the tainted path it leads you ever further into the depths of evil. I fear he is forever lost.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Yes, hmm, I suppose you are correct. Sometimes it is easy to lose sight of that hope in the face of such unbridled cruelty, but you speak the truth.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «This is not a matter to joke about! If there is one thing we can learn from Saul it is how the power of the dark side can corrupt even the bravest of heroes! I'm sorry. Forgive me. Snapping at you like that won't help our situation.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «I suppose I'm taking the news of Dantooine's destruction quite hard. First Taris, now the Academy... is there no end to the killing?» [K1/Leviathan]
- «I'd like to believe that Saul was lying to us, but even as he said the words I knew they were true. The Academy is gone.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «We should have felt a disturbance in the Force when the attack came. The fact that we did not is a bad sign. I fear the dark side is growing stronger, casting shadows our vision cannot pierce. I can only hope that some of the Jedi escaped. Vrook, Vandar, Zhar... I cannot imagine all of them being gone. In any case, we have lost our one place of refuge in the galaxy.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «It is fortunate you were able to resist the Admiral's questioning. The fate of the galaxy could be changed by revealing the slightest piece of vital information.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «I have to confess something. There was a moment - just a moment - when part of me was hoping you would tell him what he wanted to know. Just to make the horrible pain stop.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «I know you wouldn't ever do anything to intentionally cause me pain. But you did the right thing. I don't honestly know if I could have been as strong in your position. To watch you suffer like that... it might have been too much for me to bear.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «You wanted me to suffer? You enjoyed my torment? I don't know what to say. I thought there was a bond between us. Maybe... maybe you're not the man I thought you were.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «I only wish you had been able to resist the Admiral's questioning. I hope the information you revealed does not bring the entire galaxy under the dominion of the Sith.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «I appreciate your... feelings... for me. But you can't let your feelings override your judgment. Remember the Jedi code: There is no emotion, there is peace.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «I appreciate your... feelings... for Carth. But you can't let your feelings override your judgment. Remember the Jedi code: There is no emotion, there is peace.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Your efforts were well intentioned but poorly thought out; Saul tortured us all anyway. There is too much at stake to let reckless passion rule our actions.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «I know if I had been in that position I would not have betrayed the Order and the Republic!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Your attitude disturbs me. Such selfishness is a sign of the dark side's taint, and it does little to fill me with confidence in you.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Did you feel that? A disturbance in the Force. The Admiral has sent his message, the Dark Lord knows we are here now. Malak is coming.» [K1/Leviathan]

**[K1/Lower_City_Apartments_(East)]**
- «No, wait! I want to hear what this man means by 'clear conscience'.» [K1/Lower_City_Apartments_(East)]

**[K1/Lower_Shadowlands]**
- «Wait - I don't trust Chuundar. Maybe we should try talking to this Wookiee.» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands]

**[K1/Manaan]**
- «It is strange that anyone would have built a Star Map here; the entire surface of Manaan is covered by nothing but vast oceans.» [K1/Manaan]
- «It is possible. The melting of polar caps or a cataclysmic earthquake could have buried the land beneath the waves eons ago. Records from that time are incomplete.» [K1/Manaan]
- «The ocean floor is vast and much of it is uncharted, even by the native Selkath. But how could Revan and Malak have found their way down? No doubt things will become more clear once we discover the Star Map's location.» [K1/Manaan]
- «Manaan is a water world inhabited by an aquatic race known as the Selkath. Their only surface city and spaceport is called Ahto. It is unique in that the Selkath are firm in their neutrality. They are neither part of the Republic nor controlled by the Sith, and they wish to keep it that way.» [K1/Manaan]

**[K1/Prison_Block]**
- «Well done, Jolee. I knew we could count on you. A Jedi never fails to get the task done!» [K1/Prison_Block]
- «Well done, Juhani. In freeing us from the cell you have proven yourself truly worthy of the title of Jedi.» [K1/Prison_Block]
- «We better get moving. I can feel the darkness of Malak's presence approaching, and I don't want to be here when he arrives. None of us is a match for the Sith Lord.» [K1/Prison_Block]
- «Then you are a fool! The power of the Dark Lord is strong enough to destroy any of us... even you. It would be suicide to face Malak here! We need to get away before he arrives.» [K1/Prison_Block]
- «Surprise and secrecy will serve us best. A small group might have a better chance of sneaking onto the bridge undetected while the others make their way down to the Ebon Hawk.» [K1/Prison_Block]
- «That's a good idea. The others can get to the Ebon Hawk on their own, but Carth and I might need your help.» [K1/Prison_Block]
- «That's true, Carth. You can come, but don't let your hatred of Saul Karath jeopardize our true mission: getting the Ebon Hawk safely off the Leviathan.» [K1/Prison_Block]
- «You better come with me and Carth. The others can find their way on their own, but we might run into trouble. We'll need you and your powerful Force abilities to deal with it.» [K1/Prison_Block]
- «The three of us will get our equipment and make our way to the bridge. The rest of you head down to the docking hangar where they've got the Ebon Hawk. You'll have to find a way to deal with guards.» [K1/Prison_Block]
- «We'll meet you there as soon as we get those docking bay doors open. Just make sure the Hawk is ready to fly when we get there. And may the Force be with you.» [K1/Prison_Block]

**[K1/Quest_for_the_Star_Forge]**
- «What are you talking about? The Council must be told of what we found there! We found an incomplete Star Map, Master Vandar. And an ancient droid that mentioned something about a Star Forge.» [K1/Quest_for_the_Star_Forge]

**[K1/Ruins]**
- «It was less of a dream and more of a vision... a vision the two of us shared. But I am certainly willing to answer any questions the Jedi Council did not.» [K1/Ruins]
- «Are you wondering why we shared the vision? Or why we even received it in the first place? To the first I can only repeat the answer that the Council gave us. Our fates are linked, and for two as strong as we are in the Force that amounts to a near-physical bond. As to the second, I don't truly have an answer for you. The Force works as it will, and perhaps we should be grateful for what we have been given.» [K1/Ruins]
- «I... I don't know. Believe me, I certainly don't find the prospect of being joined to you enjoyable in any fashion.» [K1/Ruins]
- «Please forgive me. I did not mean to imply that you were repulsive in any sense of the word. That we shared something so personal is just not something I'm used to.» [K1/Ruins]
- «Then perhaps the sooner we see to our destiny the sooner that we can proceed on our separate paths. That seems the logical solution, no?» [K1/Ruins]
- «The Force often seems to cause events that bend the laws of probability, especially with those that are strongly affiliated with it. In this respect, you and I will simply have to become accustomed to such 'convenience'. We are the tools of the Force and we will do as it wills.» [K1/Ruins]
- «The Force does not compel obedience. You have a destiny, but the choices you make along it are ultimately your own.» [K1/Ruins]
- «Quite the contrary. Ours is the ultimate free will. The Force is our destiny, but the choices we make along it are ultimately our own.» [K1/Ruins]
- «There is no evidence one way or the other. What you believe the Force to be ultimately will decide who you are.» [K1/Ruins]
- «What would you like to know?» [K1/Ruins]
- «Perhaps because we desired to. Perhaps because they came to this planet and were strong enough in the Force to leave a... a trace.» [K1/Ruins]
- «That would not be my first choice, either, but choice appears to be irrelevant in this matter.» [K1/Ruins]
- «They did something important here, of that I am certain. It may be simply that we are sensitive to that event. Or it may not.» [K1/Ruins]
- «And what else should we dream about except that which is most important to our fate?» [K1/Ruins]
- «We dreamed about Revan and Malak either because we were meant to or because we needed to. There is no other way to look at it.» [K1/Ruins]
- «I have no idea. It was obviously important, however. That is why we must investigate this further.» [K1/Ruins]
- «And are you so certain that it is not you in my dreams?» [K1/Ruins]
- «I see. That is most likely vanity speaking, for I am not certain, myself. Regardless, our fates are linked... the vision was no doubt meant for us both.» [K1/Ruins]
- «Regardless of which it is, our fates are linked... the vision was doubtless meant for both of us.» [K1/Ruins]
- «With luck we will. I would rather not rely on such visions to guide us, but when we have so little else to go on and the galaxy hangs in the balance...» [K1/Ruins]
- «As you wish. We really should return our thoughts to business, anyway.» [K1/Ruins]
- «I think the droid is trying to communicate with us by cycling through a variety of languages. Each time it spoke it was using a very different alien dialect. The droid can probably understand us. The only problem is it may not have been programmed with the phonemes of a language we can understand.» [K1/Ruins]
- «I recognize this language as well. It is an archaic variant of the Selkath dialect spoken on Manaan. But why would a droid on Dantooine be programmed to speak ancient Selkath?» [K1/Ruins]
- «It must be referring to Revan. The Dark Lord and Malak likely encountered this droid when they explored these ruins.» [K1/Ruins]
- «Ten revolutions would take more than 20,000 years. If this is true then this droid is nearly 5,000 years older than the Republic itself! There must be some mistake.» [K1/Ruins]
- «These Builders must have been an extinct people, though it is strange there is no record of their existence. Even the archives at the Jedi Academy make no mention of them. In the years before the Republic the Hutts were a dominant force in the galaxy, but they never constructed an empire. In fact, I know of no species that would fit with this information.» [K1/Ruins]
- «The droid is obviously not programmed with the knowledge we seek. The Star Forge sounds like some type of weapon, perhaps... though, in fact, it could be anything.» [K1/Ruins]
- «Maybe... that might explain how the Sith were able to amass a fleet so quickly. But I suspect the Star Forge is more powerful than a mere factory.» [K1/Ruins]
- «Our vision was clear. We saw Revan and Malak speaking of the Star Forge. I am certain it is somehow connected to the Sith's sudden rise to power.» [K1/Ruins]
- «Maybe the droid has more information we can use. It seems to respond to you; perhaps you should ask it something else.» [K1/Ruins]
- «The droid must be talking about poor Nemo. The Council sent him here to investigate... and it cost him his life.» [K1/Ruins]
- «Revan and Malak unlocked the sealed door and uncovered the secrets of the Star Forge. Now Malak is using the Star Forge to fuel his conquest of the Republic. We have to find out what they uncovered. We have to find a way to unseal these doors to learn more about the Star Forge! The Republic is depending on us.» [K1/Ruins]
- «If the droid is correct, then we must complete the tasks in the proving grounds to the east and west before these doors will open.» [K1/Ruins]
- «This... this must be what Revan and Malak found when they entered this temple. This must be where their journey down the dark side began.» [K1/Ruins]
- «This is a... a map. Some sort of intergalactic navigational chart. Revan and Malak must have used this to lead them to the Star Forge. We could use this map to follow their path and find the Star Forge ourselves. But we must be wary… they may have laid traps or concealed what they found.» [K1/Ruins]
- «I... I don't know, but Revan and Malak were very interested in finding it. It must be a tool of some type... or maybe a weapon. Perhaps the Council can tell us more. But I think this map might be the key to finding the Star Forge, whatever it is. See this world here? This looks like Korriban, a Sith world. And if that's Korriban, then this is... Kashyyyk... and Tatooine... and here's Manaan. But there are pieces missing: incomplete hyperspace coordinates, corrupted data... and there doesn't seem to be anything indicating where the Star Forge itself might be.» [K1/Ruins]
- «I was thinking that, too. This map can't take us to the Star Forge, but I know that Revan and Malak visited Korriban at least once. Perhaps they discovered something more there. They may have found something on each of the other worlds that completed this map. Maybe if we find all the pieces they will lead us to the Star Forge… and some way to destroy it.» [K1/Ruins]
- «What if I'm right? We can't ignore this. Finding the Star Forge might very well be the key to defeating the Sith!» [K1/Ruins]
- «We must inform the Council of what we have discovered. They must decide our next course of action, though I suspect our task has only just begun.» [K1/Ruins]

**[K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]**
- «This task has its own importance. It may also serve to divert our minds for a short time... something which carries its own rewards.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «Two thousand? Even if he would pay such a fee, what could you possibly need so many credits for?» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «I'm impressed, Carth. That interjection was very Jedi-like.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «I'm afraid Ahlan is not just making idle threats. He is rash and foolish enough to attempt a full assault on the Sandral estate. Such action would result in all-out war between the families.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «Jedi are renowned for their fairness and pursuit of justice. There is nothing to fear from us... unless you have something to hide.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «Privacy is all well and good, but justice must be valued higher. Is it not obvious to you that this man hides something?» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «Typical. Anything to continue the feud which has become so customary to you people.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «Your actions show you are overly focused on material wealth. This is not the way of the Jedi. You will have to learn to let go of your greed if you wish to walk in the light.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «The Council would not approve of your actions here. Perhaps we should find this girl and try to help her.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «I see. Well there is the answer we seek. The Jedi Council should be informed of this at once.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «Of course not. It seems very simple to me. The Council must be allowed to decide the next step.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «I am sure the Council will realize these accusations are completely unfounded. The Matale grievance will fall on deaf ears.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «Good luck to you both. May you find the happiness you deserve.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «Are you mad? They will slaughter each other!» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «*whisper* It is obvious Master Vandar senses something is not right with your story. Yet he chooses to believe you, and I will not question the wisdom of a Jedi Master.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]

**[K1/Sith_Base_(Manaan)]**
- «*whisper* How does promoting the Sith help our cause? Think about what you are doing!» [K1/Sith_Base_(Manaan)]
- «Yes... certainly you must have heard of the destruction of Taris. It is your 'honorable' friends that committed that atrocity.» [K1/Sith_Base_(Manaan)]
- «I can understand why you're doing this, but surely it can't be that hard to *prove* the evil of the dark side, can it?» [K1/Sith_Base_(Manaan)]
- «Use the Force, then. Look into your heart and you will realize what is truth and what is lies.» [K1/Sith_Base_(Manaan)]
- «You have been saved from more than you know. Given time, the Sith would have turned you fully to the dark side... and you would have betrayed your world gladly.» [K1/Sith_Base_(Manaan)]

**[K1/Sith_Base_(Taris)]**
- «This is too risky. We should find another way.» [K1/Sith_Base_(Taris)]
- «No, I... don't have another plan. I would rather not place my life in your hands, however.» [K1/Sith_Base_(Taris)]

**[K1/Star_Forge]**
- «The Republic Fleet must have got the message Carth sent as we were crashing onto that planet. Maybe we can use their arrival to our advantage. If Malak is distracted by the attack, we should be able to get in close enough to dock on the Star Forge and hunt the Dark Lord down!» [K1/Star_Forge]
- «Admiral Dodonna, this is Bastila Shan of the Jedi Order. We are receiving your transmission.» [K1/Star_Forge]
- «The Jedi sent to rescue me from the Dark Lord did their job well - though I am sorry to report Carth did not survive the mission.» [K1/Star_Forge]
- «Don't pull back, Admiral. You have to attack the Star Forge now, otherwise the Sith will use its power to destroy the Republic.» [K1/Star_Forge]
- «As you wish, Master Vandar.» [K1/Star_Forge]
- «The fools! Even Master Vandar did not realize you have reclaimed your identity as the Dark Lord! The Jedi strike team and the Republic forces will provide the perfect distraction as we hunt down your ex-apprentice. And once we have slain Malak, I can use my Battle Meditation and the power of the Star Forge to crush the Republic fleet. All our enemies will be destroyed in a single glorious day!» [K1/Star_Forge]

**[K1/Star_Forge_System]**
- «I'll never fall to the dark side!» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «You think torture will turn me, Malak? You are a fool.» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «Never!» [K1/Star_Forge_System]

**[K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]**
- «Jedi are renowned for being arbiters in times of need. We will investigate this matter as best we are able.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- «If you had listened, Carth, you would know that that *is* the law. Sunry is guilty until proven innocent.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- «Angering the judge won't get us a more impartial decision, Carth.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- «'Almost seems'? They do wish to conquer everything, and will not stop at Manaan. Why the Selkath believe themselves invulnerable I have no idea.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- «Madam. I would remind you that I am a Jedi. Now, then... was he having an affair?» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- «And you would propose what? Letting a murderer free on the chance it will help the Republic?» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- «But you're willing to overlook it. Are the principles that the Republic stands on so very weak, Carth?» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- «This is the will of the court, but it doesn't feel like justice to me.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*

**[K1/Swoop_Platform]**
- «I might have something to say about that, Brejik!» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «You underestimate the strength of a Jedi's mind, Brejik – a mistake you won't live to regret!» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «Well, maybe those bloody Vulkars will think twice next time before trying to keep a Jedi prisoner! And as for you, if you think you can collect me as a prize... Wait... I don't believe this! You're... you're one of the soldiers with the Republic fleet, aren't you? Yes, I'm sure of it. How did you end up racing for these swoop gangs?» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «Well we don't have time for it now. We have to get out of here before the Sith show up to sort out this mess. Is there somewhere safe we can go?» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «You must have banked a turn too sharply, because it sounds like all the blood has rushed from your brain! I'm Bastila Shan, a member of the Jedi Order and a fleet commander for the Republic. Nobody 'owns' me! Now we don't have time for joking around. What are you doing here?» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «Save me? Is that what you were trying to accomplish by riding in that swoop race? Well, as far as rescues go this is a pretty poor example. In case you hadn't noticed, I managed to free myself from that neural restraint collar without your help. In fact, it's more accurate to say that I saved you! Brejik and his Vulkars would have left you for dead if I hadn't stepped into that fight. You're lucky I was here to get you out of this mess!» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «I may have been a prisoner, but a Jedi is never helpless. Maybe you've heard of a little thing called 'the Force'? But I suppose I shouldn't be too hard on you. You did try to save me after all, even if it didn't go quite as planned. So let's get down to business – we're not out of danger yet.» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «Yes, I suppose you can. Well, I appreciate your attempt to save me – even if it didn't really go as you planned. But let's get down to business – we're not out of danger yet.» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «If I'm going to figure out a way for us to get off this planet I need to know what kind of resources we can draw on. First, are we the only two survivors left from the Endar Spire?» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «The Republic, for one. I was fleet commander, remember? But I don't want you getting all worked up over nothing. So tell me – do you have a plan to get off this planet?» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «Carth Onasi is alive? Finally, some good news! Carth is one of the Republic's best soldiers. He's proved himself a hero a dozen times over! And he sent you here to save me? Maybe I misjudged you. Carth wouldn't have sent you if he wasn't confident in your... abilities. Forgive me – despite my Jedi training, I still tend to act a bit rashly sometimes.» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «Please, take me to Carth right away. Between the three of us I'm sure we can figure out some way to get off this planet before the Sith realize we're here.» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «You cannot win, Revan!» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «You mean you don't have a plan to get off Taris yet? What have you been doing all this time?» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «I see. Now that I'm back in charge of this mission, perhaps we can start doing things properly. Hopefully our escape from Taris will go more smoothly than when you "rescued" me from Brejik.» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «My attitude? It strikes me that you're the one in sore need of an attitude adjustment. I happen to be in charge of this mission, if you'll recall.» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «That hardly strikes me as an appropriate way of addressing your commander, Carth. I am a member of the Jedi Order and this is my mission. Don't forget that! My Battle Meditation ability has helped the Republic many times in this war, and it will serve us well here I am sure.» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «Yes... You're right, of course. I apologize, Carth. This has been a difficult time for me. Of course I'm happy to listen to your advice. What do you suggest we do?» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «Well said, Carth. And the sooner we start looking the better; I've already been a prisoner of the Vulkars and I don't plan on being captured by the Sith.» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «I see. It's true that I don't have much military experience; perhaps I should not be so quick to judge. Very well, Carth: what do you suggest we do?» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «I think we'll need some help getting off Taris. Maybe if we ask around one of the locals can help us out. We should probably start by asking around in the cantinas.» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «You don't need to ally yourself with this... person. We should move on while we can.» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «I don't sense any deception from him, which is surprising. This may be exactly what we need.» [K1/Swoop_Platform]

**[K1/Swoop_Registration]**
- «My friend tells the truth. I am a Jedi... are you going to imply that I am lying, as well?» [K1/Swoop_Registration]
- «And? It sounds like you have something special. What do you want help with?» [K1/Swoop_Registration]
- «[Force Persuade] I have heard enough. You want to act in a fair manner. Now.» [K1/Swoop_Registration]
- «Forcing the boy to sign his life away? Is that really necessary?» [K1/Swoop_Registration]
- «I would have thought we have more important things to do than extort credits from the common folk.» [K1/Swoop_Registration]

**[K1/Taris]**
- «The surface of Taris is covered with an urban skyscrape. Its glittering spires belie the decay that lies in its lower reaches, however. Beyond that, there is little else I can tell you.» [K1/Taris]

**[K1/Tatooine]**
- «Tatooine is known for little but blowing sand. I find it surprising that there would be a Star Map somewhere in its desolate wastes.» [K1/Tatooine]
- «Perhaps, though that would have been tens of thousands of years in the past. Now there is nothing but the howling emptiness of the Dune Sea.» [K1/Tatooine]
- «The Star Map would likely have to be within some kind of shelter to protect it against dust and sandstorms. I suspect there are many such caves and caverns hidden in the sands of the Dune Sea. The creatures of this world probably use them as their lairs. No doubt things will become more clear once we discover the Star Map's location.» [K1/Tatooine]
- «Tatooine is a dry planet that has not been inhabited long and has little law. This town of Anchorhead may be its only settlement. Beyond that, there is little else I can tell you.» [K1/Tatooine]

**[K1/Temple_Summit]**
- «Revan - I knew you'd come for me. Malak thought you might be afraid to enter the Temple again, but he doesn't know you like I do. Not anymore. Not since you've changed.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Escape? You don't understand. I have sworn allegiance to Lord Malak and the Sith; I am no longer a pawn of the Jedi Council.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «You say that as if the dark side is some terrible entity. The Jedi Council has brainwashed you like all the others. Like they once did with me.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Surely you know what I mean, Revan. Look at what the Council did to you; they turned you into their puppet. The same thing they do to all who are truly strong in the Force.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «They speak of the dark side as if it something to be feared. But in reality their only goal is to manipulate those who are strong in the Force. The fear of the dark side is a tool to maintain control. Why do you think the Jedi forbid you and Malak from joining the Mandalorian Wars? They knew you would realize your true potential and break free of their domination. Malak has shown me how the Jedi Council have been using me the same way they once tried to use you. They've been holding me back because they knew one day I would surpass them all.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «I resisted at first. I endured the Sith torments with the passionless serenity of a true Jedi, emptying my mind. But after a week of endless tortures I finally saw the truth. Malak forced me to acknowledge my anger and pain. He showed me the liberating power of these emotions. Then he made me see how the Jedi Council has denied me what is mine by right! The Jedi Council gladly used my Battle Meditation in their wars, but they still treated me like a child - like an inferior. They were jealous of my power... of what I could become! They wanted me to bow and call them Master and follow their Code and obey their every order. But all the while they were exploiting my Battle Meditation for their own use!» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «You are a sad little fool. You speak as if I were the same Bastila that you've known all along. But freed from the control of the Jedi Council I've become much, much more.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «You think so, do you? You style yourself the Master of the Sith that you once were? To think I once envied you your passion, your power.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «I almost wish you could see things as I do now. I wish you could join me and taste true power once again. Sadly, I doubt you are even capable any longer.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Lies? You are the one living a lie, Revan. The Jedi Council made you into something you are not; they programmed you to be their slave.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «You used to be Revan, Master of the Sith, but no longer. You are simply a pawn of the Jedi Council and the Republic they serve... like I was until Malak freed me from their shackles!» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «A pity the power you once had is so diluted in you. You could have been strong as I am now... stronger, even. But that will never happen, now.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «With the power of the Star Forge Malak will destroy the Republic and conquer the galaxy. And I will be the apprentice at his side - after I prove my worth by killing you!» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «You are stronger than I would have thought possible, after what the Jedi Council did to you. Seems that Malak was wrong - the power of the dark side is not lost to you after all, Revan.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «You can deny what you are, Revan, but you are only fooling yourself. I know the truth. I have seen the shadows inside your mind. Remember: I was there when you nearly died in the trap set by the Jedi Council. I used the Force to preserve your life, Revan. We are forever linked by my actions on that bridge!» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «These are not your true feelings, Revan. You are speaking as a tool of the Jedi Council - as I once did. But now I see how the Jedi used us both!» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Our bond is not easily broken, Revan. Even when your mind was destroyed and reprogrammed with a new identity the bond between us endured.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Do not mistake the power of the Force for love, Revan. It does not exist. Power is what forged our bond, and power is what made us both tools of the Jedi Council!» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «The Council tried to exploit the bond between us. They hoped I would draw out your memories to lead them to the Star Forge. We were slaves to their will - like all who follow the Jedi Code! But in our shared visions of the Star Maps I also felt the so called taint within you. I resisted it at first, but now I embrace the power of the dark side - your dark side!» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Yes, Revan! I was there when you almost died in the trap set by the Jedi Council; I used the Force to preserve your life. We are forever linked by my actions on that bridge. The Council tried to exploit our bond. They hoped your memories would lead me to the Star Forge. But in our shared visions of the Star Maps I also tasted the power of the taint within you!» [K1/Temple_Summit]
