- «I had... had nothing left after that, really. I devoted myself to the fleet. Hunting Saul was my only purpose.» [K1/Carth]
- «I... miss them. I know killing Saul won't bring them back, and it won't make me happy again... but I have to do it. I don't expect you to understand. I have to pay him back for what he's done... I have to. It's all I have left.» [K1/Carth]
- «Gotten over it? Look - my family was everything to me. Once they were gone... I had nothing. Hunting Saul became my only purpose.» [K1/Carth]
- «No, it's alright, I don't mind. You deserved some kind of... explanation.» [K1/Carth]
- «She had courage and ... and she was stubborn.» [K1/Carth]
- «She had courage... and she was stubborn. Heh... a little bit like you in that respect.» [K1/Carth]
- «I could never talk her out of anything once she put her mind to it. And she hated it when I signed back onto the fleet at the start of the war. I had planned on... on leaving soon, to join her...» [K1/Carth]
- «Yes. I can't forgive Saul for this. He took everything from me, even... even my trust. I hope you can understand that.» [K1/Carth]
- «His name was Dustil and I don't know what happened to him. The colony was a complete ruin, and we never found any trace of him. I made inquiries and followed the reports from Telos for years, but... I stopped. Anyway... I hope that answers your questions. Let's, uh... let's continue with what we were doing.» [K1/Carth]
- «To think that I once looked up to those two as the best that humanity had to offer. Now I'd like nothing more than to put a blaster to both their heads. Although I suppose only Malak is left, isn't he? Turned on his own master, not that Revan didn't have it coming. Heh. Typical for their kind, I guess.» [K1/Carth]
- «No, not personally. They aided the Republic during the Mandalorian wars. They were heroes. Without them the Mandalorians would have finished us for certain. In the fleet, we didn't see much of the Jedi. I only met Malak once, but I was impressed by him. I guess that just shows how much the dark side can change someone.» [K1/Carth]
- «Nobody does. When they left after the Mandalorian wars ended, they were Jedi. When they returned... they were something else.» [K1/Carth]
- «Well... when they returned from wherever they went, they had an entire fleet with them. Nobody knows where they got the ships. They had a lot of them and as the years have passed there always seems to be more and more... while our forces dwindle. Did they really get away with it, though? Revan was betrayed by Malak... and Malak hasn't won. In the end, the dark side won't help him.» [K1/Carth]
- «I, uh... used to think that it was a fancy name for something that I see every day. Corruption is everywhere. People are greedy and stupid and do horrible things. I'm starting to think it's different for the Jedi, however. That there's this evil watching them, waiting for its chance.» [K1/Carth]
- «I've been watching you. You have this, uh... incredible darkness inside you. Some of the things you do disturb me.» [K1/Carth]
- «You have so much courage and strength in you... yet, somehow, I have no trouble imagining it differently. Like the flip side of a coin.» [K1/Carth]
- «It's not just you. It's Bastila, as well. She's so... intense. I don't pretend to know much about the Force... but I know evil.» [K1/Carth]
- «No, of course not. All I'm saying is that when you have so much power, the stakes are higher. I can only imagine the kind of conflict that goes on inside you.» [K1/Carth]
- «No? I know how people change. I remember how Malak looked and acted before his return... I bet the old Malak discounted the possibility that he would ever fall, as well.» [K1/Carth]
- «That's a frightening thought. I hope you're right.» [K1/Carth]
- «Neither you nor Bastila are fully trained on how to handle your power. I'm just concerned at what might come.» [K1/Carth]
- «I didn't mean to... <Sigh> Fine, fine. I suppose I shouldn't stick my nose where it doesn't belong. I'll leave you be.» [K1/Carth]
- «Well, that's not what I... I mean... I wouldn't want to see you hurt. Either of you.» [K1/Carth]
- «I know that, and Bastila says the same thing. You're both incredible women. I'm just... I'm just not sure this is the kind of thing you can defeat.» [K1/Carth]
- «I suppose finding the Star Maps is more important than your training... and your safety. I just hope there isn't a price for you to pay.» [K1/Carth]
- «Oh... it's nothing. Sorry.» [K1/Carth]
- «Moping? I'm not moping! I... okay, fine, maybe I'm moping a little, but you're very pushy, you know that?» [K1/Carth]
- «I told you my wife died four years ago. I... I've just been trying to remember what she looked like. It shouldn't be so difficult. I can remember things about her... things she did. The way she smiled, what her hair smelled like, our last fight... just not her face. I try to hold it in my head but it's gone. Is... that strange? Maybe I shouldn't be talking to you about this.» [K1/Carth]
- «Ahhh, I'm sorry. I shouldn't have mentioned it, even if you asked. I just find you, I don't know... easy to talk to.» [K1/Carth]
- «But I *should* be able to remember her face. It's frustrating! I... feel like I'm losing her.» [K1/Carth]
- «That's a damned mean thing to say. I wasn't ready for her to go, I can't accept it. Alright?» [K1/Carth]
- «I, uh... it must look really strange for me to be obsessing like this, still. You must think I'm incredibly stupid.» [K1/Carth]
- «She isn't a ghost to me. I still remember holding her as she died... and I doubt I'll forget until I've paid Saul back in kind. That's all I have left: finding Saul and killing the scum. Don't worry... I won't waste any more time until then.» [K1/Carth]
- «I... suppose you're probably right. But I have to do it, anyway.» [K1/Carth]
- «Maybe. It can't be worse than what I tell myself, sometimes.» [K1/Carth]
- «The only thing that's kept me going since she died has been the need to find Saul and kill him. It's better to think about that than... anything else. If I can do that, then maybe I can let her go. Let it all go. If we encounter Saul... if we ever have the chance, promise me that I will be the one to kill him. I have to settle this... I need to.» [K1/Carth]
- «Whether it does or not, that's the way it has to be. I... guess there's no need to discuss it until then.» [K1/Carth]
- «Thank you. I... guess there's really nothing else to say.» [K1/Carth]
- «You mean if I kill him?» [K1/Carth]
- «I... never thought about it. I suppose I always assumed that I would be dead once Saul was.» [K1/Carth]
- «Understand that whenever I envisioned taking on Saul in the past, it was always as the captain of my own ship... or alone. In those cases I would risk everything.» [K1/Carth]
- «That's never occurred to me. I've always been the captain of my own ship, after all... or thought about going after Saul on my own.» [K1/Carth]
- «I'm not in the same situation, now. I wouldn't risk hurting you... or the others.» [K1/Carth]
- «You don't think I would throw away everything we're doing here, do you?» [K1/Carth]
- «I would like to think that I wouldn't put you in danger. That I wouldn't forget that there's more behind Saul that needs to be stopped.» [K1/Carth]
- «Of course it means something to me! The Sith have to be stopped! You think it doesn't matter to me that everyone on Taris is dead? That the Republic is in danger?» [K1/Carth]
- «If I saw Saul, however... if I had the chance... I don't know what I would do. I really don't. I mean his death has been my entire focus for so long.» [K1/Carth]
- «Well, that's easier said than done, but I know you mean well. I promise you I'll see this through. No matter what.» [K1/Carth]
- «I know. I'll... see this through. I promise you that. No matter what.» [K1/Carth]
- «But, uh... maybe it's best I did. I have to see this through... and I will, to the end. I promise you that. No matter what.» [K1/Carth]
- «As for what comes afterward... well, let's wait until I know that I'm around to see it.» [K1/Carth]
- «Oh. I hadn't thought you'd noticed...» [K1/Carth]
- «No, no, I didn't mean it that way.» [K1/Carth]
- «Err... I'm not that bad, am I?» [K1/Carth]
- «Damn it, woman, if you keep hounding me I'm going to put you over my knee and teach you a lesson!» [K1/Carth]
- «Well, I ah... I've just been admiring you. Not, uhh, not anything like that, though...» [K1/Carth]
- «Oh, no, I'm not even going there, sister.» [K1/Carth]
- «You just wait, you'll get yours.» [K1/Carth]
- «At any rate, I wasn't ogling you. I've just been admiring you.» [K1/Carth]
- «I've been watching you in action. Your, your skills... you have a natural talent that is incredible. Not that, ah, all I do is watch you or anything. I don't mean anything by it.» [K1/Carth]
- «Oh. Right. I'll, ah, I'll just pay attention to what I'm doing...» [K1/Carth]
- «Sorry. Didn't mean to... embarrass you. I'll stop.» [K1/Carth]
- «Ha! Why didn't you tell me that sooner? You would have saved me a lot of trouble.» [K1/Carth]
- «Well... maybe a few. I hope you won't mind if I keep those to myself.» [K1/Carth]
- «I will say one thing, however. We've come a long way with your help. Whether it's the Force or fate or just dumb luck... I'm glad you're here. We probably would have never made it this far without you. I... should have said this long before, instead of doubting you. I, ah, hope you can forgive me.» [K1/Carth]
- «I guess I'm a proud man. I... don't admit things like this easily.» [K1/Carth]
- «And you accepted it... but that doesn't mean I'm forgiven. I'd like to be.» [K1/Carth]
- «Err... what do you mean?» [K1/Carth]
- «Because you're an impressive and beautiful woman. In some ways... good ways... you remind me of my wife and I'd like to make things right between us.» [K1/Carth]
- «What am I supposed to say? I was wrong. I was a stubborn fool. I... Look, I have trouble admitting it when a beautiful woman has my number...ok?» [K1/Carth]
- «Thank you. Let's, ah... let's get back to what we were doing.» [K1/Carth]
- «I'll, ah, take that as a yes. I'm glad that's settled. Shall we... shall we get back to what we were doing?» [K1/Carth]
- «Oh, you can tell, can you?» [K1/Carth]
- «I do. It's serious, though... I need your attention. Is this a good time?» [K1/Carth]
- «Oh, yeah? Well listen, beautiful, I don't need to take this abuse. I get enough female Jedi bashing from Bastila, thank you very much.» [K1/Carth]
- «Wouldn't you like to know. Just you wait, sister.» [K1/Carth]
- «And just what would you do if I wasn't? No, no, wait, don't answer that. I don't want to know.» [K1/Carth]
- «Uh. *That* is one bet I'm not about to take. Not a chance.» [K1/Carth]
- «You think so? I could probably get the same kind of attention from a blaster rifle.» [K1/Carth]
- «Ha! No, wait, wait, don't go. Not just yet.» [K1/Carth]
- «Now *that* I'd like to see. Or would I? You've got my damn head on backwards, you know that?» [K1/Carth]
- «What?! No! I mean... no! Don't be crazy!» [K1/Carth]
- «Oh no you don't! I'd have to shoot you down first, and I'm not kidding.» [K1/Carth]
- «What? You must be joking. I'd be lucky not to get my eyeballs seared out of their sockets.» [K1/Carth]
- «Was there ever any doubt?» [K1/Carth]
- «Anyway... as fun, uh, as this is, I do have to talk to you about something serious. Really serious. Uh, is this a good time?» [K1/Carth]
- «Alright. We'll talk later, then.» [K1/Carth]
- «Alright. I'm, uh... I'm concerned about you. I've been keeping these thoughts to myself, mostly, but I think it's time I say something.» [K1/Carth]
- «It's about you. I'm worried about what you're doing to yourself... how much you've succumbed to violence and anger. I knew it was possible for this to happen to you... and it just pains me to see it. I've been down this path. And I don't recommend it.» [K1/Carth]
- «It's about you. I'm worried about what might happen to you. You have a lot of courage, and the fact you've remained strong is amazing, but there is even greater danger ahead. I think you might be setting yourself up for a fall. Maybe at the urging of the Jedi, I don't know... but you're definitely going to become a target.» [K1/Carth]
- «If, uh... if I'm going to find some purpose beyond taking revenge on Saul, then it's going to have to be in protecting you. I don't know why, but I think some terrible fate is waiting for you. I think the Jedi Council knows it, too. And I don't want that to come to pass.» [K1/Carth]
- «That's where I think you're wrong. You can't do this on your own. Nobody could.» [K1/Carth]
- «I *sigh* I... don't know. I'm not the best of men, and I'm not the strongest fighter there is... but I'll find a way.» [K1/Carth]
- «I know that there's going to come a day when you'll look in the mirror and wonder how you ever got to become what you are... and by then it will be too late.» [K1/Carth]
- «Don't chalk it up to my paranoia just yet. Something isn't right. I blamed it on you, before, but I... I think the Jedi didn't tell us everything.» [K1/Carth]
- «If I'm going to live past Saul, I need you to, as well. Let me protect you... from yourself, from the Sith... you have to let me try.» [K1/Carth]
- «I, uh... I guess I have no other choice. I will still help you, if I can... but I guess you're on your own. If that's the way you want it, I hope things go well. Let's, uh... let's get back to what we were doing.» [K1/Carth]
- «Because... because I never got the chance to save my wife and son. Because I didn't stop Saul when I had the chance. Because I finally have the chance to do it right. You are an extraordinary woman... you make me think that maybe I might have some purpose beyond revenge. I don't know whether it means anything to you... but it does to me.» [K1/Carth]
- «I'm glad to hear that. I'll do my best.» [K1/Carth]
- «Jordo?» [K1/Carth]
- «I was. I crashed.» [K1/Carth]
- «So, what are you doing here, Jordo? The last time I saw you was on, um... well, Telos, actually.» [K1/Carth]
- «My... boy? You mean... Dustil?» [K1/Carth]
- «No! Jordo, Dustil has been missing since the attack on Telos! Are you... are you absolutely certain it was him?!» [K1/Carth]
- «What do you mean he's joined the Sith?» [K1/Carth]
- «No... no, I... I didn't. Well, thanks for telling me, Jordo.» [K1/Carth]
- «Dustil... Dustil is alive! We have to go to the Korriban academy and find him!» [K1/Carth]
- «You think I don't know that? I just... if there's a chance we can try to find him... I don't want to wait to track him down, if possible.» [K1/Carth]
- «Thank you. I... I just have to see him. I have to know what happened to him.» [K1/Carth]
- «I don't know. I don't know why Dustil would be with the Sith... but I... I have to find out. There's simply no choice.» [K1/Carth]
- «All this time I've thought he was... he must be a man by now...» [K1/Carth]
- «Talk about what? The only thing I want to do right now is find Dustil. If he's alive... well, there's just nothing else I want to think about. I'll understand if we can't look for him right now, but if we could it would be a huge load off my mind.» [K1/Carth]
- «There's nothing to talk about. I failed my son... just as I failed my wife. I thought that if I ever found him... I just can't believe he's dead. I... you should have stopped him! You should have done something to prevent this!» [K1/Carth]
- «Oh, don't give me that innocent look! You can talk a Hutt out of his credits, you could have found a way... you could have saved him!» [K1/Carth]
- «Is it? You seem just fine at pulling off the near-impossible... when you want to.» [K1/Carth]
- «He was my son!!» [K1/Carth]
- «Why didn't you want to? You knew how important finding Dustil was to me! You... you've helped others, why not him? Why not me?» [K1/Carth]
- «I can't help but wonder if part of you didn't enjoy this. I thought we might be friends, but with you... heh, who can tell?» [K1/Carth]
- «You could have. But... you're only partly to blame. I'm to blame for all the rest.» [K1/Carth]
- «All the blame? No. Part of the blame, though... part of the blame is yours. The rest is mine.» [K1/Carth]
- «Is it? I find it hard to tell which side you're on, sometimes. Still... not all the blame is yours. Most of it is mine.» [K1/Carth]
- «No, I see that. I don't know what I was expecting, telling you all I did. The blame is mostly mine for this, anyway.» [K1/Carth]
- «I... I wish we hadn't come. I wish I'd never found him.» [K1/Carth]
- «I'm sorry, too. And I'm sorry I ever met you.» [K1/Carth]
- «No, I did fail him. And so did you. I wish I'd never met you.» [K1/Carth]
- «No. If it did, I would never have met you.» [K1/Carth]
- «I... no, I didn't mean that. Please... maybe it would be better if we continued with the mission. I want to... take my mind off this. Saving the galaxy is what's important now. My son... I can mourn my son later. When we're done. So... let's just go.» [K1/Carth]
- «So, Jolee, you decided to leave your little hermitage in the forest and come help us stop the Sith. I guess you realized this was worth coming out of retirement for, huh?» [K1/Carth] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Okay, old man, you lost me there. Are you trying to make a point?» [K1/Carth] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «That's an interesting theory, but I don't buy it. The Republic stands for something; it's stood for something for fifteen thousand years. And if it falls, everything will change forever.» [K1/Carth] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «I'll be honest, Mission. Taris would rate pretty low. The prejudice, the rich spoiling themselves while the poor are crushed beneath them – not a pretty picture.» [K1/Carth] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Trust me, Mission. There are a lot of worlds better than Taris. There are worse, too. But Taris is no place for a kid to live on her own – even a kid who's got a Wookiee to look out for her.» [K1/Carth] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Don't you snap at me, missy! You want a lecture? How's this: only bratty little children fly off the handle because of a simple comment.» [K1/Carth] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «And I sure as hell don't need this. Let's just drop it and get back to what we were doing.» [K1/Carth] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Are you ready to have a civil chat? Or are is this going to be another childish tantrum?» [K1/Carth] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Yeah, I know. And I'm sorry about what I said, too. I'm just a little on edge lately. Not surprising considering all we've been through. But I shouldn't take it out on you.» [K1/Carth] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Mission, you have to know that we don't think you're helpless. Look where we are, look at what we're doing. You're not just along for the ride.  We need you.» [K1/Carth] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Ah, it's no big deal. I know how it is. Sometimes you just need to hear a few words of encouragement. Kids are like that.» [K1/Carth] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*

**[K1/Command_Module]**

**[K1/Courtyard]**

- «I say we look for these Mandalorians. I fought them in the war... they're nothing but vicious pirates. We should... we should stop them if we can.» [K1/Courtyard]

**[K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]**
- «The Wookiee was looking pretty agitated back in the ship. You think it's wise to leave him unattended?» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «He looked like there was something he needed to do. Besides, we don't know this planet. He could prove useful. Good or bad, he's got to have some interest in Kashyyyk. I'd rather have him with us.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «I agree, but he could prove useful. He'd certainly know the place. And I wouldn't mind keeping an eye on him. Good or bad, he's got to have some interest in Kashyyyk. I'd rather have him with us.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «No business sense? You mean they don't like to be cheated out of all their belongings and freedom.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «No, they're not. An honest man is pretty scarce, too, wouldn't you say?» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «I have to admit, I'm surprised you let him get away. I don't know if I could have been as forgiving.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «Odd energy signatures? Have you ever checked those out?» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «Humane, you call it? Beneficial? Sounds like a bunch of excuses, if you ask me.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «Are you saying you approve of this?!» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]

**[K1/Czerka_Office]**
- «*whisper* I don't know much about the Jedi code, but I know I'd rather see those credits in our hands than in the hands of Czerka Corp or the Sith.» [K1/Czerka_Office]

**[K1/Dantooine]**
- «Safe? You saw what his fleet did to Taris: there wasn't a building over two stories high left standing! They... they turned the planet into one big pile of rubble.» [K1/Dantooine]
- «Maybe you're right. It isn't easy to witness the annihilation of an entire planet. I know Mission must be taking it pretty hard.» [K1/Dantooine]
- «An audience with the Jedi Council? That's pretty unusual for someone who isn't even a Jedi. What's this about, Bastila?» [K1/Dantooine]
- «Well, I don't like being left out of the loop, but I'm not looking to get you in any trouble with the Jedi Masters. We'll do things your way for a while.» [K1/Dantooine]
- «Dantooine's a boring place. It's all plains and herders and small settlements. Perfect for the Jedi to lose themselves in, I guess. That's all I can think of, at any rate.» [K1/Dantooine]

**[K1/Davik's_Estate]**

- «Hey! There's no need for that. Just... just run, pal, before my friend here decides to start blasting.» [K1/Davik's_Estate]

**[K1/Eastern_Dune_Sea]**

**[K1/Great_Walkway]**
- «This planet is incredible! It's too bad Zaalbar isn't with us. It would be nice to have a guide who's familiar with this place.» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- «Put it down? You killed him, you mean.» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- «It's a good thing Zaalbar isn't here to see this. I doubt he'd approve of what you're doing. Actually, I don't know if I approve, either.» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- «Why not do something about it, then?» [K1/Great_Walkway]

**[K1/Grove]**
- «First the Jedi trick you into becoming an enemy, then they welcome you back as a friend. I can't say I approve of their training methods.» [K1/Grove]
- «I'm not an expert on the Jedi, but this seems like the kind of thing that could get a person into a lot of trouble.» [K1/Grove]
- «Heh heh... that's sort of funny, but you should really be serious about this, no?» [K1/Grove]
- «You did good. You might just make a proper Jedi yet, who knows?» [K1/Grove]

**[K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]**
- «Careful. He'll be impossible to reason with if you get him any madder.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]

**[K1/Hangar]**
- «Down you go!» [K1/Hangar]
- «[[../Taris#Search for Bastila» [K1/Hangar]
- «No, Bastila, he's too strong! NO!!» [K1/Hangar]
- «The door's sealed, we can't get past! Come on, we have to get to the Ebon Hawk!» [K1/Hangar]
- «Bastila doesn't stand a chance against Malak, but we can't help her. Not here. We have to get off this ship and find the Star Forge. That's the key to beating the Dark Lord! Bastila sacrificed herself so we could get away. We can't let her sacrifice be in vain! Come on!» [K1/Hangar]
- «If you're ready to talk, then yes... so am I.» [K1/Hangar] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «I can't hate you. I tried... I wanted to hold you responsible for all the things you've done. For my... for my wife, for Telos... for Dustil. But I can't.» [K1/Hangar] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Maybe you shouldn't. I would hope that my standing by you would mean something to you, but maybe it doesn't. Maybe it just can't.» [K1/Hangar] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «I got the revenge I always wanted when Saul died, but it hasn't brought me the peace that I thought it would.» [K1/Hangar]
- «You have a darkness inside you that must be Revan. But there's more to you, as well. I see it, I know it's there.» [K1/Hangar] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Despite whatever part of Revan is inside you, the... the darkness that must surely be there, it isn't who you are.» [K1/Hangar] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «That's why I can't hate you, why I don't want any more revenge. You don't have to be Revan, you can be so much more. Whatever the Jedi did to you, they gave you that chance. Whatever's happened up until this point, there's going to come a time very soon where you're going to have to make a choice. And there won't be any turning back.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Well then I hope I can save you. From yourself.» [K1/Hangar] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «We ran into Malak. He would have killed us, but Bastila sacrificed herself so we could get away.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Malak won't kill her. I think he'll want to use her battle meditation against the Republic. He'll keep her alive so he can turn her to the dark side!» [K1/Hangar]
- «Not so fast. We've got a bigger issue to deal with here. They deserve to know the truth about you. Do you want to tell them what Malak said, or should I?» [K1/Hangar]
- «Threats? You can't bully me - though I shouldn't be surprised now that I know who you really are... Revan.» [K1/Hangar]
- «No, it's no joke. The Jedi Council captured Revan and erased the Dark Lord's mind, programming in a new identity. Saul Karath told me on the Leviathan and Bastila confirmed it!» [K1/Hangar]
- «And so the lies begin. It was obvious you remembered something back there when Malak confronted you with the truth. It might have only been small pieces, but there was something there!» [K1/Hangar]
- «Of course it still matters! How do we know more memories won't come flooding back? How do we know Revan won't suddenly turn on us? The whole time we've been chasing after Malak we've had his old Sith Master right at our side; listening to our secrets; hearing our plans!» [K1/Hangar]
- «How can you say that, Mission? The Sith bombed my home world! Revan took away my family and destroyed my life!» [K1/Hangar]
- «It, uh... it all makes sense now... Revan. I've watched you, I've seen your cruelty. I've seen your... your dark side. And now this! I don't know if I can trust you. Can any of us?» [K1/Hangar]
- «I... I suppose you've proven yourself to be a friend of the Republic by your actions so far... Revan. But can I trust you? Can any of us?» [K1/Hangar]
- «Well, the others seem to trust you... and I don't see any other way that we can stop the Sith. And I suppose that Malak is the real enemy here... I really don't have any other choice, do I?» [K1/Hangar]
- «I want to believe you. You've proven yourself time and time again during our mission, but this is a little much for me to wrap my mind around.» [K1/Hangar]
- «This must be even more of a shock to you... I don't know how you even keep going. I guess we both just have to find a way to push forward.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Don't worry - I won't let my personal feelings get in the way of my assignments or this mission. But don't forget: I've sworn an oath to defend the Republic! As long as this mission stays on course I'll stick with you. But I won't let you betray the Republic under any circumstances!» [K1/Hangar]
- «So I guess that's it then... we keep going. We've still got one more Star Map to uncover if we're going to find that Star Forge and save Bastila, so let's do it before it's too late.» [K1/Hangar]

**[K1/Hidden_Bek_Base]**
- «Don't fool yourself. The Sith would never commit to that kind of operation. They'd... they'd probably do something much more grand and deadly.» [K1/Hidden_Bek_Base]
- «Uh, very tactful. Are you itching for a fight or something?» [K1/Hidden_Bek_Base]
- «They still think Bastila is just a Republic officer. That could work to our advantage. Maybe she'll even figure out a way to escape from the Vulkar base on her own.» [K1/Hidden_Bek_Base] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «So how do you propose we go about rescuing Bastila, then? We can't fight all the gangs.» [K1/Hidden_Bek_Base] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*

**[K1/Hrakert_Station]**
- «Then how are we supposed to get you out of here?» [K1/Hrakert_Station]

**[K1/Hunting_Lodge]**
- «There's only one language you Gamorreans ever understand. A blaster to your forehead.» [K1/Hunting_Lodge]
- «Hey, don't push your luck, fellas.» [K1/Hunting_Lodge]
- «Hey! You talk to her with a bit of respect in your voice or you'll end this conversation minus a few teeth! Got it?» [K1/Hunting_Lodge]

**[K1/Javyar's_Cantina]**
- «It couldn't hurt, could it? Enough credits could help grease a lot of wheels.» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]
- «Well, it's my experience that the targets of these bounties are usually criminals, themselves. So don't get all in a twist over it.» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]
- «I can't see anything wrong with getting rid of people like that – as long as we don't end up on the list of their victims.» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]
- «Okay, I don't know about Davik's special contracts. Justice is one thing, but doing a crime lord's dirty work is something else.» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]
- «Yeah, right. Sounds to me like she was defending herself.» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]
- «You showed a lot of guts dealing with those Vulkars, kid. You got a name?» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]
- «So we noticed. Still, you seem like an odd pair.» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]
- «Where would he keep it? Do you know?» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]

**[K1/Jedi_Enclave]**
- «They're waiting for you inside.» [K1/Jedi_Enclave]
- «This morning's getting stranger by the minute. First Bastila comes out looking like she saw a ghost, and now you. Well, Bastila did mention that you should go to the Council chambers before she left. It is no doubt urgent, so you shouldn't keep them waiting.» [K1/Jedi_Enclave]
- «No, she didn't. She didn't seem well, as I recall... and for that matter neither do you. Are you alright?» [K1/Jedi_Enclave]
- «Well, I can't say I blame you. I... I haven't exactly been sleeping well myself. Here I thought things would get better once we escaped Taris.» [K1/Jedi_Enclave]

**[K1/Kashyyyk]**
- «Kashyyyk is covered by a giant forest, I hear. Trees kilometers high. The Wookiees live on the higher branches, I think. That's all I can think of, at any rate.» [K1/Kashyyyk]

**[K1/Korriban]**
- «Korriban's a desolate world, and a Sith planet. There's only one small colony here, I'm pretty sure. That's all I can think of, at any rate.» [K1/Korriban]

**[K1/Leviathan]**
- «Sith Interdictor ship. They must have been waiting for us on the hyperspace route. We're caught in their tractor beam.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «It's the Leviathan. Saul Karath's vessel. My old mentor.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Admiral Karath taught me everything I know about being a soldier. He was a legend in the Republic fleet, and a hero to me. Until he betrayed us. When the Sith attacked my home world, the Leviathan - which is Saul Karath's flagship - was at the head of the fleet. My family was destroyed that day and my wife died in the Sith bombardment.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «I'm not going to do anything stupid. I won't throw our lives away in some mad quest for vengeance. But if I get a chance to kill Saul during our escape, nobody better get in my way.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «I'll admit it won't be easy. Saul's no fool and he won't underestimate us either. You can count on plenty of guards watching every move we make.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Well, if we're going to pick someone to save our skins we better do it quick. In another minute we're going to have Sith troops marching up our loading ramp!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Well, the droid's right. If we disable him the Sith will probably wipe his memory chips and take him to the junkpile. But we can rig a back-up memory chip with a timer. When it kicks in the little fella will be reactivated and he can come find us.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Well, that's a risk we might have to take, unless you can come up with a better plan to get us out of this.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Hold on! They're dragging us into the docking bridge!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «But I recognized you, Saul. I see your face every night even as I promise myself I will kill you for what you did to my home world.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «It was a cowardly act of betrayal! Your fleet bombed a civilian target into oblivion without warning or provocation. And the blood of those innocent people is on your hands!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «My wife died in that attack, Saul. And for that, I swear I'll kill you.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Don't waste your breath, Saul! We won't answer any of your questions.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «What are you saying? Physical pain is... is nothing compared to the suffering of the galaxy if Malak should defeat the Jedi!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «My pain is meaningless! Tell him nothing!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «AHHHH!!!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «No! Don't say anymore!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «NO! AHHH!! The pain - THE PAIN! AHHHH!!!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Why? Why... why are telling him this?» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Words that betray the Republic bring me more pain than any torture ever could!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «For the sake of the Republic don't tell him anything!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «No! How could you betray the Republic like this?» [K1/Leviathan]
- «No! AHHH!!! AUGH! NO!!! I beg you... mercy!!! NO!!!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «They tortured all of us, though you got the worst of it by far. Saul wanted them to make us suffer. He's become some sort of sadistic monster.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «None of this will matter if we don't get out of this prison before Saul gets back!» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Saul mentioned that Lord Malak was on his way. I think the Admiral left to prepare for his arrival... and to report the results of our interrogation.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «I, uh... I have to confess something. There was a... there was a moment - just a moment - when part of me was hoping that you would tell him what he wanted to know. Just to make the horrible pain stop.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «No, I know you wouldn't ever do anything to intentionally cause me pain. But you had no other choice. You couldn't betray our cause.I... I don't honestly know if I could have been as strong in your position. To watch you suffer like that I... I might have cracked.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «You... you wanted me to suffer? You enjoyed my torment? I... I don't know what to say. I thought there was a... a bond between us. Maybe you're not the woman I thought you were.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Don't be so hard on yourself. I've known the Admiral a long time. I could see that he already knew the answers to the questions he was asking.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Stop it, both of you! Bastila, you... you can't honestly say how you would have reacted in that situation - nobody can! Besides, Saul already had all the information. I could tell.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Forget about it, Bastila. It doesn't matter anyway. I've known the Admiral a long time. I could see that he already knew the answers to the questions he was asking.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «I've known Admiral Karath a long time and I think you're right.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «The interrogation was a sham. Saul was toying with us. He didn't care what we told him. I think it was just an excuse to torture us before Malak arrived.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «[[../Prison Block#Cell Block» [K1/Leviathan] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «[[../Prison Block#Droid Maintenance» [K1/Leviathan] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*

**[K1/Lower_City_Apartments_(East)]**
- «Hold on a second. I want to hear what he means by 'clear conscience'.» [K1/Lower_City_Apartments_(East)]

**[K1/Lower_Shadowlands]**
- «You mean you'd just let all those people die? That's monstrous!» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands]

**[K1/Manaan]**
- «Manaan's a neutral world. They're the only source of kolto... the healing fluid... and they use that to remain free from both the Republic and the Sith. That's all I can think of, at any rate.» [K1/Manaan]

**[K1/Matale_Grounds]**
- «These settlers have come to Dantooine seeking privacy. Perhaps we should respect their wishes.» [K1/Matale_Grounds]

**[K1/North_Apartments]**
- «*whisper* I know all about Sith interrogations. This isn't going to end well.» [K1/North_Apartments]
- «What are you doing? There's no need to go around drawing attention to ourselves. You there... just get out of here.» [K1/North_Apartments]
- «I know we might need credits, but there has got to be a better way to get them than this!» [K1/North_Apartments]
- «Wow, that was sure generous of you. I just hope we don't end up needing those credits later on.» [K1/North_Apartments]

**[K1/North_Beach]**
- «Wait a minute - you understood these creatures? Of course... you and Malak must have been here before. You...you probably learned their language back when you were Revan.» [K1/North_Beach]

**[K1/Prison_Block]**
- «Good job, Mission! I knew you wouldn't let us down. When we get out of this I'm going to see you get a medal from the Republic for everything you've done!» [K1/Prison_Block]
- «Nice job, Canderous. You keep getting us out of jams like this and there might be a place for you in the Republic army, even if you are a Mandalorian!» [K1/Prison_Block]
- «You may be a droid, but when this is all over I'm going to see the Republic gives you a medal for your part in this!» [K1/Prison_Block]
- «If I remember the layout of this ship our equipment should be in a storage chamber just through the north doors. After we grab our stuff we need to get to the main bridge controls. The bridge is the only place we can open the docking gates of the hangar where they've got the Ebon Hawk. We have to open those gates before we can fly out of here!» [K1/Prison_Block]
- «Count me in, then. I've got a score to settle with the Admiral before we get off this ship, and I have a feeling I'm gonna find him on the Leviathan's bridge!» [K1/Prison_Block]

**[K1/Ruins]**
- «That sounds like quite a supposition. What if you're wrong?» [K1/Ruins]

**[K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]**
- «Not to mention that I wouldn't mind getting out of this enclave for a bit. I mean, come on, how bad could it be?» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «Somehow I imagine the story from the Sandrals would sound just about the same, don't you?» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «You would be willing to risk open war over this?» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «And here I thought you would blame us, if we failed. It seems everyone is responsible for your actions except for you.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «What can I say? You pick up a few things.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «I've seen men like Ahlan Matale before. He's so convinced that his hatred is justified he's prepared to do anything. And if we don't intervene, there will be war.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «I've seen an evasion or two in my time... enough to know when I hear it.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «That's quite a line. You actually believe that? Don't you think someone is allowed to value privacy?» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «Actually, it is. All I'm saying is that not everybody welcomes the sight of a Jedi with open arms. Better get used to it.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «This man just lost his son! I can't believe you're trying to squeeze extra credits out of him.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «Yeah, that's the way to go about it. Make things worse for these people, why don't you?» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «You don't think that perhaps there's more to look at here, do you? That maybe everything isn't what it appears?» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «I wish you the best of luck, Shen. I hope you two find the happiness I once knew myself.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- «What are you doing? Are you trying to get everyone here killed?» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud] *(+2 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «*whisper* It's obvious he doesn't believe you. He must have some reason for letting you get away with this lie. I swear, I'll never understand these Jedi.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]

**[K1/Sith_Academy]**
- «So it's a popularity contest, basically? Wonderful.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «Darth Malak went there? Very interesting... isn't it, master?» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «I'd love to know what's going on in that tricky mind of yours.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «Dustil? Is that you?» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «Dustil... what? What are you talking about? I... I thought you were dead!» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «No, I didn't abandon you! The task force just arrived too late. Telos was in ruins, and your mother... I held her while... But I looked for you. I swear I looked everywhere --» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «I didn't have a choice! I was needed...» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «The Sith? You can't mean that! No, the Sith killed your mother! The Sith destroyed Telos!» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «No, you've been brainwashed. The son I knew would never --» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «I don't know what's been done to you, but you're coming with me out of here. Now.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «You can't mean that! The Sith are... they're evil. They're the dark side. They... they took me away from you and your mother. They're... they're what took you from me!» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «The Sith war to conquer, to rule the helpless. I went to war for *you*, Dustil. For your freedom, your future!» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «If I failed you, son, then it's... it's *my* failure. Please don't add to it by becoming part of something evil.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «Shut up! Stay out of this!» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «No! I won't accept that! I won't give up on him!!» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «Stop it, Dustil! Stop it! I won't let you go on like this! What have they done to you?!» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «I... wish I could help you, son. I truly do.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «No... no, that's not true! I was there when you were younger, but I had to leave to fight! I fought for *you*, for your freedom!» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «You're going to have to fight your own battles, Dustil. I've...I've fought all I can for you.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «No, Dustil, don't! I don't --» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «I... got it, Dustil. I'll be back. I swear it.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «I don't have anything. Yet. But I haven't given up on you, Dustil.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «Please... don't say that...» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «No. What I want is to find something... anything... that will convince Dustil that we're telling the truth. There must be *something* here in the academy we can bring to him, something that would show him what the Sith really are!» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «That datapad... take a look at it. I wonder if Dustil knows his friend was disposed of like that? If not, it might convince Dustil that what we're saying about the Sith is true. It would be worth a shot.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «Not right now. I think this datapad we found is the evidence we need. We have to bring it to Dustil right away.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «I have a datapad I want you to look at. You knew someone named Selene?» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «Look at it. It belongs to Master Uthar, doesn't it?» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «Killed her because she was hindering your progress. Superiority at any cost, Dustil. There's your evil. Or can you live with that?» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «Well, there's the son I remember. Now will you leave here?» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «I... don't suppose there's any way I could talk you out of that, is there? I mean, you're not going to do anything half way. Sounds familiar.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «I'm proud of you, Dustil. You aren't hanging onto a lie after you see it for what it is. Not everyone could do that.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «I'd like that.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «Goodbye, son. Good luck.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- «I think so. If he's anything like he used to be, Dustil hates to be tricked. There's no way he'll let the Sith trick him again. As for whether or not he'll be my son again... I don't know. He's so full of anger and hate... I wasn't expecting him to be like this. Maybe we can work it out. I hope so. I guess I'll have to wait and see. Thanks, by the way... for all your help.» [K1/Sith_Academy]

**[K1/Sith_Academy_Entrance]**
- «Oh, what a sweet guy. He should get the Sith congeniality medal.» [K1/Sith_Academy_Entrance]
- «Somehow I think he'll get over it.» [K1/Sith_Academy_Entrance]
- «No more disruptive than our 'master' will be.» [K1/Sith_Academy_Entrance]
- «Oh, nothing.» [K1/Sith_Academy_Entrance]

**[K1/Sith_Base_(Taris)]**
- «That's... not a bad plan. It might just work.» [K1/Sith_Base_(Taris)]

**[K1/Star_Forge]**
- «The Republic Fleet must have got the message I sent as we were crashing onto that planet. I'm picking up a transmission from them now.» [K1/Star_Forge]
- «Admiral Dodonna, this is Carth Onasi. We are receiving your transmission.» [K1/Star_Forge]
- «The Star Forge wasn't constructed by the Sith, Admiral. We don't have time for me to fully explain it, but that space station is far older than you can imagine.» [K1/Star_Forge]
- «You can't do that, Admiral. The Star Forge is a factory of immense power. It's been churning out the capital ships, snub fighters and assault droids that have powered the Sith war effort. You have to destroy the Star Forge now or you'll be fighting an unending wave of reinforcements.» [K1/Star_Forge]
- «It's because of Bastila, Admiral. She turned to the dark side and become Malak's apprentice. We suspect she's somewhere on that space station right now, using her Battle Meditation against you and your fleet.» [K1/Star_Forge]
- «Don't worry, Admiral. The Ebon Hawk and her crew are going to see this through to the end!» [K1/Star_Forge]

**[K1/Star_Forge_System]**
- «The Star Forge... I've never seen anything like it. I'm transmitting these coordinates to Admiral Dodonna.  Maybe a quick strike by the Republic can cripple the Sith fleet. Message is away. Now we can just wait for the Republic to show up. We should be safe here - we're outside their sensor range.» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «[[../Ebon Hawk gunner station» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «We've got problems! We've flown into some kind of disruptor field. All my instruments are jammed! We've got massive overloads in all systems! I'm picking up a single planet in this system. I'll try and put us down there.  Hold on. This may be a rough landing.» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «That disruptor field fried our stabilizers - we're lucky we made it down in one piece! But if we can't find the salvage to make repairs I won't even be able to get the Ebon Hawk airborne again!» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «Even if we get the stabilizers fixed, we'll have to find and disable the source of that disruptor field before we can take off. Otherwise we'll just end up crashing again.» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «You're right! That Sith fleet we saw must have some type of protection against the disruptor field. We have to find a way to disable it or the Republic will be slaughtered!» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «They must have some kind of protection against it. But the Republic fleet won't. We have to find a way to disable that disruptor field or the Sith will slaughter them!» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «We haven't forgotten about her. But we can't do her much good stuck down here. We have to help ourselves before we can help her.» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «The stabilizers won't do much good if we don't disable that disruptor field first. Otherwise, we'll end up crashing back down to the planet's surface again. And this time we might not survive!» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «Good idea. If that temple's generating power it probably has something to do with that disruptor field.» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «Well, if Bastila is on the Star Forge like you think, Jolee, then we can't rescue her until we disable that disruptor field. The sooner we investigate that temple to the east the better. We can probably find the wreckage of a downed ship along the way. If we're lucky we can salvage some stabilizers from it to get off this planet.» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «So do I, Mission. So do I.» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «I got the revenge I always wanted when Saul died, but it hasn't brought me the peace that I thought it would. All I can think of now is the promise I made to protect you from what's going to come. It's given me a reason to look past simple revenge.» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «That's why I can't hate you, why I don't want any more revenge. You don't have to be Revan, you can be so much more. Whatever the Jedi did to you, they gave you that chance. You have this huge destiny waiting for you, and I just fear that if you're alone it could swallow you whole. I mean, is there room in there for me? Will you let me help you?» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «Oh. I had... hoped that there might be. I don't blame you. Uh. You're not the same woman I met on Taris anymore, are you? Well, thank you for your honesty. I still intend to see this through to the end, whatever happens. Malak needs to be stopped. And uh, you... you'll make the decision you have to. And we'll have to deal with that day when it comes.» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «I think I would be hurt worse if I didn't try.» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «Whatever's happened up until this point, there's going to come a time very soon where you're going to have to make a choice. And there won't be any turning back. I want you to make the right choice. I want to give you a reason to.» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «You gave me a future. I want to give you a future, too... with me. I think I could love you, if you give me the chance.» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «Neither do I. But does that really matter if we love each other?» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «Well then I'm... I'm glad. Let's... let's face the future together, then... there's still a lot to do.» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «Hey, where are you going? We can't leave the planet yet. Remember all those wrecked ships we saw? We need to salvage some new stabilizers or the Ebon Hawk won't even be able to get off the ground.» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- «I don't really know much about this place, sorry.» [K1/Star_Forge_System] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*

**[K1/Starboard_Section]**
- «This is Carth Onasi on your personal communicator. I'm tracking your position through the Endar Spire's life support systems. Bastila's escape pod is away – you're the last surviving crew member of the Endar Spire! I can't wait for you much longer; you have to get to the escape pods!» [K1/Starboard_Section]
- «But be careful. There's a Sith patrol just down the corridor. Use your STEALTH skill to sneak past him.» [K1/Starboard_Section]
- «First, make sure you have a stealth field generator equipped on your belt. You can't use your stealth skill without one. {{control» [K1/Starboard_Section]
- «Be careful! There's a whole squad of Sith Troopers on the other side of that door! You need to find some way to thin their numbers. You could reprogram the damaged assault droid to help you, if you have enough repair [[../Utility items#Parts» [K1/Starboard_Section]
- «You made it just in time! There's only one active escape pod left. Come on, we can hide out on the planet below!» [K1/Starboard_Section]
- «I'm a soldier with the Republic, like you. We’re the last two crew members left on the Endar Spire. Bastila's escape pod's already gone, so there's no reason for us to stick around here and get shot by the Sith. Now come on – there'll be time for questions later!» [K1/Starboard_Section]

**[K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]**
- «We'll do our best. You can count on that.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- «Hey! I thought you Selkath judges were supposed to follow the law! You can't already have decided that Sunry is guilty!» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- «That's a stupid law for any civilized world to have.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- «Well, speaking of that injury... does that not make it seem unlikely that he killed anyone?» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- «The Republic believes in justice, as do you. We just want Sunry to be fairly treated, that's all.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- «You're talking about acts of war. We're just defending ourselves! You murdered your girlfriend in her sleep.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- «I hate to say it, but he has a point. The Republic needs that kolto.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- «If need be. We are talking about a Sith, remember? I don't approve of what he did any more than you –» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- «The Republic's principles aren't worth a hill of beans if it falls, Bastila. I'll do whatever I can to save it.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- «I... I don't believe this. Sunry should be remembered as a hero, not as a murderer. This isn't right.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «I knew you wouldn't let the Republic down!» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]

**[K1/Swoop_Platform]**
- «Bastila – you're alive! Finally, things are looking up. Now we just need to figure out a way to get off this planet.» [K1/Swoop_Platform] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «I know you're new at this, Bastila, but a leader doesn't berate her troops just because things aren't going as planned. Don't let your ego get in the way of the real issues here.» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «Your talents might win us a few battles, but that doesn't make you a good leader! A good leader would at least listen to the advice of those who have seen more combat that she ever will!» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «First off we can't get hung up on who's in charge; we all need to work together if we want to get off this rock. The answer's out there, we just have to find it.» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «You know, I had my doubts about this mission but I figured the Jedi Council wouldn't put you in charge if you weren't prepared. But here you are, acting like a spoiled child!» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «Careful. Mercs like this haven't a lick of conscience... they'll betray you in a heartbeat. This could be a trap.» [K1/Swoop_Platform]
- «Hmm. Much as I hate to say it, he's probably right. We're going to need that ship.» [K1/Swoop_Platform]

**[K1/Swoop_Registration]**
- «I'm sure they wouldn't mind *some* of the credits, as opposed to getting it stolen out of their pockets.» [K1/Swoop_Registration]
- «Right. Tell me why we're talking to this guy again?» [K1/Swoop_Registration]
- «I'm impressed, helping a kid like Nico off to a decent start. Good job.» [K1/Swoop_Registration]
- «That Hutt's going to suck every credit he can out of that kid, then toss him aside. Might as well have sold him to slavers.» [K1/Swoop_Registration]
- «Maybe we should spend less time shaking people down for credits and more time on finding a way to stop the Sith.» [K1/Swoop_Registration]

**[K1/Taris]**
- «Good to see you up, instead of thrashing around in your sleep. You must have been having one hell of a nightmare. I was wondering if you were ever going to wake up. I'm Carth, one of the Republic soldiers from the Endar Spire. I was with you on the escape pod, do you remember?» [K1/Taris]
- «I'm not surprised. You took a serious blow to the head. You're probably having all kinds of strange dreams. I wouldn't worry too much about it.» [K1/Taris]
- «Well, you've been slipping in and out of consciousness for a couple of days now, so I imagine you're pretty confused about things. Try not to worry. We're safe... at least for the moment. We're in an abandoned apartment on the planet of Taris. You were banged up pretty bad when our escape pod crashed, but luckily I wasn't seriously hurt. I was able to drag you away from our crash site in all the confusion, and I stumbled onto this abandoned apartment. By the time the Sith arrived on the scene we were long gone.» [K1/Taris]
- «You don't have to thank me. I've never abandoned anyone on a mission, and I'm not about to start now. Besides, I'm going to need your help.» [K1/Taris]
- «Taris is under Sith control. Their fleet is orbiting the planet, they've declared martial law and they've imposed a planet-wide quarantine. But I've been in worse spots. I saw on your service records that you understand a remarkable number of alien languages. That's pretty rare in a raw recruit, but it should come in handy while we're stranded on a foreign world. There's no way the Republic will be able to get anyone through the Sith blockade to help us. If we're going to find Bastila and get off this planet, we can't rely on anybody but ourselves.» [K1/Taris]
- «That smack to your head did more damage than I thought. Bastila's a Jedi. She was with the strike team that killed Darth Revan, Malak's Sith master. Bastila is the key to the whole Republic war effort. The Sith must have found out she was on the Endar Spire and set an ambush for us in this system. I believe Bastila was on one of the escape pods that crashed down here on Taris. For the sake of the Republic war effort, we have to try and find her.» [K1/Taris]
- «I don't think you understand the situation. We can't hide on this planet forever. Eventually the Sith will find us... and, trust me, you don't want that. Getting off this world isn't going to be easy... we'll probably need Bastila's help. Not to mention that without her, the whole Republic war effort is doomed.» [K1/Taris]
- «I don't. But Bastila's young, and she has a powerful command of the Force. We survived the crash landing, so I'm willing to bet she may have, too. Besides, what's the alternative? I mean, if she's dead, then no one can stop Malak and his Sith from wiping out the Republic. And I'd rather operate on the assumption that she survived.» [K1/Taris]
- «Bastila's going to need our help. Many of Darth Malak's followers can use the dark side of the Force, and the Sith have already killed more than their share of Jedi in this war. I doubt anyone's specifically looking for us anymore: we're not that important. But if we're careful we can move about the planet without attracting notice; a luxury Bastila won't have. She's going to have half the Sith fleet looking for her. They know how vital she is to the war effort.» [K1/Taris]
- «Bastila is no ordinary Jedi. She has a rare gift the Jedi call Battle Meditation. Bastila's power can influence entire armies.» [K1/Taris]
- «Through the Force Bastila can inspire her allies with confidence and make her enemies lose their will to fight. Often, that's all it takes to tip the balance in a battle. Of course, there are limits to what she can do. From what I understand of her ability, it requires great concentration and focus to maintain her Battle Meditation. The attack on the Endar Spire happened so fast she probably never even had a chance to use her power. I'm guessing she barely got out alive, and now she's trapped here just as we are.» [K1/Taris]
- «The whole planet is under quarantine. No ships can land or take-off. So if Bastila's going to escape Taris, she's going to need our help. And we'll probably need hers.» [K1/Taris]
- «Don't be a fool! You're not getting off this world without help, and you can't hide here forever. Do you have any idea what will happen when the Sith find you?» [K1/Taris]
- «You mean besides a chance to get off this planet before the Sith find you? Do you... do you have any idea what the Sith do to prisoners of war?» [K1/Taris]
- «Oh, I get it. Never mind that the Sith will destroy the Republic and ravage the galaxy. You're only in this for the credits. Don't worry. The Republic pays its mercenaries well. You help me find Bastila and they'll make it more than worth your while, I'm sure. Plus, it might be your only chance to get off Taris.» [K1/Taris]
- «Good. We need to work together if we're going to survive.» [K1/Taris]
- «While you were out I did some scouting around. There are reports of a couple escape pods crashing down into the Undercity. That's probably a good place to start. But the Undercity is a dangerous place. We don't want to go in there unprepared. It won't do Bastila any good if we go and get ourselves killed.» [K1/Taris]
- «I'll tell you whatever I can, though I... I don't know how much help it'll be.» [K1/Taris]
- «I understand why you want to know more about me; I... I kinda get the feeling we'll be spending a lot of time together over the next while. But this isn't really the best time for long introductions; we should stay focused on the task at hand. There'll be time for that later.» [K1/Taris]
- «Everything I know about Malak is pretty much common knowledge. He escaped the trap that killed Darth Revan, his Sith Master. With Revan's death, Malak became the new Dark Lord. It's obvious that Malak's a ruthless tyrant who'll crush anyone who stands in his way... just like Revan was. Experience has shown that the Sith won't stop until the Republic lies in ruins. Malak and his Sith don't respect anything except raw, brutal power. It's hard to imagine how someone who used to be a Jedi could become such a monster!» [K1/Taris]
- «Malak and Revan were once both part of the Jedi Order, but they were young and headstrong. And against the wishes of the Council they went to battle the Mandalorians on the Outer Rim. Something happened out there. Something corrupted them and drew them over to the dark side. Or maybe there was something rotten inside them all along. I don't know. They formed an army of ex-Republic soldiers and Jedi who had fallen to the dark side, with Revan at their head... until Revan was killed by Bastila's Jedi strike team. But even that didn't slow the Sith down. Malak just stepped in and assumed Revan's role. He took control of the Sith armada and resumed the bloody conquest of the Outer Worlds.» [K1/Taris]
- «How can you say that? The Sith are butchers! Soldiers, civilians – I mean, they don't care who they kill! Even... even children! Right now the Republic is the only thing keeping Malak's brutal fist from crushing the entire galaxy... and it won't be long until even the Republic falls to the Sith fleet.» [K1/Taris]
- «I hope you're right. But the Republic hasn't been able to stop them so far, even with the support of the Jedi Council. I think Bastila might be the galaxy's last hope.» [K1/Taris]
- «Taris was once a magnificent planet-wide metropolis of towering skyscrapers. But that was a long time ago. The Upper City, where the rich citizens live, is... is still pretty safe. If it wasn't for the Sith occupation and the planet-wide quarantine it might not even be that bad a place to live. But farther down things have degenerated. The... the Lower City is nothing but a slum overrun by swoop-bike gangs waging a never-ending war for control. And the Undercity is, well, even worse. The lowest level of Taris is a wasteland overrun by rakghouls; mindless, diseased mutants that attack on sight. I've already entered all this info into your data-pad journal.» [K1/Taris]
- «Taris? The planet's all one big city... but its golden years are long past, and things have gotten worse since the Sith occupied it. From what I hear, the wealthy live on the tops of all the tall towers. And if you're poor, you live down in the shadows... and it gets worse the lower you go. That's all I can think of, at any rate.» [K1/Taris]
- «Good idea. We can use this abandoned apartment as a base, and we can probably get some equipment and supplies here in the Upper City. Just remember to keep a low profile. I've heard some grim stories about the Dark Jedi interrogation techniques. They say the Force can do terrible things to a mind. It can wipe away your memories and destroy your very identity! But I figure if we don't do anything stupid we should be okay. I mean, after all, they're... they're looking for Bastila, not a couple of grunts like us. Alright, soldier, let's move out.» [K1/Taris]

**[K1/Tatooine]**
- «Tatooine's just a desert planet. I hear the mining isn't going so well… I'd bet the colony gets abandoned before long. That's all I can think of, at any rate.» [K1/Tatooine]

**[K1/Temple_Summit]**
- «You're back! But where's Bastila? Is she alive? What happened inside that Temple?» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Hold on a second! What about Bastila? Wasn't she in the Temple? Wh...what happened?» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Dead? I... I can't believe it.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «The dark side? Bastila? No! No! How could that happen?» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «But there's still hope for her, right? I mean, Revan rejected the dark side so Bastila could too, right? We still might be able to save her.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «No doubt. Let's go, then, before she has time to organize a bigger welcoming committee.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Decide? Decide what?» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «So... you did it? You turned against Revan once and for all? I knew she wasn't part of you anymore. I...I knew it.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «I told you that you would have to make a choice eventually, that you would be tested. I think that was it, I...I can feel it. And you did exactly what I'd hoped you would. It couldn't have been easy... I'm...I'm very proud of you.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «I'm sure she did. I can't say that any one of us wouldn't have been tempted.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «I know. I can't blame Bastila for being turned, however... she's...she's just so young and doesn't deserve this kind of fate.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Always. I'm not certain any one of us wouldn't have been tempted by Bastila's offer.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «I... I love you. And I...I can't wait until all of this is over with.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Right. Sorry. I just... can't remember the last time I felt this happy. I can wait until the Star Forge is destroyed.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «I feel more confident now than I ever did before. The Force is with us, Mission.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Okay - let's get moving. The longer we wait the harder this is going to be!» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Bastila - you're alive! I was worried about you. For a minute there I was sure we'd never see you again once Malak got his... w... wait a minute.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Where are Juhani and Jolee Bindo? Are they okay? What happened inside that temple?» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Where's Jolee Bindo? Is he okay? What happened inside that temple?» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «What... what are you talking about?» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Wh... what? No! We serve the Republic! You're no better than Malak! We'll never swear allegiance to one who serves the dark side!» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «[[../Star Forge System#Carth» [K1/Temple_Summit] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «You've got to resist it! Th... this isn't you talking... we... we can help you, we can find a way --» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «I refuse to believe that! We'll...we'll stop you if we have to, all of us. We'll save you from yourselves!» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «No, never! You're not the woman I love. We'll stop you if we have to, all of us.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «You don't have to help the Sith, Mission. Not while I'm here. I see now it was a mistake to let you go into that Temple. I of all people should have seen this coming. First Saul Karath, and now you... I mean, I should be an expert on betrayal by now! But nothing you can say or do can make me betray the Republic. I won't join you, and I won't just stand aside and let you become ruler of the Sith again, Revan!» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Run for it, Mission! Go! Go!» [K1/Temple_Summit]

**[K1/Tomb_of_Ajunta_Pall]**
- «I suppose that's the nature of the dark side. Power, but no longevity. Eventually it just consumes itself.» [K1/Tomb_of_Ajunta_Pall]
- «You wouldn't have considered, oh, I don't know... getting it yourself?» [K1/Tomb_of_Ajunta_Pall]
- «We should have kept that. It could have made a --» [K1/Tomb_of_Ajunta_Pall]

**[K1/Tomb_of_Marka_Ragnos]**
- «I knew there would be a catch. There's always a catch.» [K1/Tomb_of_Marka_Ragnos]

**[K1/Tomb_of_Tulak_Hord]**
- «I don't suppose the fact that he's weak as a newborn kith pup has anything to do with his decision?» [K1/Tomb_of_Tulak_Hord]

**[K1/Undercity]**
- «I don't believe this planet! Even the beggars are trying to shake us down.» [K1/Undercity]
- «I'm sure you are, miss. It's just too bad your little welcoming committee is there to give people a bad first impression.» [K1/Undercity]
- «So you just lock them away in a cage?» [K1/Undercity]
- «No offense, but I can see why people normally avoid this place.» [K1/Undercity]
- «Be careful... this one might be crazy enough to be dangerous.» [K1/Undercity]
- «From what I've seen of Taris, it doesn't look like much has changed. Except for the Upper City, people here are just as bad off as the poor in your little history.» [K1/Undercity]
- «Sounds like a myth to me. Something to give the people here some false hope to cling to so they don't go mad with despair.» [K1/Undercity]
- «I get the feeling if it wasn't for Gendar, this place would be a lot worse off than it is.» [K1/Undercity]
- «Watch yourself. There's something slimy about this guy. I wouldn't trust him as far as I could throw him.» [K1/Undercity]
- «I guess with a Wookiee at your side you've got to figure you can handle the odd rakghoul attack.» [K1/Undercity]
- «Hold on a second. Don't just brush her off like this; Gadon said this girl's the only one who can get us inside the Vulkar base.» [K1/Undercity]
- «Do you know where he's being kept?» [K1/Undercity]

**[K1/Upper_City_Cantina]**
- «You sure you want to get involved in this? Seems a bit pointless to me. Up to you.» [K1/Upper_City_Cantina]
- «Vibroblades and blasters? And nobody ever dies? How come I get the feeling you're trying to take us for a ride?» [K1/Upper_City_Cantina]
- «*whisper* Careful what you say. I get the feeling this spoiled brat could cause us more trouble than she's worth.» [K1/Upper_City_Cantina]

**[K1/Upper_City_North]**
- «Hey, aren't you...? Hey, hey stop that, you kids! Leave him alone!» [K1/Upper_City_North]
- «Well, I will. You kids... get lost before I kick your sorry butts! Now, now beat it!» [K1/Upper_City_North]
- «Well, this is rich.» [K1/Upper_City_North]
- «Oh, great. We're fighting the drunks, are we? Man, do they stink.» [K1/Upper_City_North]
- «You'd think people would be a little more tolerant of others in this day and age. *sigh* I guess stupidity and ignorance will never go out of style.» [K1/Upper_City_North]
- «Come on. We should keep moving. Kook or no, people like him can make trouble for us.» [K1/Upper_City_North]
- «*whispers* We're going to need some kind of disguise if we want to get past this guy.» [K1/Upper_City_North]

**[K1/Upper_City_South]**
- «Mostly? What do you mean by that?» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- «Hmm. I've heard of the Exchange. Bad organization to cross. If anyone has blockade-breaking ships, however, it's them.» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- «And then only the rich could afford the cure. Just let the poor suffer, right?» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- «If you haven't noticed, not much about this place is fair.» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- «We're not in a position to be much more than just realists, are we?» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- «So you twisted a few extra credits out of him. Hope it was worth it.» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- «Well, for that you have my thanks. It's good to know that at least some of these men ended up in compassionate hands.» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- «No, it's *not*. The Sith would torture these men, or worse. You're not threatening this man while I'm present.» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- «I understand some extra credits might help us in our mission, but I don't approve of your methods. Zelka's a good man... you shouldn't have done that.» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- «*whisper* I know we have to be careful about drawing attention to ourselves, but are we just going to let them drag this guy off?» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- «You're giving him a hundred credits? Generous.» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- «Are you joking? We don't need this guy's credits. Just go on, we were happy to help.» [K1/Upper_City_South]

**[K1/Viewing_Platform]**
- «There you are! What happened?» [K1/Viewing_Platform]
- «That's great news! I knew you could do it!» [K1/Viewing_Platform]
- «I don't think anyone actually expected that he could be redeemed. I'm surprised you would even think of trying.» [K1/Viewing_Platform]
- «Hey! I was doing what I could, thank you very much!» [K1/Viewing_Platform]
- «No time to celebrate just yet. With Bastila dead, the Republic has broken through the Sith fleet! The capital ships are in bombardment range!» [K1/Viewing_Platform]
- «And that means we have to get out of here right now, before this entire complex comes down around our ears! Everyone else is already on the ship! Let's move!!» [K1/Viewing_Platform]
- «We couldn't let you start the victory party without us, Admiral!» [K1/Viewing_Platform]
- «So you killed Darth Malak. Somehow I... I always knew you would.» [K1/Viewing_Platform]
- «The Republic fleet picked me up from the planet. I told them of your betrayal... but I also told them I couldn't abandon you. I had to come. I said I'd find a way to save you from yourself, and I will.» [K1/Viewing_Platform]

- Mission: «Tantrum? I'm trying to apologize, you nerf-herder! Uh... I mean... I'm sorry. I didn't mean to get mad at you. It's just that I'm sick of everyone treating me like I'm a helpless kid.» [K1/Carth] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*

**[K1/Courtyard]**
- Mission: «Wow, talk about an ego trip! You Jedi aren't perfect; remember Revan and Malak? Maybe these Mandalorians are worth looking into.» [K1/Courtyard]
- Jon: «You Jedi have left them alone because they haven't harmed you, but they steal our property, destroy our land and worse!» [K1/Courtyard]
- Bastila: «That was beneath you. I hope in the future you will strive to be better than this.» [K1/Courtyard]
- Bastila: «There is no need for you to make fun of her. She is obviously desperate.» [K1/Courtyard]
- Mission: «Hey, why'd you have to do that? That was just mean!» [K1/Courtyard] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*

**[K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]**
- Bastila: «Perhaps you should reconsider leaving Zaalbar behind. This is, after all, his homeworld.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]

- Juhani: «It is difficult indeed to deal with those you oppress and enslave.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Bastila: «An honest man and a good mechanic. Seems like you got a favorable trade, sir.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Matton Dasol: «You'll get your money. My crew will be back.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Matton Dasol: «All for nothing. He killed my crew... who knows where my ship is. Well, there's your pay, Eli. Blaster fire, and keep the change.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]

**[K1/Grove]**

**[K1/Hangar]**

Besides, I had to see for myself if it was true. Even now I can hardly believe my eyes... tell me, why did the Jedi spare you? Is it vengeance you seek at this reunion?» [K1/Hangar]
- Bastila: «I'll hold Malak off. You two get out of here! Find the Star Forge!» [K1/Hangar]

**[K1/Hidden_Bek_Base]**

If the Sith ever moved in down here all the swoop gangs would unite against them. We'd use hit and run guerrilla tactics to pick them off... their casualties would be enormous!» [K1/Hidden_Bek_Base]
- Zaerdra: «How dare you?! I should kill you where you stand!» [K1/Hidden_Bek_Base]
- Gadon Thek: «She's too valuable to leave with the Vulkar scum at the base. Brejik's probably got your Republic friend hidden away somewhere safe until the big swoop race. You'll never find her.» [K1/Hidden_Bek_Base] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- Gadon Thek: «I'm afraid your friend has become a pawn in Brejik's game to take over the Lower City. He's offered her up as the Vulkar's share of the prize in the annual swoop gang race. Their numbers will allow him to finally destroy me and my followers.» [K1/Hidden_Bek_Base] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- Gadon Thek: «The only hope you have of rescuing Bastila is to somehow win the big season opener of the swoop race.» [K1/Hidden_Bek_Base] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*

- Tanis Venn: «Ask your questions. Please.» [K1/Hunting_Lodge]

**[K1/Javyar's_Cantina]**

**[K1/Jedi_Enclave]**

**[K1/Jolee_Bindo]**
