**[K1/Kashyyyk]**
- Bastila: «Kashyyyk is a planet where most of what you see is actually foliage that has grown to enormous heights. No one has ever been to the true surface of the planet below. Beyond that, there is little else I can tell you.» [K1/Kashyyyk]
- Jolee: «Oh, I know plenty about Kashyyyk. You think someone doesn't live here for twenty years and pick up a thing or two? Chances are that by the time I finished telling you about it all, you would have found out for yourself. So there's no reason for me to start blathering on. It should be enough for me to tell you that there's kilometre after kilometre of trees on this planet. The deeper you go, the more dangerous it gets. If you're smart, you stay on top with the Wookiees. Go deep, however, and you may find some things you weren't expecting. And that's about all I got to say about that. Now let's get going.» [K1/Kashyyyk]

**[K1/Korriban]**
- Bastila: «Korriban is a sparsely populated planet controlled by the Sith. It feels... wrong. There is an old evil here that permeates the Force. We can't risk having any of the dark Jedi Masters recognize me. For the sake of the mission I must remain hidden in the Ebon Hawk while we are on this world. Beyond that, there is little else I can tell you.» [K1/Korriban]

**[K1/Leviathan]**
- Bastila: «Do you recognize the ship?» [K1/Leviathan]
- Bastila: «Talk of an escape is somewhat premature, don't you think? We don't even have a plan to get out of this mess yet!» [K1/Leviathan]
- Saul Karath: «Did you learn nothing in your time under me? As a soldier you should understand that casualties were unavoidable. This was an act of war.» [K1/Leviathan]
- Saul Karath: «You used to be a man of action, not of empty words. Cling to your lust for revenge if you must, but spare me your tired threats. I've heard them all before. You are an insignificant part of these events, anyway. Lord Malak is far more interested in your Jedi companions. He has great plans for them.» [K1/Leviathan]
- Bastila: «Don't waste your breath, Saul! We won't answer any of your questions.» [K1/Leviathan]
- Saul Karath: «I'm sure you won't. However, we both know your friend's loyalties have proven in the past to be somewhat... flexible.» [K1/Leviathan]
- Bastila: «What are you saying? Physical pain is nothing compared to the suffering of the galaxy if Malak should defeat the Jedi!» [K1/Leviathan]
- Saul Karath: «It is time to put your loyalty to the test. I doubt torturing you will gain me your true cooperation. Your will is too strong to be broken that way. However, even the strongest of heroes has trouble watching those they care about suffering.» [K1/Leviathan]
- Saul Karath: «You expect me to fall for such a transparent ploy. You travel half way across the galaxy with someone and you expect me to believe you feel nothing for each other?» [K1/Leviathan]
- Saul Karath: «I tire of these games - now I want answers! On what planet is the Jedi Academy at which you were trained?» [K1/Leviathan]
- Saul Karath: «Enough! You see what happens when you try to defy me?» [K1/Leviathan]
- Saul Karath: «An excellent beginning. I am glad you are being reasonable.» [K1/Leviathan]
- Saul Karath: «Listen, can you not hear her suffering? You can spare her further pain by simply answering my questions.» [K1/Leviathan]
- Bastila: «Why? Why are you telling him this?» [K1/Leviathan]
- Saul Karath: «You should be grateful, Bastila. He is sparing you agony beyond comprehension.» [K1/Leviathan]
- Saul Karath: «Tell me, how did you find out about the Star Forge?» [K1/Leviathan]
- Bastila: «No! How could you betray the Jedi like this?» [K1/Leviathan]
- Saul Karath: «I find your willingness to cooperate pleasing, though it seems your answers are quite upsetting to Bastila. Not to worry - we are almost finished here.» [K1/Leviathan]
- Bastila: «No! AHHH!!! AUGH! NO!!! I beg you... No! Mercy!!! NO!!! AUGH!» [K1/Leviathan]
- Bastila: «Don't try to move too quickly, you might not be fully recovered yet. Admiral Karath had his guards continue to torture you even after you passed out.» [K1/Leviathan]
- Bastila: «It is fortunate you were able to resist the Admiral's questioning. The fate of the galaxy could be changed by revealing the slightest piece of vital information.» [K1/Leviathan]
- Bastila: «I have to confess something. There was a moment - just a moment - when part of me was hoping you would tell him what he wanted to know. Just to make the horrible pain stop.» [K1/Leviathan]
- Bastila: «I know you wouldn't ever do anything to intentionally cause me pain. But you did the right thing. I don't honestly know if I could have been as strong in your position. To watch you suffer like that... it might have been too much for me to bear.» [K1/Leviathan]
- Bastila: «You wanted me to suffer? You enjoyed my torment? I don't know what to say. I thought there was a bond between us. Maybe... maybe you're not the man I thought you were.» [K1/Leviathan]
- Bastila: «I only wish you had been able to resist the Admiral's questioning. I hope the information you revealed does not bring the entire galaxy under the dominion of the Sith.» [K1/Leviathan]
- Bastila: «Your attitude disturbs me. Such selfishness is a sign of the dark side's taint, and it does little to fill me with confidence in you.» [K1/Leviathan]
- Bastila: «Did you feel that? A disturbance in the Force. The Admiral has sent his message, the Dark Lord knows we are here now. Malak is coming.» [K1/Leviathan]

**[K1/Lower_Shadowlands]**
- Computer: «Very good. If you had moved to evacuate the city, you would have alerted the enemy to their lost codes.» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands]
- Mission: «I can't believe you'd just let all those people die!» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands]
- Zaalbar: «You must help him! This is not right!» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands]

**[K1/Manaan]**
- Jolee: «Manaan's an unusual place. Not for its water, mid you... it's the kolto. Healing juice. Only place where it occurs in the galaxy. And that's about all I got to say about that. Now let's get going.» [K1/Manaan]

**[K1/North_Apartments]**
- Sith Trooper: «You're a little too curious for your own good, civilian! This doesn't concern you!» [K1/North_Apartments]

- Alien Prisoner: «Yes... I have no desire to be here when another patrol comes to investigate these deaths. Goodbye, and thank you once again.» [K1/North_Apartments]
- Largo: «You'd give 200 credits to a stranger just to help them out?! I... I don't believe it! Thank you!» [K1/North_Apartments]
- Largo: «Now I can pay off Davik! Oh thank you – you've saved my life! I better go give this to Davik right away!» [K1/North_Apartments]

**[K1/North_Beach]**

**[K1/Prison_Block]**
- Bastila: «Well done, Jolee. I knew we could count on you. A Jedi never fails to get the task done!» [K1/Prison_Block]
- Bastila: «Well done, Juhani. In freeing us from the cell you have proven yourself truly worthy of the title of Jedi.» [K1/Prison_Block]

**[K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]**
- Vrook Lamar: «It is in the real world that we truly prove ourselves worthy of the title Jedi. You would do well to remember this, young Padawan.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- Ahlan Matale: «Until you find Shen, Jedi, we have nothing further to discuss. I suggest you hurry south to their estate, lest I take matters into my own hands.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- Bastila: «Jedi are renowned for their fairness and pursuit of justice. There is nothing to fear from us... unless you have something to hide.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- Bastila: «Privacy is all well and good, but justice must be valued higher. Is it not obvious to you that this man hides something?» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- Nurik Sandral: «I trust you will show yourself out. If not, my security droids will be sure to deal with you.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- Nurik Sandal: «[Failure] You think you can exploit a father's grief? I loved my son, but I am no fool! You shall get nothing from me! May the curse that brought Casus to his death be on your head as well!» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- Bastila: «Your actions show you are overly focused on material wealth. This is not the way of the Jedi. You will have to learn to let go of your greed if you wish to walk in the light.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- Bastila: «The Council would not approve of your actions here. Perhaps we should find this girl and try to help her.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- Bastila: «Good luck to you both. May you find the happiness you deserve.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- Juhani: «This doesn't have to end in violence! Don't give in to your bloodlust!» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud] *(+2 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- Bastila: «Are you mad? They will slaughter each other!» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- Juhani: «*whisper* It is obvious Master Vandar senses something is amiss in your tale. Yet he chooses to believe you, and I will not question the wisdom of a Jedi Master.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]
- Mission: «*whisper* Anyone can see that he doesn't believe you. He must have some reason for letting this slide. Probably trying to teach you some Jedi lesson or something.» [K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]

**[K1/Sith_Academy]**
- Jolee: «You don't say? Well, the master loves tombs, don't you master?» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Uthar Wynn: «For coming to me with this information and betraying your foolish trainer, I feel you are worthy of prestige, young one.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «Well, don't let me keep you.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «Oh, lovely. It's Father. Figures that you'd show up after all this time. How did you manage to get inside the academy?» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «Just why are you here, Father? Not for me, I hope. Couldn't you have gotten yourself blown up on some ship and spared us this reunion?» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «Too bad you didn't still think that. Or did you really think I would be happy to see you? Look, everyone! It's Father, come to rescue me at long last! Sure, he may have left Mother and I to die on Telos, but that doesn't matter!» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «Ah, save it. You abandoned us long before. We were alone all during the wars, and even once you came back, you still didn't stay.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «Yeah? Well you were needed at home, too. You were needed when the bombing started and I got captured. You know what? It doesn't matter. Not any more. I have a new family now, a family that cares about me. I don't need you.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «So? You're the soldier, father. How many mothers have you killed?» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «You never knew me. You weren't even there to know me, so don't presume to tell me what I would or wouldn't do!» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «Touch me, old man, and I'll kill you. Get out! Get out of here before I tell the Sith that you're here!» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «No, they're not evil! They're not! The dark side is superior, and you... you were at war long before they came along!» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «Heh. I... don't believe you.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «Yeah, I can just imagine what you two are up to, here. Master Uthar will be more than happy to hear about it, I'm sure.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «Is that all you do? Give out orders? Well you can't show up after all this time and expect to give me orders! I'm not your soldier and I'm sure as hell not your son!» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «They gave me a life, old man. They gave me power! You... you didn't even give me so much as a second's notice.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «Right. Just as I thought. You can't prove anything.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «No you didn't. You fought for yourself. For glory. Well, the Sith can do that, too. We learn to fight... and to kill. You want to see what I've learned, 'father'?» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «Too late, old man! You should have left when you had the chance!!» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «I'll stay right here. I won't tell anyone you're here... for now. You find some 'proof' and you bring it to me. If I hear you asking questions about me or doing a single thing to jeopardize my position in the Sith, I swear I'll tell everyone what you're up to. You got that, father? You prove what you're saying is true. I'm not going anywhere, otherwise.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «I don't see the old man with you. Did he come to his senses and leave, finally? I knew he couldn't prove anything. I don't know why you're still here. Why don't you just follow him wherever he went? You and I have no business at all.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «Back already? So tell me, father, where's this 'proof' you promised?» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «Yeah, well, that's a surprise. I gave up on you a long time ago. So did Mother, for that fact.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «Whatever. Just go if you're going. I have things to do.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «Selene? She's the one who convinced me to come to the academy with her. Why? Where did you get this?» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «I... no. You go do whatever you have to, father. I... I have some other friends here. I have to warn them what's going on. And maybe I can, you know, look around here and find out some more information. From the inside. Something that might help you.» [K1/Sith_Academy]
- Dustil Onasi: «I'll go back to Telos when this is over. You can find me there. Goodbye... father.» [K1/Sith_Academy]

**[K1/Sith_Academy_Entrance]**
- Juhani: «You should not toy with people's lives!» [K1/Sith_Academy_Entrance]
- Sith Academy Guard: «Ah. I trust you will be responsible for ensuring your slaves are not disruptive, then?» [K1/Sith_Academy_Entrance]
- Jolee: «Don't get smart-mouthed with me, young man. You're not too old to put over my knee.» [K1/Sith_Academy_Entrance]
- Prospective Sith: «So there *is* a secret to it. I knew there had to be! Would you tell me what it is? I'll do anything to know!» [K1/Sith_Academy_Entrance]
- Prospective Sith: «[Failure] You just want one less competitor, right? Well, we'll see about that.» [K1/Sith_Academy_Entrance]
- Prospective Sith: «So you're already part of the academy. I am unimpressed.» [K1/Sith_Academy_Entrance]
- Prospective Sith: «[Success] I... but, ugh... I guess you're right. If I can't even figure this out, what hope do I have? *sigh* I guess this is for the best. Maybe it's time to take up dew farming.» [K1/Sith_Academy_Entrance]

**[K1/Sith_Base_(Manaan)]**
- Jolee: «*whisper* I'm not sure what kind of game you're playing, kid, but I don't understand it. Why you would help spread Sith propaganda like this is beyond me.» [K1/Sith_Base_(Manaan)]
- Shasa: «We will not report your presence to our Sith Masters yet. If you bring us proof of Sith lies and torture we will return to our families and report this to the Ahto City authorities.» [K1/Sith_Base_(Manaan)]

**[K1/Sith_Base_(Taris)]**
- Canderous: «I can say the same about you. That makes us even. Fortunately we both want to get off this rock, right?» [K1/Sith_Base_(Taris)]
- Canderous: «While Davik's checking you out, we steal the Ebon Hawk and escape Taris. Come on – I've got an air speeder nearby to take us to Davik's estate. The sooner we're off Taris the better!» [K1/Sith_Base_(Taris)]

**[K1/South_Apartments]**
- Janitor: «Hmph! You'll change your tune the first time your plumbing breaks down and raw sewage floods your apartment. Then you'll be beggin' for Kadir to come help you out!» [K1/South_Apartments]
- Janitor: «We'll see who has the last laugh then! Now if you ain't going to be civil then I got work to do. This place doesn't clean itself, you know!» [K1/South_Apartments]
- Larrim: «Hey, I wasn't trying to pry or anything. I know people here like their privacy. It's just that I might be able to help you out.» [K1/South_Apartments]

**[K1/Star_Forge]**
- Admiral Dodonna: «This is Admiral Forn Dodonna to the Ebon Hawk, do you read us?» [K1/Star_Forge]
- Vandar: «And may the Force be with you.» [K1/Star_Forge]

**[K1/Star_Forge_System]**
- Darth Malak: «Such resolve in your words, but I see the truth in your heart. The dark side calls to you, Bastila. You hunger to taste it. Become my apprentice, and all its power can be yours!» [K1/Star_Forge_System]
- Jolee: «Hmph. Hard to say what this planet is. Been lost for thousands of years, if not more. *Sniff* Smells like bad, bad karma so watch your step. And that's about all I got to say about that. Now let's get going.» [K1/Star_Forge_System]

**[K1/Starboard_Section]**
- Escape Pod: «[This is the last escape pod and your only hope of survival.]» [K1/Starboard_Section]

**[K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]**
- Judge Shelkar: «So be it! You are now appointed Arbiter in the case of Sunry vs. The Sith Empire. Your name and position have been recorded in our files. I will now inform you of the pertinent facts in this case. You have a limited amount of time in which to investigate and organize a defense of your client, and I advise you to use it wisely.<br/><br/>Sunry was seen leaving a hotel, leaving behind a dead Sith woman - Elassa Huros. He has been charged with murder and is being held in the Ahto City prison facilities. Due to his crippled status he is being kept in a solitary holding cell. Witnesses claimed to have seen the killing and are being detained at the hotel in question pending the trial. The manager of the hotel has now been informed of your appointment. Elassa was found dead of a blaster wound with an incriminating Republic medal clutched in her hand.<br/><br/>This information has been uploaded to your datapad. It would be wise to review all information before the trial starts. You may question Sunry or the witnesses. The evidence in this case is heavily stacked against Mr. Sunry. I believe it will take some doing to absolve him of guilt.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- Jolee: «You said it, not I.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- Jolee: «Speaking of that injury, has it been taken into consideration, your honor?» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- Judge Shelkar: «In no way does his disability hamper him, though. Rest assured that my personal regard for Sunry will not affect my judgment. While emotion may rule your Senate, the cold hard hand of the law rules here on Manaan. Is there anything else you wished to ask me, human?» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- Judge Jhosa: «Well I have often wondered, if Sunry were so innocent, why was he seen fleeing the scene of the crime? Why would he have been running if he had not committed the crime himself, or was at least aware of what had occurred? This case seems fairly simple and obvious to me. You Republic types stick together, however, and I assume you will go to lengths to defend him.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- Judge Jhosa: «What else do you want to ask?» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- Jolee: «That's different, Sunry, and you know it. We don't kill them in cold blood while they sleep.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- Jolee: «Sunry... this is wrong, and you know it. I am a Jedi... what is it that you expect me to do to defend your actions?» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- Sunry: «You do whatever you have to, Jolee. I know what I did, but I also know what's at stake, here.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- Bastila: «And you would propose what? Letting a murderer free on the chance it will help the Republic?» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- Sunry: «No, I'll rot in here if I have to, but I won't betray the Republic. Do what you have to, but know what the consequences will be.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]
- Mission: «Well, that didn't go well. If I'm ever on trial remind me not to ask you for help.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- Jolee: «Well done. You showed wisdom worthy of a Jedi Master during this trial.» [K1/Sunry_Murder_Trial]

**[K1/Swoop_Platform]**
- Bastila: «You cannot win, Revan!» [K1/Swoop_Platform]

- Bastila: «You don't need to ally yourself with this... person. We should move on while we can.» [K1/Swoop_Platform]

**[K1/Tatooine]**

**[K1/Temple_Summit]**
- Jolee: «Remember the bond that was forged between you when she rekindled the spark that was your life. Through that bond she touched your memories... and also the echo of the dark taint within you.» [K1/Temple_Summit]

- Mission: «No, Zaalbar. I don't care! I won't help the Sith against the Republic! Not for anything! Not even for you!» [K1/Temple_Summit]

**[K1/Undercity]**

- Gendar: «Why have you come into this dark and sunless place? Is there something you need of me or my village? I will help you however I can.» [K1/Undercity]
- Mission: «Watch yourself: this guy's star chart is missing a few galaxies, if you know what I mean.» [K1/Undercity]
- Igear: «Hey, you ain't from the village! You're from the up-world, ain't you? Yes, you've got credits I bet.» [K1/Undercity]
- Igear: «My name's Igear. I run a little salvage shop here. You want to buy something from my store? I got some good deals.» [K1/Undercity]
- Mission: «Me... me and Zaalbar were just wandering around here in the Undercity. You know, looking for stuff we could find, just kind of exploring. We do it all the time.» [K1/Undercity]
- Mission: «Pleeeze! There's nobody else who can help me! Listen – if you help me get Zaalbar back, I'll help you get inside the Vulkar base. Come on, what do you say?» [K1/Undercity]

- Mission: «The Gamorreans make their camps in the sewers. I bet that's where we'll find Zaalbar – and that's where I'll show you the secret entrance into the Vulkar compound.» [K1/Undercity]

**[K1/Upper_City_Cantina]**
- Bendak Starkiller: «Good luck with that, kid... you're going to need it. HA-HA-HA!» [K1/Upper_City_Cantina]

You think you got what it takes?» [K1/Upper_City_Cantina]
- Ajuur: «I can arrange for you to fight in the duel ring. If you win, you get the standard contract: 10% of all wagers. And don't worry, nobody dies in the duel ring anymore. Death matches are illegal now. Most fighters in the duel ring use vibroblades or stun sticks because the ring's pretty small, but a few of the duelists use blasters. Use whichever you prefer.» [K1/Upper_City_Cantina]
- Ajuur: «The duel ring has energy suppressor fields to make sure nobody dies. Weapons are limited so they hurt, but don't kill. And we've got a medic droid in case of serious injuries. Are you interested?» [K1/Upper_City_Cantina]
- Gana Lavin: «Why is the help here so incompetent? One word from Daddy and I could get you fired!» [K1/Upper_City_Cantina]

**[K1/Upper_City_North]**
- Bastila: «I will not stand here and let that poor man be stoned! You there, children... leave him alone!» [K1/Upper_City_North]
- Bastila: «Well I will. You children get away... just because he is different does not give you the right to attack him!» [K1/Upper_City_North]
- Drunk Man: «Shouldn't you go back to the Lower Cities where you belong, shlummie?» [K1/Upper_City_North]
- Drunk Man: «Yeah, like he said, these streets are for the Upper City citizens! You better get out of our way if you know what's good for you!» [K1/Upper_City_North]
- Drunk Man: «You talk big, shlummie! Maybe you should show us a little more reshpect!» [K1/Upper_City_North]
- Janice Nall: «You'll see a few aliens around, but most of the non-humans stick to the Lower City. I've learned not to dwell on it. though. I try to stay focused on running my store.» [K1/Upper_City_North]
- Gorton Colu: «You are like all the rest! You will not see the truth! On the day of reckoning you will suffer with the rest of the alien lovers!» [K1/Upper_City_North]

You better watch yourself: those gangs will take a shot at anyone – even us! It's too bad we don't have the manpower to just sweep those slums clean.» [K1/Upper_City_North]

**[K1/Upper_City_South]**
- Kebla Yurt: «Hello there. I haven't seen you in my shop before... allow me to introduce myself. My name is Kebla Yurt. Welcome to the Equipment Emporium. You looking to buy some supplies? My shop's the largest one in all of Upper Taris. Best selection on the planet. Whatever you need, I've got. Well, mostly.» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- Kebla Yurt: «The Sith confiscated all my heavy weapons. And they impounded all my ships and swoop bikes. But I've still got a real nice selection, if you're interested.» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- Kebla Yurt: «Oh, Davik's a legitimate businessman, if you get my drift: smuggling, slaving, extortion. Uh huh. They say he's a member of the Exchange – you know, the big intergalactic criminal organization.» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- Kebla Yurt: «I have to pay him a protection fee every month, but it's reasonable. And I get most of my inventory through Davik and his suppliers – I'm just smart enough not to ask where it came from, you understand?» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- Gurney: «Helping people is all well and good, but you have to help yourself first, right? I'm telling you Davik will pay big credits for the cure. More than Zelka could ever afford.» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- Bastila: «That was unworthy of you. Zelka has the serum, certainly, but only because of your extortion. Were the few extra credits truly worth it?» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- Zelka Forn: «Welcome to my medical facility. Do you require healing or treatment? I can treat almost any ailment right here at the facility.» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- Bastila: «You have taken a great risk to care for these men. I wish we could aid you more, but you have my thanks.» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- Bastila: «Don't be absurd. Indulge your darker impulses if you wish, but not at the cost of hurting helpless men. We will not betray this man.» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- Zelka Forn: «Fine, take these credits to seal your tongue, then leave this place. I don't want to have anything to do with a monster like you!» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- Bullied Merchant: «You're giving me 100 credits? Just like that? I... I don't know what to say! Thank you! Thank you!» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- Bullied Merchant: «Now I can pay off Davik. You've saved my life! Thank you! I better take these credits to him right away!» [K1/Upper_City_South]
- Bullied Merchant: «What? You're robbing me? You're no better than those bounty hunters! Here – take my credits! Now I'm getting out of here!» [K1/Upper_City_South]

**[K1/Viewing_Platform]**
- Darth Malak: «I suppose... I suppose you speak the truth. I alone must accept responsibility for my fate. I wanted to be Master of the Sith and ruler of the galaxy. But that destiny was not mine, Revan. [cough] It might have been yours, perhaps... but never mine. And in the end, as the darkness takes me, I am nothing.» [K1/Viewing_Platform]
- Bastila: «I don't think anyone actually expected that he could be redeemed. I'm surprised you would even think of trying.» [K1/Viewing_Platform]
- Dodonna: «I'm sending an honor guard to escort you in. You'll be getting a hero's welcome when we all get home!» [K1/Viewing_Platform]
- Bastila: «You are a fool. Revan has already made her choice, and there is no turning back! Don't listen to him, master! Let me strike him down! Seize your victory!!» [K1/Viewing_Platform]

**[K1/Worrroznor's_Home]**
- Jolee: «I urge you caution. This may seem like the right path to follow... but you do not know these people as I do.» [K1/Worrroznor's_Home]

## Mission Vao
*Corpus coverage: 320 own lines (every line, no length filter) · 63 lines naming them by name, alias or epithet · 7 pronoun references resolved from context · 135 lines addressed to them · 31 narration lines · 58 duplicate/variant lines merged (noted inline). Every «quote» is script-verified.*
### Background and history
Mission is a Twi'lek teenager living in Taris's Undercity and Lower City. Her brother Griff abandoned her; he is later found working for Czerka on Tatooine [K1/Czerka_Office].
### Personality and motivations
Cheerful, streetwise and a skilled slicer. She is loyal to Zaalbar and longs for family.
### Arc (scene by scene)
- **Taris:** guides the party through the Undercity and the Vulkar base. In the garage she backs Gadon's claim: «Brejik stole that engine from Gadon!» [K1/Black_Vulkar_Base_(Garage)].
- **Tatooine:** Griff thread.
- **Dark path:** confronted when Zaalbar is turned.
### Relationships
- **Zaalbar:** best friend.
- **Griff:** brother.
- **Revan:** a surrogate family figure.
### Abilities
- No Force abilities. Security and computer skills; a scoundrel.
### Feats
- Navigates Taris's gang territories.

- «Hey – Zaalbar's not your slave! He just swore a lifedebt to you. It's not the same thing.» [K1/Lower_Sewers]
- «A lifedebt is the most solemn vow a Wookiee can make. It means he'll stay by your side for the rest of your life – wherever you go, whatever you do, Zaalbar will be with you.» [K1/Lower_Sewers]
- «Sorry, but there's not much you can do about it. Zaalbar's already sworn the lifedebt and it's not something they can just take back. This is a sacred irreversible vow.» [K1/Lower_Sewers]
- «I guess this means you're stuck with me too. Wherever Big Z goes, I'm going. I almost lost him once – it's not going to happen again.» [K1/Lower_Sewers]
- «Hey – don't underestimate me! I may be young, but I'm quick and plenty smart. You just give me a chance and you'll be surprised at how useful I can be.» [K1/Lower_Sewers]
- «So... I guess I still owe you one secret path into the Vulkar base. That was the deal, wasn't it? Don't worry, I know a backdoor into that scum den!» [K1/Lower_Sewers]
- «I better come with you – the Vulkars put up a force field to keep the sewer dwellers out. I'm one of the only non-Vulkars on Taris who can get you past it. I can't remember exactly how to get there, but I know it was somewhere here in the sewers. Over to the northeast, if I remember right. I just hope the rancor monster isn't still there.» [K1/Lower_Sewers]
- «There used to be a rancor monster that made its nest in that part of the sewers. Pretty much eats anything it can get its claws on. That thing is huge!» [K1/Lower_Sewers]
- «You did a good job mopping up those Gamorreans, but I don't think you want to take on a rancor! Those things are huge!» [K1/Lower_Sewers]
- «Luckily rancors aren't too bright. I was able to sneak past it before, so I'm sure we'll figure something out. That is, unless you want to change your mind.» [K1/Lower_Sewers]
- «Okay then, off we go. Like I said, somewhere to the north-east. Just look for the force shield and we'll know we're there.» [K1/Lower_Sewers]
- «That energy shield leads to another section of the sewers. The entrance to the Vulkar base is somewhere past there. I've got the codes to lower the shield, but we have to rescue Zaalbar from those Gamorrean slavers. Don't worry – we can come back after we find Big Z.» [K1/Lower_Sewers]
- «You won't be able to get that computer to lower the energy shield unless you know the proper codes. Lucky for you, I've got them. I picked them off the pocket of a Black Vulkar who had a little too much to drink in the cantina one night. Here, let me get that energy shield down for you.» [K1/Lower_Sewers]

**[K1/Lower_Shadowlands]**
- «Come on, you know you could trust Big Z! He'd never turn on you.» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands]
- «I can't believe you'd just let all those people die!» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands]
- «Hold on a second: Zaalbar and Chuundar are brothers? And you're their father? Wait a minute... does this mean Big Z is some kind of prince or something?» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands]
- «Doesn't seem like much of a father anyway. Hmph! Zaalbar was hurt bad by whatever happened here.» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Exiled? Big Z never told me that! Of course he never said he was royalty, either.» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands]
- «Doesn't seem like much of a father anyway, kicking his son out like that.» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands]

**[K1/Manaan]**
- «Manaan's the source for all the kolto in the galaxy; that's why those fish-faced Selkath can stay neutral in this whole Sith-Republic war. But I don't know much else about this place. Sorry I can't be more help, you know? Is there anything else I can do for you?» [K1/Manaan]

**[K1/Mission]**
- «[Mission seems rather distant. Maybe you should talk to her.]» [K1/Mission]
- «[You decide to ignore Mission and continue on with your quest for now, though you might want to speak to her later.]» [K1/Mission]
- «Really? You want to know about me? Nobody's ever really been interested in me before. What did you want to know?» [K1/Mission]
- «Big Z's my family, you know? My parents... well, I guess they're dead. It was just me on my own until the day I saw Zaalbar in the Lower City. I could tell right away he was in trouble. This was before the gang wars were out of hand, but even then the Vulkars were scum. A few of them were hassling Big Z, trying to pick a fight – but he wasn't looking for trouble.» [K1/Mission]
- «Fine – I won't tell how Zaalbar and I hooked up. Sheesh! First you ask about it, then you say you don't want to hear it! You're as bad as my brother used to be!» [K1/Mission]
- «Hey, nobody said the Vulkars was smart. But there were three of them, so maybe they figured they could handle him. I don't know.» [K1/Mission]
- «Anyway, I don't like Vulkars at the best of times. And when I saw them picking on this poor Wookiee – all alone on a strange planet, overwhelmed by the big city – I just lost it. I screamed out 'Leave him alone, you core-slimes!' and charged right at them. One of them saw me coming and slapped me so hard he just about knocked me cold.» [K1/Mission]
- «Hey, I don't need a lecture from you. You ain't my mother! I knew what I was doing.» [K1/Mission]
- «Hey – don't treat me like I'm a little girl! I ain't no kid – I'm fourteen years old!» [K1/Mission]
- «Those Vulkars didn't scare me. They're nothing but cowards. I knew how to deal with them. Of course, I never got the chance. I guess Zaalbar didn't like seeing me get smacked around. He let out this howl and yanked that Vulkar a meter off the ground and held him there by his throat.» [K1/Mission]
- «Are you kidding? Big Z ain't like that! He's just a big old softie inside. Of course, the Vulkars didn't know that.» [K1/Mission]
- «The other two screamed and ran off. Can't say I blame them. The first time you see an angry Wookiee up close it isn't a pretty sight. I thought Zaalbar was going to rip that punk's arms off and beat him to death with his own fists. The Vulkar was so scared he fainted. Or maybe Big Z's breath just knocked him out.» [K1/Mission]
- «I keep telling Zaalbar to brush those choppers of his, but he never listens. Just stay upwind when he's speaking and you'll be fine.» [K1/Mission]
- «Sorry Zaalbar, but I keep telling you to brush those choppers once in a while. Why do you think I won't stand downwind when you're talking?» [K1/Mission]
- «Anyway, I knew those Vulkars would be back with friends, so I grabbed Zaalbar and we took off. Ever since then we've been a team. We look out for each other, you know?» [K1/Mission]
- «He was fleeing some kind of trouble back on Kashyyyk. That's all I know, really. Big Z doesn't like to talk about it. In case you didn't notice he's the strong, silent type. Doesn't much matter to me, though. I accept him for what he is, not what he was. Me and Zaalbar like to live in the present.» [K1/Mission]
- «What's that supposed to mean? You think I can't take care of myself? I've got street smarts!  Know how to get by on my own! In fact, I look out for Zaalbar more then he looks out for me, you know? Big Z's a little bit too gullible to make it alone on the mean streets of the Lower City.» [K1/Mission]
- «Yeah, I suppose you're right. Like I used to tell my brother, fast talk and slick words don't get the job done.» [K1/Mission]
- «My brother's a touchy subject, you know? It just so happens I don't really feel like talking about him right now. Nothing personal. Let's just get back to the business at hand, okay?» [K1/Mission]
- «I... I was a little snappish when we last talked. I'm sorry about that. I get a little touchy when it comes to Griff. It's kind of embarrassing telling people about him.» [K1/Mission]
- «Right, sure. I understand. We've got all this other stuff going on what with the Sith and all. You're busy. No problem. Maybe later we can talk. When you have more time, you know?» [K1/Mission] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «It's complicated. Griff wasn't the most popular guy, he had his faults. But I still loved him, you know? Sometimes people don't understand.» [K1/Mission]
- «No, I want to tell you. Zaalbar's a great listener but it might be nice to talk about this with someone who doesn't reply in growls and grunts.» [K1/Mission]
- «I never knew my parents, my brother always looked out for me. He's the one who brought me to Taris. I was just a kid, only five. But I remember the trip – if you could call it that. We were stuffed inside a packing crate in a star freighter's cargo hold with just enough food and water to make the trip. Not exactly first class, you know?» [K1/Mission]
- «Oh... yeah. I understand. We've got bigger bantha to hunt, right? I just miss Griff, is all. I keep thinking things might have been different, you know?» [K1/Mission]
- «I don't know the whole story – I was pretty young. But my brother owed a lot of money. Might even have been a few arrest warrants out for him, I don't know. The only way to get off the planet was to smuggle ourselves out. I mean, I don't want to make it sound like we were criminals... well, maybe my brother was. See, this is why I don't like to talk about it. It makes Griff sound worse than he really was. My brother had his problems, but he always looked out for me.» [K1/Mission]
- «Yeah – that's what I'm trying to say! Without my brother I don't know where I'd be.» [K1/Mission]
- «He gambled. And drank. And he was always borrowing money for his latest get rich quick scheme. But he had a good heart, you know? He taught me how to survive. He showed me how to slice into a computer's security system; how to get inside a locked building without the entrance codes, and how to spot a wealthy mark for a quick shell game.» [K1/Mission]
- «Hey, you don't know what it's like! You need those skills here in the Lower City. Griff did right by me.» [K1/Mission]
- «Yeah, Griff did right by me.» [K1/Mission]
- «I really miss him since he left. I keep hoping he'll come back some day. He promised me he would.» [K1/Mission]
- «Why do you got to go putting my brother down like that? That's just mean! Besides, it wasn't his idea to leave!» [K1/Mission]
- «He fell in with a bad crowd. It's all Lena's fault. She's the one who took him from me! Just batted those long lashes at him and off he went!» [K1/Mission]
- «Mission – mission: is that supposed to be a joke? Like I've only heard that about a million times in my life! Okay, I can take a hint. You don't want to hear anymore. That's just fine.» [K1/Mission]
- «I don't want to talk about Griff and Lena – just the thought of that space tramp makes my blood boil! Subject's closed as far as I'm concerned! If I'm going to be any help to you I can't be worrying about my brother running off with some intergalactic skank! So, is there something else you need?» [K1/Mission]
- «Huh? Oh... sorry. I was thinking about Taris. I still can't believe it's gone! I mean, I grew up there and now it's... it's just gone!» [K1/Mission]
- «Yeah... I know. The Jedi got rid of Revan, so I figure Malak's days are numbered, too. But that doesn't make the pain go away, you know?» [K1/Mission]
- «I don't really think there's anything you can say. I just have to find some way to deal with it, I guess. It'll take some time.» [K1/Mission]
- «What? How can you be so cruel! Millions of people dead and all you can say is 'get over it'?» [K1/Mission]
- «Look, I'm not saying I can't go on or anything like that. It's just... it's a shock, you know? I mean, I knew the Sith were evil and all, but the reality of it kind of slaps you in the face. But I suppose that's why we need to stop Malak, right? The more time I spend dwelling on Taris the more chance some other planet will get wiped out. I guess that's what it comes down to. So don't worry about me; I'll be okay. And if you need my help against Malak or the Sith, I'll be there for you!» [K1/Mission]
- «I'm sorry for the way I acted before. It's just that when it comes to Lena I tend to get a little worked up.» [K1/Mission]
- «My brother and me had a good thing going. Sure, Griff had his run-ins with the law on Taris. But we got by okay. Until Lena came and ruined everything. She was a dancer at the cantina where my brother used to go to play Pazaak. Griff could be a real smooth talker, and it wasn't long before the two of them were dating. But Lena was used to dating rich Tarisian nobles – guys with mountains of credits. Griff could never give her the kind of lifestyle she was used to, no matter how hard he worked.» [K1/Mission]
- «I'm not going to pretend Griff wasn't a hustler and a con-artist, but that doesn't mean you can just insult him! He did what he did to look out for me!» [K1/Mission]
- «I thought Lena would brush Griff off when she saw how poor he was, but for some reason she stuck around. I guess she saw the potential for a big payday down the road.» [K1/Mission]
- «I saw Lena for what she really was – a busty, credit-grubbing cantina rat! She used Griff and took away the only family I had!» [K1/Mission]
- «After they'd been together for a few months, Griff told me he was leaving Taris. He and Lena were going to try and make their fortune off-world. He promise as soon as he made enough credits he'd come back and get me and we'd all live like royalty. That was two years ago – I haven't seen him since! I don't even know where he went!» [K1/Mission]
- «Oh, I know what happened! As soon as she got him off Taris Lena sunk her claws into Griff but good! She twisted him around her little finger and made him forget all about me!» [K1/Mission]
- «I know I'll probably never see Griff again. But part of the reason I came with you was the hope that I could find out what happened to my brother.» [K1/Mission]
- «Don't worry – I won't let my search for Griff get in the way of what we're doing. Let's just get back to the task in hand. Is there anything else I can help you with?» [K1/Mission]
- «Lena? What... what are you doing here? Where's Griff?» [K1/Mission]
- «Don't you start trashing my brother, you cantina rat! Take that back or I'll smack you so hard your head-tails will pop off!» [K1/Mission]
- «You liar! Griff told me you didn't want his little sister tagging along – that's why he had to leave me behind!» [K1/Mission]
- «No – you're the one who's lying! Griff wouldn't... he wouldn't try to leave me behind!» [K1/Mission]
- «But Griff is my brother! I can't just pretend he doesn't exist! If he was here to defend himself Lena wouldn't be saying all this bad stuff about him!» [K1/Mission]
- «Griff's better off without you anyway, you table-dancing, brother-stealing home wrecker!» [K1/Mission]
- «Don't tell me you believe Lena's lies? Griff might be working as a miner on Tatooine, but the rest of her story is bantha poo-doo! You can't trust someone like her. At least Griff's free of her clutches. I'd like to go speak to the Czerka Corp rep on Tatooine, if we have time. Maybe I can arrange to see my brother again.» [K1/Mission]
- «I just hope he's not in any kind of trouble when we do.» [K1/Mission]
- «Sure, I understand. Saving the galaxy and all. All I'm saying is if we get time to make a quick sidetrip to Tatooine... look, just think about it, okay?» [K1/Mission]
- «I've been thinking about Lena and what she said about Griff. You know, how he was always blaming other people or his problems. There might be something to what she said.» [K1/Mission]
- «Right, sure. We've got all this other stuff going on what with the Sith and all. You're busy. No problem. Maybe later we can talk. When you have more time, you know?» [K1/Mission]
- «No, of course not. Not really. But what if... what if it was his idea to leave me behind? I'm not saying Griff would just abandon me. But maybe... maybe he did want to leave me behind. Just temporarily, you know? He might have done that if he planned on coming back later. But things didn't usually work out for Griff the way he planned, you know? And that's when he'd get in trouble. He was always borrowing money he could never pay back. He might have been trying to skip out on his debts when he left Taris. He would have had to leave his little sister behind so it would look like he was coming back.» [K1/Mission]
- «Yeah... well, no. Not exactly. Look, all I'm trying to say is that the more I think back the more I realize I might be idolizing my brother a bit. Not seeing all his faults. I still want to find him. I need to see him again. It's just that I'm not sure how I'll react when I do.» [K1/Mission]
- «Maybe. We'll see. I don't... I don't want to judge him yet. Maybe Lena was lying. Or maybe... maybe she wasn't.» [K1/Mission]
- «All I know is I'd like to speak to Griff myself. If we have time, I'd like to go talk to the Czerka Corp rep on Tatooine and see what he has to say about where my brother is now.» [K1/Mission]
- «Hey, Big Z, we've got to do something about your breath. I didn't want to say anything, but it's bad. Worse than usual, which is hard to believe. In fact, now that I think about it, your breath has been pretty rancid ever since we rescued you from those Gamorrean slavers. What did they feed you, buddy?» [K1/Mission] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Oh, Zaalbar, that's terrible! I know how grouchy you get if you don't get your eight square meals a day. I'm amazed you didn't pass out from hunger.» [K1/Mission] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Ewww! No wonder your breath is so bad, Big Z. Gamorreans smell like bantha poo-doo! We'll have to pick you up a toothbrush to clean that stench out of your choppers.» [K1/Mission] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Okay, relax. No toothbrush. Sheesh. Just try to eat something else to cover up that smell, okay? Stay away from anything that's smart enough to lock you in a cage this time.» [K1/Mission] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Hey, Big Z. Don't take this the wrong way, but lately I've noticed you're starting to look a little bit scruffy.» [K1/Mission] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «No, I'm not suggesting a bath. I know how well that went over last time. But your hair's getting all tangled. And if you look close, you can see a few gray strands starting to poke through.» [K1/Mission] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Don't worry, Big Z. It's nothing I can't fix. A little trim, a splash of coloring and you'll be as good as new. Best-looking Wookiee on the planet. Maybe a nice suit...» [K1/Mission] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «I know Wookiees aren't into the whole clothing thing, but you could start a whole new trend! You'd be on the cutting edge.» [K1/Mission] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Okay, okay. Sheesh. Try to offer some constructive criticism and this is the thanks I get? Let's move on. You can just stay naked and scruffy for all I care.» [K1/Mission] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*

- «Yeah, you can find your way from there, right? Can you manage that? What? Is there something else?» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]

- «Hmph!» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Look, I'm happy Griff's alive but I'm mad at him right now. And I don't know what kind of job he's got for you, but I don't trust him. It's probably just another scam! So, is there anything else you need?» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]

**[K1/Sandral-Matale_Feud]**

**[K1/Taris]**

- «The Upper City's got some nice shops and all, but it's boring! The only time I go up there is if I need free healing from Zelka at his medical facility.» [K1/Taris]

- «Hey, no problem. I'm here to help, right?» [K1/Taris]

**[K1/Tatooine]**

**[K1/Temple_Summit]**
- «Hey! Sheesh... get a room, will ya?» [K1/Temple_Summit]

- «Oh, sure. Even a good omen can get itself a room, though, don't ya think?» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «I saw what the Sith did to Taris - anyone who serves the dark side is evil! Big Z and I are with Carth on this one!» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Zaalbar - Revan's a Sith! Just like Malak! It's not a betrayal if you break your life debt now!» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «No, Zaalbar. I don't care! I won't help the Sith against the Republic! Not for anything! Not even for you!» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «No - this isn't happening! It can't be happening!» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «No! I'm not going to just stand aside and do nothing! You'll... you'll just have to kill me. But I don't think you will.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «I don't believe you've gone over to the dark side. Not totally. I don't think you'll kill me. Not if I don't attack you, first.» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Looks like you'll have to do your own dirty work, Revan - if you've got the guts!» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Zaalbar, what are you saying? Revan can't force you to do anything you don't want to! It's me, Big Z - Mission!» [K1/Temple_Summit]
- «Please, Zaalbar - don't do this! Please! NO!!!» [K1/Temple_Summit]

**[K1/Undercity]**
- «Watch yourself: this guy's star chart is missing a few galaxies, if you know what I mean.» [K1/Undercity]
- «What did you expect? If they could get away with it the Tarisian nobles would stuff their own mothers down here to make more room in the Upper City.» [K1/Undercity]
- «Please, you have to help me! Nobody else is going to help me. Even the Beks won't help me. But I can't just leave him there – he's my friend! You'll help me, won't you?» [K1/Undercity]
- «Gadon? What? I... I don't know what you're talking about. Please – Zaalbar's in trouble. He needs help or they're going to sell him into slavery!» [K1/Undercity]
- «It's Zaalbar. He's in trouble - big trouble! We have to help him. If we don't they'll sell him into slavery!» [K1/Undercity]
- «Listen, my friend Zaalbar is in serious trouble, so you can forget about me helping with anything else until I get him back!» [K1/Undercity]
- «Me... me and Zaalbar were just wandering around here in the Undercity. You know, looking for stuff we could find, just kind of exploring. We do it all the time.» [K1/Undercity]
- «Only this time they were waiting for us. Gamorrean slave hunters. We didn't even have a chance to run. Big Z threw himself at them, and he roared for me to run! I... I took off; I figured Zaalbar would be right behind me. But there were too many of them – he couldn't get away. They're going to sell him to a slaver – I just know it!» [K1/Undercity]
- «I didn't mean to leave him! I thought he was right behind me – I'd never abandon Big Z on purpose! Please – help me get him back.» [K1/Undercity]
- «No way. I'm the one that got Zaalbar into this mess, so I'm coming with you. I'm not going to abandon him again!» [K1/Undercity]
- «I don't know for sure, but those Gamorreans like to hang out in the sewers. The stink reminds them of home, I guess. That's probably where they took Big Z.» [K1/Undercity]
- «I can't ask Gadon – he's always telling me not to go into the Undercity. He says it's too dangerous with the rakghouls and Gamorreans and all. He'll never send his Beks down there.» [K1/Undercity]
- «Pleeeze! There's nobody else who can help me! Listen – if you help me get Zaalbar back, I'll help you get inside the Vulkar base. Come on, what do you say?» [K1/Undercity]
- «How can you be so stubborn? When you're ready to help me with Zaalbar come on back – because you'll never get into that Vulkar base without my help!» [K1/Undercity]
- «You're back – does this mean you're going to help me now? Does this mean you're going to help me get Zaalbar back?» [K1/Undercity]
- «It's a deal – as soon as we get Big Z back, I'll show you a way into that Vulkar base! Now, come on – We have to find Zaalbar before they sell him to slavers – or worse!» [K1/Undercity]
- «The Gamorreans make their camps in the sewers. I bet that's where we'll find Zaalbar – and that's where I'll show you the secret entrance into the Vulkar compound.» [K1/Undercity]

**[K1/Upper_City_North]**
- «Hey! You aren't going to just let them keep hurting him, are ya?» [K1/Upper_City_North]
- «You want me to come over there and kick your little butts?! That's it... now you're in for it!!» [K1/Upper_City_North]
- «Yeah! You tell him, Big Z!» [K1/Upper_City_North]
- «Do we have to stand here and listen to this space-slug? He’s starting to get on my nerves, you know?» [K1/Upper_City_North]
- «Hmph! You may think it's okay to joke about killing aliens to string Gorton along, but I don't think that kind of thing is funny at all!» [K1/Upper_City_North]
- «What a rail-slug! Give Big Z five minutes alone with that guy and he'd straighten him out... or maybe twist him like a Tarisian Zella nut.» [K1/Upper_City_North]
- «Hear that, laser brain? Sell it somewhere else, 'cause we ain't buying!» [K1/Upper_City_North]

**[K1/Upper_Shadowlands]**
- «It's kind of nice to meet a Jedi who isn't all hung up on this light side, dark side stuff. It gets pretty tiring, you know?» [K1/Upper_Shadowlands]

**[K1/Village_of_Rwookrrorro]**
- «Big Z! What are you doing here? What's going on?» [K1/Village_of_Rwookrrorro]
- «You can't do that! He can't do that, can he? He can't hold Zaalbar prisoner just because he's Chieftain, can he?» [K1/Village_of_Rwookrrorro]
- «Don't worry, buddy, we'll get you out of here. You can count on us!» [K1/Village_of_Rwookrrorro]

**[K1/Woorwill's_Home]**
- «It isn't an easy language to learn, what with all the growls and howls. Big Z told me the whole point was to make it difficult for outsiders to understand.» [K1/Woorwill's_Home]
- «Yours? Why would we find your casing beside... no, it couldn't be. Could it?» [K1/Woorwill's_Home]

**[K1/Worrroznor's_Home]**
- «How awful. Big Z always said how important honor was to his people. It's everything.» [K1/Worrroznor's_Home]
- «Big Z says honor was everything to his people. I... guess he's right.» [K1/Worrroznor's_Home]

**[K1/Black_Vulkar_Base_(Garage)]**

**[K1/Carth]**

- Carth: «Trust me, Mission. There are a lot of worlds better than Taris. There are worse, too. But Taris is no place for a kid to live on her own – even a kid who's got a Wookiee to look out for her.» [K1/Carth] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- Carth: «Mission, you have to know that we don't think you're helpless. Look where we are, look at what we're doing. You're not just along for the ride.  We need you.» [K1/Carth] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*

**[K1/Sand_People_Enclave]**

## Zaalbar
*Corpus coverage: 209 own lines (every line, no length filter) · 146 lines naming them by name, alias or epithet · 24 pronoun references resolved from context · 112 lines addressed to them · 41 narration lines · 48 duplicate/variant lines merged (noted inline). Every «quote» is script-verified.*
### Background and history
Zaalbar is a Wookiee exile from Kashyyyk and the son of Chieftain Freyyr. His brother Chuundar collaborates with Czerka's slavers. He has sworn a life debt to the player: «At times like this I regret ever swearing my life debt to one such as you.» [K1/Eastern_Dune_Sea]. His companion is Mission.
### Personality and motivations
Honour-bound, protective and reticent: «I will honor my life debt, but I don't feel we share more than that.» [K1/Ebon_Hawk].
### Arc (scene by scene)
- **Taris:** rescued from the Gamorrean Compound (narration); joins.
- **Kashyyyk:** must choose between Freyyr and Chuundar. The player can push him toward Chuundar for dark-side points (narration).
- **Dark path:** may side with the dark Revan against Mission.
### Relationships
- **Mission:** friend.
- **Freyyr:** father.
- **Chuundar:** brother.
- **The player:** life debt.
### Abilities
- Wookiee strength; bowcaster.
### Feats
- Wookiee physical-strength feats only.
### Power-scaling statements
- None.
### Duels and fights
- The Kashyyyk resolution fights (Freyyr or Chuundar).
### Verdict implications
- Physical brute. No scaling value.
### Open questions
- None.

- [K1/Party] Zaalbar: Model Zaalbar, Class Scout, Level 4, Alignment 60 (light). Feats: Implant Level 2, Improved Power Attack.

The fight was stopped, but my father did not believe me when I told him about my brother's actions. I was made an exile, disowned by my home and people. I should not be here. They will not accept me back.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «When I attacked my brother I was so mad… I used my claws. You don't understand what that means to a Wookiee. Our claws are tools, not weapons. To use them in battle is to become an animal. It is madness without honor. I am forever a madclaw in the eyes of my people. Nothing I say is to be trusted. They were right to cast me out.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «The slavers are still here... this dock is theirs. I doubt anyone has risen to try and fight. Nothing has changed. I just hope I can prove myself to my people. It will be difficult to make them listen. I just don't know.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «I don't have much hope.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «You outsiders even cheat each other! No wonder you give no thought to my people!» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «You have nothing to be proud of, fool.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «And it makes my people more desirable as slaves.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]

- «What are you doing? Stop this!» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]

- «RrrrraaAAAARRRR!!!» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- «Grrr.... That was not a name I wanted to hear.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]

- «Grraarrr!» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]

**[K1/Great_Walkway]**
- «Can you sense it? The wind... the sound... the smells? I feel it all now that we are away from the spaceport. This walkway is new, probably built by the slavers, but I remember the trees. My village is not far from here.» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- «I'm sorry, I don't know. It has been so long since I left. I only know the way things were, and many things may have changed.» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- «It is kind of you to offer, but my problems are very personal. I'm not sure if I am ready to deal with them.» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- «Yes, your outsider concerns must always come first. Just remember that this was my home. You are the stranger here.» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- «I must warn you of one thing... I don't know if I will be a help or hindrance to you here. My father was very powerful... a chieftain. Perhaps his feelings have mellowed, but if my brother had his ear all this time... I may be very unwelcome.» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- «That is what I am dreading. My shame was meant to be forgotten on some far away world. I never thought I'd come back. I'm sorry, I've taken enough of your time. We should press on.» [K1/Great_Walkway]

- «What are you getting at? Do you want these men dead? I would not need much encouraging!» [K1/Great_Walkway]

- «You lied to gain profit from the death of this Wookiee? You may as well have killed him yourself.» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- «You can't justify this. Don't try.» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- «So I see.» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- «Stand aside! This human is with me and I want access to the home of my people!» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- «He means me. I am the taint that you have brought back.» [K1/Great_Walkway]

**[K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]**
- «Shut up! Both of you! This ends today! I... I will not see Rwookrrorro suffer any more!» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]

- «Returning home has lifted a great weight from my mind... but it has been painful as well.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «I... I can't. Not yet. I'm just getting used to being free... and not just from the slavers. And I have a life-debt. Now that my life is truly my own again, honoring that agreement is all the more important.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «I have a request, father. I have thought about it a great deal. I would like Bacca's Sword.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «I have gone through a lot here. I don't think it's too much to ask that I choose the reward.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «I understand. I want this, father. I'll bring it back one day.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «Greetings father. It is good to see you again.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «Yes, goodbye, father.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]

- «You have seen more than I would have allowed, and taught me some things too. I am grateful for that. It will be a while before I know what my role will be in making Kashyyyk truly free. I have a lot to learn.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «I'm not sure I really know. Father expects much of me... I guess I do as well. I think, when I've learned enough, I'll bring it back to Kashyyyk. What happens then... we'll see.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «You and I have important things to do, and I don't feel bad about leaving this time. I know I'll be welcomed back.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «I should get mad, but I won't. Your comment was callous, but you have shown you respect my people. And it is that harshness of you outsiders that I must try to understand. I will follow undistracted while I observe.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «I will follow.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «I am proud of today. Yesterday is forgotten.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «Chuundar told me who the mad-claw was. Have you done it then? Have you... killed my father?» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «I've been reminded of how Freyyr cast me out. I see how easily he has been disposed of, himself. We are stronger without him. Chuundar's way is better.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «I don't want to dwell on it. The deed is done. You rule Kashyyyk. I will follow.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «I would prefer that. There is nothing here for me. You have shown me that. So have you, {{s» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «You've shown me how useless our traditions are, so what is there to want? I'll take Bacca's sword. At least it's still useful in combat.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «RRAAAAAAGHGHGH!!! BACCA'S SWORD! NOTHING ELSE!» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «Leave it alone, Mission. This is what I want now.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «Don't worry, brother. I know your way is the best. It's the only way our people will survive in a galaxy full of outsider lies.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «I have made my peace with Chuundar. I see that his way is best. You showed me that. There is nothing here for me anymore.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «So many things have changed on Kashyyyk. I'm not sure what my place is. I must learn more about you outsiders. Chuundar has told me much about our failures here. I think learning how to really live elsewhere will help. And maybe... maybe I'll come back to fight... but not now.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «I will fulfill my life debt with you, but I don't think outsiders are worthy of knowing about me or my people. I don't think I have to explain why. You witnessed what happened on Kashyyyk, what is still going on.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «Chuundar showed me that you are all the same, all greedy, but I also learned that outsiders can be used.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «Did we ask to be enslaved? Suffer like we have and then you can criticize how we dealt with this. Chuundar has done what he must to ensure we survive. I see it now. He has shown me you can be used.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «I am only a slave to you, just like my people are slaves. Well, Chuundar has shown me how to use you anyway.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «As long as you think you are leading, you don't care what those beneath you do. I will use this to my advantage. I owe you a life debt, and I will honor it, but I will also serve myself. That is all I have to say.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «I have said all I am going to. I will follow you as my life debt commands, but you are just another outsider to me.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- «I have no objections. Chuundar showed me the way things must be. There is nothing for me here. The old ways are dead.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]

- «The vine... I remember this. There were hunters that would tell of the trial... of how the chieftain Rothrrrawr was nearly killed. It was said that he lost the blade to Bacca's sword in a place just like this, foolishly challenging the Great Beast. I wonder...» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands]
- «Not much. I believe a specific creature was killed to hang from the vine. This served as bait for the larger more dangerous beasts.» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands]

- «Use it, of course. It has no more worth to my people. Not with Chuundar as chieftain. The old ways are dead. You showed me that. No, this sword will serve me as I see fit. It is no longer a symbol that anyone here recognizes. Still... maybe...» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands]

**[K1/Black_Vulkar_Base_(Garage)]**
- Mission: «You're right! I don't need anyone but Zaalbar! If Gadon dies, he's only getting what's coming to him!» [K1/Black_Vulkar_Base_(Garage)]

**[K1/Carth]**
- Mission: «Hey, I ain't no kid! And I look out for Zaalbar as much as he looks out for me. Big Z's my friend, not my babysitter! Geez, I come ask you a question and you give me a lecture!» [K1/Carth] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*

**[K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]**
- Janos Wertka: «I don't have any experience with that. I just know that only the most adaptive people can understand the Wookiee language.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Janos Wertka: «Very well, though only the most adaptive people seem to comprehend the Wookiee language, such as it is.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Mission: «Zaalbar should be here. He shouldn't miss this. He needs to know he can come back here.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Bastila: «Perhaps you should reconsider leaving Zaalbar behind. This is, after all, his homeworld.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Juhani: «It is always good to know as much as possible about a world, and to have a reliable guide. Perhaps we should get Zaalbar to accompany us.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Mission: «I can't talk for Big Z, but believe me, he should be with us. He's got... unfinished business here.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Mission: «I'm not saying that I know better than you, but this is Zaalbar's home. Don't you think he'd know some things? Besides, he's got things here he needs to take care of.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Bastila: «We know very little of this planet. I also sense that Zaalbar has much that is unresolved here... it may be beneficial to aid him in this respect.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Bastila: «Is this about power, then? You would rather make a decision for the sake of making it than make it wisely? I am only suggesting that both we and Zaalbar would benefit from his company while on Kashyyyk. You do want to find the Star Map, don't you?» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Canderous: «Hmph. Maybe we should have brought the Wookiee out. This place looks... untamed.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- HK-47: «Observation: You should have brought the Wookiee Zaalbar, despite the smell. He would have knowledge of this place, master.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Czerka Scientist: «I'm sorry, I don't understand Wookieespeak. Shyriiwook, I think it's called? What did the Wookiee say?» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Jolee: «[Force Persuade] Hmph. 'Harvesting'. Tell us about this agreement with the Wookiee leadership.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Bastila: «[Force Persuade] You wish to tell us more about this agreement with the Wookiee leadership.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- Janos Wertka: «It is not me, personally. I merely represent Czerka Corporation at this outpost. There are other directors at other stations, of course. Arrangements have been made with the Wookiee leadership. Harvesting is handled as delicately as possible, relatively speaking.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Janos Wertka: «We do things as humanely as possible. There are other outposts, but the operation is very lean overall. Arrangements have been made with the Wookiee leadership. Harvesting is handled as delicately as possible, relatively speaking.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Janos Wertka: «It's not up to you. This planet is not a member of the Republic, and its backward citizens hold no rights. I'm sorry you are offended, but this operation is very humane. Even the Wookiee leadership knows it is more beneficial to work with us.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Czerka Guard Captain: «You're the Wookiee-lover, why don't you tell me about them? I'm sure you're real close friends.» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]
- Mission: «That's horrible! You wouldn't talk like that if Big Z was here!» [K1/Czerka_Landing_Port]

**[K1/Great_Walkway]**
- Mission: «I never thought I'd see the big trees. Zaalbar's stories didn't do it justice. This is incredible. I wish he was here to see this. He'd want to see this, you know?» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- Carth: «This planet is incredible! It's too bad Zaalbar isn't with us. It would be nice to have a guide who's familiar with this place.» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- Juhani: «This place is wild and untamed. It stirs the blood and makes one feel alive. It is a shame the Wookiee is not here with us; I have no doubt he would feel the same way.» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- Bastila: «This place is so wonderful, yet so strange. Maybe we should have Zaalbar with us. A guide with local knowledge could be invaluable.» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- Mission: «I'm glad Big Z isn't here to see this. I don't know if he could handle it.» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- Carth: «It's a good thing Zaalbar isn't here to see this. I doubt he'd approve of what you're doing. Actually, I don't know if I approve, either.» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- Wookiee Guard: «Chuundar sent us to search it. We found the exile. The nameless mad-claw, once called Zaalbar.» [K1/Great_Walkway]
- Mission: «Big Z once told me he had seen paradise destroyed by the greed of outsiders. I never understood what he meant until now.» [K1/Great_Walkway]

**[K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]**
- Mission: «Woo-hoo! Way to go, Big Z!» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- Mission: «Alright! Way to go, Big Z!» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- Mission: «I... guess he *did* toss you out on your ear, Big Z. What kind of father is that?» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- Freyyr: «We have done it... I am saddened that it had to come to this, but I couldn't let it continue. Zaalbar, my son. I am truly sorry. You have suffered a great shame. I was blind. I have no excuse.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- Freyyr: «You have a place by my side, Zaalbar. I would be honored if you would take it.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- Mission: «Look, Big Z may owe you a life-debt but you've got to cut him some slack!» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- Freyyr: «Well... That is quite a request. I am tempted to say no but... perhaps I should consider it an investment. Zaalbar, do you understand what this will mean? It is the legacy of our people, held by chieftains... and future chieftains.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- Mission: «Careful, I've seen Zaalbar get this mad too. There's no persuading him when it happens.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- Wookiee: «And you, Zaalbar, you fought for us even when shunned. All of Rwookrrorro is grateful, and also shamed for the way you were treated.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- Chuundar: «I avoided his name when I sent you after him, but the pompous old wook must have said something! You're an inattentive fool if you truly didn't know, but it doesn't matter. Zaalbar has begun to see my side of things.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- Chuundar: «So you did it for Zaalbar's well-being? It's possible, but it doesn't matter. Zaalbar has begun to see my side of things.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- Chuundar: «Not with me, and I doubt Zaalbar will give you any trouble for it. He's coming around to my way of thinking.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- Chuundar: «That is true. I would have killed you. Besides, the old wook's time is done. Zaalbar has begun to see my side of things.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- Chuundar: «Yes, I think it is. But what should I reward you with? I wonder if you know the magnitude of what you have done here? You've made certain I cannot be challenged. With Freyyr gone, there is nobody to whine about the old traditions. Everyone believes in my way... even Zaalbar. I will lead the Wookiee people to a great future... safely under my thumb. What should be the reward, brother? What will be your reward for joining me?» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- Mission: «Whoa, Big Z! Settle down! I've never seen him this angry before!» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- Chuundar: «Uh... it seems Zaalbar has made up his mind, and I agree. The sword has lost its influence here. Removing it from Kashyyyk will kill the old ways completely.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- Mission: «If you say so, Big Z.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]
- Chuundar: «That finishes our business. Take care, Zaalbar. We'll welcome you back someday. When I decide the people are ready. Not before.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]

- Gadon Thek: «Don't underestimate Mission or her Wookiee friend Zaalbar. They're a formidable pair; tough enough to go exploring the Undercity by themselves!» [K1/Hidden_Bek_Base] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*

**[K1/Javyar's_Cantina]**
- Mission: «Just a sec, boys. Zaalbar... a little help here? I need you to rip the legs off some insects.» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]
- Mission: «You got a problem with me, then you got a problem with Big Z. So unless you want to take on my furry friend, I suggest you greenies hop on out of here.» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]
- Mission: «Hey, relax Big Z. No need to be rude. Sorry about that, but Wookiees ain't much for conversation, you know?» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]
- Mission: «Say, I don't recognize you and I know pretty much everyone in the Lower City. You must be new down here. I guess that makes me and Big Z your official welcoming committee!» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]
- Mission: «My name's Mission Vao and this big Wookiee is my best friend, Zaalbar. I'd offer to give you a tour, but the streets down here aren't safe. But if there's anything else you need...» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]
- Mission: «When I met up with Zaalbar it seemed like a good match. I knew we could look out for each other. With my street smarts and his muscle, we make a great team.» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]
- Mission: «There's only two gangs worth worrying about here in the Lower City: the Black Vulkars and the Hidden Beks. Sometimes Zaalbar and I hang out at the Bek base. Before he took over the Vulkars he was a Hidden Bek. Gadon considered that ungrateful space slug his adopted son.» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]
- Mission: «You're going? Yeah, this dive is pretty boring. No action around here. Come on, Big Z, let's go.» [K1/Javyar's_Cantina]

**[K1/Kashyyyk]**

**[K1/Leviathan]**
- Mission: «It's a risk we have to take, Big Z. I can slice my way free from any security cell. Don't worry, I can pull this off!» [K1/Leviathan]

**[K1/Lower_Sewers]**
- Mission: «I'm glad to see you too, Big Z! You didn't think I'd forget about you – Mission and Zaalbar, together forever!» [K1/Lower_Sewers]

- Mission: «A lifedebt? Are you sure about that, Big Z? Think about it carefully. You better be sure about this.» [K1/Lower_Sewers]

- Mission: «Hey – Zaalbar's not your slave! He just swore a lifedebt to you. It's not the same thing.» [K1/Lower_Sewers]
- Mission: «A lifedebt is the most solemn vow a Wookiee can make. It means he'll stay by your side for the rest of your life – wherever you go, whatever you do, Zaalbar will be with you.» [K1/Lower_Sewers]
- Mission: «Sorry, but there's not much you can do about it. Zaalbar's already sworn the lifedebt and it's not something they can just take back. This is a sacred irreversible vow.» [K1/Lower_Sewers]

- Mission: «That energy shield leads to another section of the sewers. The entrance to the Vulkar base is somewhere past there. I've got the codes to lower the shield, but we have to rescue Zaalbar from those Gamorrean slavers. Don't worry – we can come back after we find Big Z.» [K1/Lower_Sewers]

**[K1/Lower_Shadowlands]**

If you both remain silent, one year in prison for each of you. However, call Zaalbar a traitor, and he will serve five years, while you serve none. He is offered the same deal, but if you both accuse the other, you both serve 2 years. What do you do? What do you trust him to do?» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands]
- Computer: «Zaalbar's family is mired in treachery. What loyalty do they know? Your answer is incorrect.» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands]
- Mission: «Come on, you know you could trust Big Z! He'd never turn on you.» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands]
- Computer: «In this instance, the Wookiee is unreliable. His family has been a mire of treachery. I judge the answer correct. You display the proper behavior to match the pattern in memory. Evaluation will continue.» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands]
