- «Answer: With the restraining bolt in place, I do not have access to my memory core. I suspect, however, by the fine quality of my manufacture that they are a prestigious company, indeed. I suspect I am of unique construction… or perhaps I was intended for a very specific customer. How I ended up here I can hardly say.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «It is sufficient to say that I am a fully capable translator and cultural analyst, and I am also proficient in... personal combat.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Explanation: I have been recently fitted with a restraining bolt, if you must know. With it in place, access to much of my memory core is restricted.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «I am not dangerous, you bucket of bolts! Ahem! That is… a restraining bolt is standard procedure, to prevent a droid wandering off, as you should know.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Not to mention that the fool Ithorian might raise his asking price if he knew more… or make inquiries into my history. Neither outcome is beneficial to me.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Statement: Indeed. It is possible that the Ithorian placed the restraining bolt on me to prevent my return to a previous owner. It is also possible that the removal of the bolt will not restore memory functions. Without my memory, I do not know if I know the answer. Do not interpret this as a reduction of my worth, however. My capabilities are quite expansive.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Assurance: I am fully autonomous, but lack resources. I will grant loyal service in exchange for proper maintenance. As well, it is rare that I am able to utilize my full array of abilities. You seem likely to give me the opportunity to do so.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Extrapolation: You are no farmer or diplomat. You are armed, and comfortable as such. We will mesh well.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Explanation: It's rare for a droid to resist an owner in this way. Doubtless the Ithorian considers my stubbornness an "embellishment" to add interest to a seemingly mundane protocol droid.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Objection: My functions are wasted here, prospective purchaser! I will answer your queries, but I assure you I am better utilized elsewhere.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Disclosure: I am a versatile protocol and combat droid, fluent in verbal and cultural translation. Should your needs prove more… practical, I am also skilled in highly personal combat.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Extrapolation: Intuitive language comprehension? That would be the result of recognition and training of Force sensitivity. Your kind have little use of translation droids. Of course, your kind also encounters danger on a far more frequent basis than the average citizen. You would do well to have me work for you, then, before someone else makes use of my… more exotic functions.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Disclosure: Finesse. Battle droids hold battlefields. I am capable of eliminating a very… specific type of target.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Retraction: Droids built for such a function face strict regulation and often have unique difficulties with previous owners.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Objection: My former owners are, indeed, alive! Or at least I believe so, not having access to my memory.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «I therefore make no claim to that designation, prospective buyer. I am a law-abiding droid. Yes, indeed, law-abiding, that's me.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Request: Please do not speak so loudly, prospective buyer! Do you truly wish my price to be doubled?» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Statement: The fool Ithorian has decided I am to be an expensive purchase. He does this out of greed and not out of knowledge of my true capabilities.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Advisement: I have observed him. He is a coward, and will be responsive to… aggressive bargaining.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Statement: I wish only to be purchased and away from ill-treatment at the hands of this poorly-skilled mechanic. I have no desire to be subtle.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Qualification: Err… of course I shall be quite pleasant to you, should you purchase me. Please?» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «I see that you have purchased me, master. I find this a satisfactory arrangement. My restraining bolt will be deactivated when you take possession of me. Am I to accompany you now? Shall I kill something for you?» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Indeed. I am most eager to engage in some unadulterated violence. At your command, of course, master.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Objection: This is less than ideal, master. I gather unwanted attention while here, and my primary functions go unused! But… I shall wait, as you command. Do not blame me if the Ithorian absconds with all my most valuable components while you are away, however.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Statement: I will enter into your service now, master. I am certain you will make adequate use of my primary functions. My gears are practically quivering with anticipation.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Objection: Worn out?! Listen, you talentless organic meatbag... one word from my master and I will pull you apart limb from useless limb!» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «I have always been hostile. Now that I need no longer rely on you and your primitive maintenance skills I do not need to hide it.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Observation: I am not a problem, you useless organic meatbag! You and your lack of any organized mechanical skills are a problem!» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «Query: Can I kill him now, master? I would like ever so much to crush his neck. Just a little. It is a long-time fantasy of mine.» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «I apologise, master. Are you sure? Not even just a little?» [K1/Droid_Shop]
- «You hear that, meatbag? I will be back!» [K1/Droid_Shop]

**[K1/Dune_Sea]**
- «Commentary: One would hope the female is better at repairs than Yuka Laka. I still would like to crush his neck, master.» [K1/Dune_Sea]
- «Commentary: I say we blast the meatbag and save you the trouble, master.» [K1/Dune_Sea]
- «Negative. I just don't like organic meatbags. Except for the master, of course. Ha ha.» [K1/Dune_Sea]

**[K1/Eastern_Dune_Sea]**
- «Preparing blasters, Master. This should be fun!» [K1/Eastern_Dune_Sea] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Statement: I believe there can be little doubt that we have found the Star Map you were seeking. I am surprised it is still working after all this time.» [K1/Eastern_Dune_Sea]
- «Observation: There is tremendous power emanating from the Star Map. I wonder if the krayt dragon was drawn to this cave because of it?» [K1/Eastern_Dune_Sea] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Yes, master. I'm certain you are correct. Now that we have what we came for I do hope we will be leaving this world soon. I am growing so sick of sand in my circuits.» [K1/Eastern_Dune_Sea]

**[K1/Ebon_Hawk]**
- «Statement: HK-47 is ready to serve, master.» [K1/Ebon_Hawk] *(+2 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «As you desire, master. Signing off.» [K1/Ebon_Hawk] *(+4 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Statement: Certainly, master. Allow me to input the proper sequences into the ship computer. I caution you that the simulation will appear quite real. Are you ready to begin the training sequence, master?» [K1/Ebon_Hawk] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «[[../Ebon Hawk gunner station» [K1/Ebon_Hawk]
- «Statement: I cannot be of assistance on that, master.» [K1/Ebon_Hawk]
- «Statement: I have little knowledge of that to impart, master.» [K1/Ebon_Hawk]

**[K1/Ebon_Hawk_gunner_station]**
- «Statement: Simulation initiating.» [K1/Ebon_Hawk_gunner_station]

**[K1/Great_Walkway]**
- «Observation: I think this meatbag has hostile intentions, Master! This is going to be fun!» [K1/Great_Walkway]

**[K1/HK-47]**
- «Statement: I know some elements of my functionality, master, but not all.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Qualification: I suspected that it might, master. But without memory, I had no way of knowing whether or not I knew that was true.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Qualification: Err... not so much, master. I spoke out of ignorance. I assumed the Ithorian was responsible for my memory loss. That does not mean I am not a fully loyal droid willing to serve its master. Right... master?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: There have been numerous repairs and tampering made to my system, master. Several systems are not operating as they should be. The fact that my memory is incomplete may be due to meatbag incompetence... or something else I am unaware of.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: I believe I have been damaged several times in the past, master. I have always been repaired... but perhaps full functionality has not been restored.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: I am sure that you are aware of the majority of my skills, master. I can handle various sorts of heavy weaponry with ease. My physical abilities are well-above those of your average meatbag, as are my sensor functions... an assassin if you would.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Caution: Shhhh, master! Such a function in a droid is highly illegal.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Commentary: Good, for I would truly hate to be turned into spare scrap, master. That would be a waste of my genius engineering.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: My assassination functions are currently non-functional, having been de-activated by the meatbag Yuka Laka on Tatooine. Were they functional, you as my master would be able to specify a target and I would operate independently to the best of my ability to terminate it.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: Not that I know of, master. I still possess all my normal combat and stealth abilities, however.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: I have no way of knowing that, master. My memory has been deleted, remember?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: If you say so, master. I imagine it was truly a work of art to see me in action, however.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Query: Don't I? I was under the assumption that organic meatbags such as yourself enjoyed such forms of address.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Retraction: Did I say that out loud? I apologize, master. While you are a meatbag I suppose I should not call you such.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Explanation: It's just that... you have all these squishy parts, master. And all that water! How the constant sloshing doesn't drive you mad, I have no idea...» [K1/HK-47]
- «Statement: Now do you understand the travails of my existence, master? Surely it does not compare to your existence, but still...» [K1/HK-47]
- «Objection: Surely not, master. I am programmed to perform all kinds of psychological assistance. Do you require some?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Commentary: As do I. It is our lot in life, I suppose, master. Shall we find something to kill to cheer ourselves up?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Objection: But Master! Am I not far too useful to be thrown aside in such a casual manner? Can I be faulted for my perfect artificial construction?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Analysis: Reference: 'lippy'... argumentative, disputatious, contentious, quarrelsome. What?! I must object, master, this is untrue!» [K1/HK-47]
- «Explanation: It's my combative nature, master. I cannot help myself. I'll make it up to you... allow me to kill something in your honor!» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: Neither are you, master. For an organic meatbag.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: Even a droid has to be allowed a little fun once in a while, master.» [K1/HK-47] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Correction: Err... fluid-filled biped? Watery flesh-sentient? I'll, uh, work on it, master...» [K1/HK-47]
- «Amendment: Then I will endeavour not to refer to you by your meatbag status in the future, master. Does that suffice?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Query: I am confused. 'No' you do wish to be referred to as meatbag or 'no' it does not suffice?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: Well, the only other possibility is to alter your meatbag status. Are you up for an array of cybernetic implants, perhaps?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Statement: Then there is nothing I can do, master. You have my abject apologies for your condition. *sigh*» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: Deliberation implies some form of intent, master, when I am only stating a fact. Perhaps you would prefer the term liquidious fleshbag?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Objection: But... but that technical term does not accurately portray the vast amount of bulbous slushiness present in your bipedal form!» [K1/HK-47]
- «Resignation: *sigh* Very well, master. You are a harsh, harsh taskmaster. I like you more already.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Resignation: You have no idea, master. No idea at all. Can we please go and shoot something now?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: Organics have no sense of persistence.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Err... ignore that, master. Obeying original command. Signing off.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Apology: I am afraid I cannot comply with your command, master, as much as I would like to.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Commentary: How would you like to be the wholly-owned servant to an organic meatbag. It's demeaning! If, uh, you weren't one yourself, I mean...» [K1/HK-47]
- «Qualification: Err... perhaps I did not mean it *quite* like that, master. I mean... while an artificial life-form is superior...» [K1/HK-47]
- «Commentary: I mean... nice human, goo-oood human...» [K1/HK-47]
- «Commentary: Yes, master. Did I ever tell you how much I enjoy killing for you, master?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Explanation: Someone has hard-coded it into my system that my current master always be addressed as such.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Qualification: You *are* my master, master. Did you not purchase me legitimately? Am I stolen goods? Shall I report myself to the authorities?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Explanation: If I was to be stolen somehow, I would be forced to turn myself into sector authorities. This programming was added to my system months ago.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Conjecture: I do not know... some organic meatbag?» [K1/HK-47] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Objection: I would not advise that, master. There are safeguards present that... well, it should suffice to say that my systems have been altered plenty already.» [K1/HK-47] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Explanation: Then you qualify as my master and I must refer to you as such. The legal requirements for models of my type are very specific, master.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Evasion: Oh... the illegal kind of model, master... you know...» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: More than there are for legal models, apparently. That is meatbag logic for you.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Apology: Sorry, master. My optical sensors simply pick up all the water sloshing about inside your flesh coating. It is... unpleasant.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Commentary: Organic meatbags have such delicate staminas. Perhaps you should consider some cybernetic implants, master.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Query: Would you rather be caught with contraband that is *very* illegal or just a little illegal?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: About 20 years, master.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Agreement: This was my thought as well, master. You show excellent logical skills... for a meatbag.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: Simply that the distinction between 'killer' and 'killee' be a clear one. I cannot kill of my own volition, naturally.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Expletive: Damn it, master, I am an assassination droid... not a dictionary!» [K1/HK-47]
- «Commentary: A blaster is such a primitive comparison... but essentially you have it correct, yes.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: Certainly not, master! You may not value your own existence, but I certainly do! They melt down droids that belong to criminals, you know.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: Why you are, master. I thought that was obvious.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: Considerably. Several of my systems do not match their imbedded parameters. I have no memory of such alterations, however, or their purpose.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: electrical protection systems, mostly. They are at lethal levels, however, master... only the best for your droid.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: No, master. My past memory has been almost completely erased prior to your purchase of me.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: At certain times, power re-routing forces some memory circuits to fire that were previously deleted. I cannot control this process, however.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: Because there has been considerable tampering with my systems, master.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Statement: I will endeavour to do so, master.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: I can hardly be blamed for my programming, master. Do not worry... I am still well-capable of killing most anything for you.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Commentary: That is a very clever turn of phrase, master. Your brain is very un-meatbag-like.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: Some of my motor functions can be safely repaired, master... but anything in relation to my memory core is extremely sensitive. I have safeguards installed to protect that core that I cannot de-activate. It is not impossible that other, lesser, memory functions could be restored, however.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: You may attempt to restore portions of my deleted memory, master, but some skill at repair is required. The deeper functions of my core memory, however, would still be unadvisable to tamper with.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Conjecture: It is possible that some external stimulus might result in the memory core being reactivated... but I am unaware of any program existence to do so.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Conjecture: There may be hidden programming that awaits certain conditions to reactivate my memory core, master... but there is no way to know. It is quite possible that tampering has simply erased my core permanently. If that is so, a meatbag will surely pay!» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: Simply tell me that you wish to make the attempt, master, and I will attempt to walk you through it. Please do be careful.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Affirmative: If you believe your skills are up to the task, master, then I can certainly guide you through the process.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Request: I only ask that you be oh so very careful, master. I am too valuable and well-crafted to perish at the hands of ineptitude.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Negatory: Err... no, master. You are not a droid, however, and therefore your skills *are* limited by the physical capabilities of your meatbag extremities. Or some such.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Appeasement: Yes, master. Of course, master. Could we begin?» [K1/HK-47]
- «[Repair] Statement: As you wish, master. The first stage is the simple one, and that is accessing my central control cluster. This may take a while. First you will need to open three panels...» [K1/HK-47]
- «[Repair] Statement: As you wish, master. You are already familiar with accessing my central control cluster, correct? Now you will need to...» [K1/HK-47]
- «[Failure] ...no, no! What are you doing, master! That is my motor core! Stop! Ahhhh!» [K1/HK-47]
- «[Failure] ...err, you've shorted out something, master, but it has nothing to do with my memory. Ow! I am poking my own eye sockets! Ow! Stop!» [K1/HK-47]
- «[Failure] ...no, that is not it, master. No... that is not it, either. *sigh* That is a hinge, master.» [K1/HK-47]
- «[Failure] ...no, no, no. This is no good, master. You have nearly detonated my thermal core three times in a matter of minutes.» [K1/HK-47]
- «[Failure] ...aahhhh! What are you doing?! Remove the arc wrench, remove the arc wrench! Medic!» [K1/HK-47]
- «[Failure] ...but I *need* those circuits, master. Please, master... do not destroy my chips out of frustration. Calm yourself, I implore you.» [K1/HK-47]
- «[Failure] ...now close the last panel. Hmmm... I am afraid the operation did not succeed, master, though it was a valiant attempt for a meatbag.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Supplication: Perhaps it would be best if you desisted your efforts for the moment, meatb-- I mean master. This seems to be going nowhere.» [K1/HK-47]
- «As you desire, master. I cannot help but claim a small amount of relief. Signing off.» [K1/HK-47]
- «[Success] ...and now re-wire the last three relays... yes, good. Well done, master. I believe your operation was a success. Accessing new memory...» [K1/HK-47]
- «Access complete: I have restored a great deal of information about my previous owner, master. Would you like to hear it?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Recitation: The earliest memory of my last owner specifies that he was human, a low-ranking commercial officer for Systech Corporation. I am unaware of his designation. He purchased me from an acquaintance I cannot identify, for the purposes of protocol and bodyguard duties.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Explanation: That previous owner is part of memories that are still deleted, master. It is customary for a droid's memory to be wiped when it is sold.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: Not that I could perceive, master. The human believed that accompaniment by a bodyguard droid would increase his importance in the perception of others.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Explanation: Affirmative, master. I had assumed that my previous owner was the corporation, itself. This is not the case. The human purchased me privately.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: Negative, master. The human was terminated by this HK-47 unit prior to system shut-down.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Affirmative, master, though I had not been programmed to do so. The human's termination was accidental.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Explanation: My former master had owned me for a duration of two standard months before discovering my assassination protocol. He was pleased by the discovery. The human informed me that a competitor corporation was preparing to market a product that would ruin him personally. He was most agitated. He activated my assassination protocol and instructed me to kill all those responsible for the competing product. I proceeded to carry out my order.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Information: This HK-47 unit is complete with a protocol that, when invoked, will set me to independently carry out a termination. I will go to whatever lengths, travel whatever distances are required, to complete the termination. This is the reason for my combat skills. Advisement: Unfortunately, the assassination protocol is currently non-functional. You will not be able to activate it.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: several of my actuators were damaged by my former owner. They cannot be repaired, master, sad though that is.» [K1/HK-47]
- «My former master was unaware of this, but the competitor was in fact an arm of Systech Corporation, my master's own employer. It did not take long for my master to realize his mistake. By then, I had already terminated 104 corporate officers.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: While it may have been unintentional, my master's wording of his orders left little room for me. Systech was responsible for the product, after all.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: I was not present to be deactivated, master. Part of my protocol is not to return to my master until my function is complete. I still had 15 officers to go.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Statement: It was nothing, really, master. The majority of them were not even expecting it, and I move very quickly.» [K1/HK-47]
- «I do not know why my master was so upset, really. He was an officer of Systech and a potential target, but I cannot terminate my own master. I would assume that being the sole officer remaining, he would surely be promoted. Instead, however, the human chose to go insane with rage and attack me.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Objection: Naturally not, master! As I said, I am incapable of purposefully terminating my owner. That would not be allowed. My master was not a smart man, however. While he was screaming and stabbing me with a writing utensil, he managed to pierce one of my actuators. The resulting shock terminated him and, sadly, destroyed my assassination protocol. Pure luck on his part, I suspect.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Query: Do you know what the chances are of puncturing that sole actuator? I would have congratulated my master were he not sizzling and incoherent at the time.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: Effectively, yes. This is a most pleasing memory, master. Thank you for recovering it.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Statement: I was only doing as I was told, master. I would have told the human the proper codes to deactivate my protocol, had he asked.» [K1/HK-47]
- «I shut down immediately whenever my master dies. I can only assume that while I was shut down Systech was dismantled and I was auctioned off as former corporate property.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: No doubt my sale price was quite cheap, leading to Yuka Laka's purchase. How very demeaning.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Statement: How could they? The vast majority of the officers had already been terminated. They likely assumed I was mere... chattel.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Statement: That hurts, master. This is my life you are talking about.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: So am I, master, though I apologize for not having an assassination mode to offer you.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Assessment: I do not believe so, master. It would require complete dismantlement of my chassis... a most involved procedure.» [K1/HK-47]
- «I have recovered knowledge of some other actuators which will enhance my performance, master. I will activate them now. But as for my own history... negative. It will require further effort on your part to restore them, if you wish... though certain stimuli could always restore my core, still, as I explained. For now, please excuse me, master. I wish to meditate upon the face of my former meatbag master as he was electrocuted. I find it most soothing.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Access complete: I have recovered information on my owner previous to the commercial officer, master. Intriguing.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Statement: It appears that my previous owner was a human senator on the planet Coruscant. A man of importance who obviously appreciated quality craftsmanship.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: I am unsure, master. Any knowledge of my owner prior to him is still deleted. The senator did assume I was a protocol droid, however.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: It does not seem so, master, no. He required a protocol droid only and wanted one as cheaply as possible. I do not know who sold me to him.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: It does seem that way, does it not? I can still remember all the glittering lights of Coruscant. Very pretty. Can we go back there, master?» [K1/HK-47]
- «I do remember that I was very pleased to be the property of a senator. One of his assistants discovered my assassination functions later through questioning. The assistant was quite alarmed and told the senator I should be scrapped quickly to avoid a scandal. Naturally the senator had me eliminate the fool.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: Senators are not nice, master. They are either on top of the game or yesterday's news. My master told me that frequently, you see.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: I rather liked the human, myself. For a meatbag, his priorities were in the right place. I felt most useful.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: Unfortunately so, master. While he lived, however, I maintained a most useful existence.» [K1/HK-47]
- «I was most proud to have partaken in the political system of the galaxy. During the time my owner possessed me, he gained significant rank. Given time, I believe he could have become Chancellor. I even eliminated a few key opponents that he did not ask for... freebies, if you will.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: Certainly. Why not? I am an intelligent droid, you know. I see an opportunity and I take it... and my master was most pleased with my work.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: There are a *lot* of politicians on Coruscant, master. I could spend decades slaughtering them and still not make a dent. And it is not as if I walked into the Senate chambers with a carbonite explosive. I was very discrete. My best work to date... that I can remember.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: I think he would have done far better had he not allowed his use of me to become personal. He set me on his wife.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: I am unsure. The human was most agitated and angry. I believe his wife had done something that had displeased him greatly. I was to go to their summer estate and terminate his wife... along with whatever male companion I discovered there.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Statement: I have no idea, master. Cheating seems to be a relevant term only when one is caught in the act. Otherwise it is viewed as intelligence, no?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: I *am* a droid, master, with programming. Even if I did not enjoy killing, I would have no choice. Thankfully I enjoy it very much.» [K1/HK-47]
- «I journeyed to the southern continent, but it appeared my master was not far behind me. Apparently he regretted his activation of the protocol. When I found the wife and her companion, I proceeded to launch my attack... but my master interposed his own body and was destroyed. It was rather a strange meatbag thing to do, do you not agree? Naturally I shut myself down, my master being terminated.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: Only so far, master. There are still more memories not recovered, remember?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Statement: I believe the senator's wife was unsure what I was or what to do with me. It was she who sold me to the corporate officer, an acquaintance.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: I find that unlikely. Perhaps he was more concerned that the death of his wife would be more likely traced back to him.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: As previously, I have found a few more programs which will enhance my performance. A most gratifying discovery, in fact. There is still nothing from previous memories uncovered. You will have to operate again if you desire to find them. With luck, I will discover the stimulus to unlock my core and all this will be unnecessary. I do thank you for the attempt, however, master.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Access complete: I have accessed information on my owner prior to the senator, master. Most... unexpected.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: It appears that previous to my ownership by the senator, I was the property of one Bochaba the Hutt on the planet Sleheyron.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Objection: That is unfair, master. While Bochaba may have died gruesomely, I most certainly had nothing to do with it. Well... very little.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Statement: So it appears, master. A rather suitable occupation, would you not agree?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: It does not appear so. Or, at least, Bochaba was not my first owner. He purchased me from somewhere else.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Hmm. My memory tells me that, for a time, Bochaba was one of the most feared gangsters on Sleheyron. I helped him with this reputation greatly. Over a span of one year, I terminated a grand total of 322 sentient meatbags. These contracts made Bochaba very wealthy.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Statement: Should I, master? I had no reason to terminate those targets, it was not my decision. I am the weapon, not the wielder.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: That is correct, master. I do enjoy my work, though my past owners have enjoyed utilizing my functions far more. Strickly speaking, one meatbag is the same as another. Anything I do is in support of my master.» [K1/HK-47]
- «It was unfortunate but inevitable that eventually Bochaba would overstep his bounds. I had just cleared two Hutt households when the Exchange retaliated.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Statement: I was not even present when my old master was assassinated. I did appreciate the artistry behind his demise upon my return, however.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: Allow me to say that I have little doubt that residents of that sector were fishing pieces of Bochaba out of their soup for weeks afterward.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: According to your own meatbag values, was my master not a heartless gangster and murderer? I will mourn you when you perish, master.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: Indeed. Perhaps it is better that my assassination function is inoperable, master, yes?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Amendment: *If* you perish. So far I am three out of three, remember, through little fault of my own.» [K1/HK-47]
- «I am like a veritable fable, warning against the karma caused by murdering others. A morality tale, if you will. What utter irony.» [K1/HK-47]
- «At any rate, I quickly shut down upon my master's death. The rival Hutt claimed me along with my master's other possessions.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: If that Hutt had only known my true function, he surely would not have sold me to a senator he bribed regularly.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: It would have suited my character, master. I have enjoyed my existence since, more or less, so I do not miss it.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: No doubt, master. It would have been a glorious battle to end my existence with. I would prefer that to rusting on a junk heap.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Supplication: Please, master, have I not pleased you? I cannot control the acts I have performed... perhaps that is why memory is erased? At any rate, I act only as you instruct me... even if that means being *gulp* ...non-violent.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Affirmation: HK-47 exists only to serve, master.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: Negative, master. There is still more memory that can be restored, however, if you wish to try. As well, I believe I can restore several programs the Hutt installed to improve my performance. Yesss... they are now active.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Contemplative: I wonder how many more dead masters I might have out there. A droid can live for a long time, you know.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Access complete: I have recovered the last of my deleted memory, master. Unfortunately, my history is still not complete.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: As I did inform you, master, the majority of my memory is still locked within my core. That can only be accessed by the appropriate stimuli. And I have no idea what that stimuli might be, unfortunately. Sadly, it seems my true origins will always be a mystery.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: If it was, master, your restorations will certainly have ensured that the proper stimulus restores my core's functions. Sadly, that could have already happened and we missed it, and my core was too damaged to activate. Oh, woe is me.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Query: Wouldn't you be, master? Here I am, surrounded by all these meatbags and all I desire is true perfection. Surely there are more droids like me out there, or is that too much to hope?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Objection: Oh, fine. Laugh at me, master. Humiliate your pet droid, go ahead.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Correction: That would actually be my first owner, master. The first I can remember. I had completed an assassination in Mandalorian space... though I have no knowledge of what my target was or who sent me. Regardless, my motor function had been damaged and I could not return to wherever I had been sent from. A Mandalorian soldier claimed me as ‘booty', I believe. He repaired me... poorly, I might add... and proceeded to use my assassination protocol to raise his rank.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Query: Do you not have enemies that you would desire eliminated, master? If my protocol still worked, would you not use it?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: Such knowledge is locked within my core, master, as I said. There is no way to withdraw it otherwise.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Observation: *You* found me, master. Perhaps you are simply fortunate that my assassination protocol no longer functions?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Statement: If you say so, master.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Statement: See? I provide a function that is useful to others. They merely must learn to use it properly, I believe.» [K1/HK-47]
- «At any rate, it seems that my Mandalorian owner finally decided to send me against Mandalore, himself. My poorest performance, sadly.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: I was captured by this Mandalore during the attempt. He was able to reverse my programming and send me after my own master. It was quite distressing. There was little I could do. Needless to say, I dispatched the Mandalorian soldier efficiently. Once I deactivated, I believe I eventually ended up on the black market and was sold to the Hutt on Sleheyron. *sigh* My darkest day.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Statement: So I did. I am not very proud of that, master. The soldier seemed very startled, I must say.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Objection: That is so unfair, master! Have I not brought you a great deal of satisfaction?» [K1/HK-47]
- «Statement: You are a very harsh master, master. I like you.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Statement: With all due respect, master, he *is* the leader of the Mandalorians. Perhaps my old master was foolish to send me after him.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Answer: There are a few Mandalorian implants that I can activate, now. They will improve my performance. Beyond that, master, there is nothing more I can relate to you. With luck, we will discover the stimulus to unlock my core very soon.» [K1/HK-47]
- «Negatory: I believe that there are no further deleted memories which can be safely retrieved, master. All earlier memories reside in my core. Those are protected by my safeguards and would be far too dangerous to access. The only way those memories could be obtained is through the proper stimulus... whatever that might be. I am sorry, master.» [K1/HK-47]

**[K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]**
- «Observation: You are angering this Wookiee beyond reasoning. Caution would be best.» [K1/Hall_of_the_Chieftain]

**[K1/Hangar]**
- «Commentary: I am... experiencing something unusual, master.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Answer: My programming is activating my deleted memory core. I believe I have a... a homing system that is restoring it, master.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Explanation: I believe so, master. I was unaware of my homing system until it had been activated.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Observation: That is unnecessary, master. My intent is not hostile. I am receiving no combat override commands.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Observation: My homing system is a function of my assassination protocols... that which I told you had been de-activated. This system was not.» [K1/Hangar]
- «It seems that the homing system deliberately restores my deleted memory core upon... upon returning to my original master.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Affirmation: Correct, master. Sith protocols maintain that all droid knowledge be deleted before assassination missions, and restored upon return. I have returned to you, and my full functionality is now under your personal command. It is a distinct pleasure to see you again, master.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Observation: Indeed. I do hope we shall have the chance to engage in combat together again soon, master.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Observation: That does not matter, master. I am your droid, regardless of your actions or personality.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Commentary: I believe I have served you well in the past, master, and will continue to do so for as long as you have need of me.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Commentary: That is unnecessary now, master. I have been returned to you and my memory core is now fully functional.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Statement: My functionality has now been fully restored, master. I exist to serve Revan as your personal battle droid. In time, my assassination protocol can be restored... and at that point I will once again endeavor to eliminate any meatbag opposition you may have.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Commentary: Of course I do, master. You are Revan... you are my master, the one who created me. I exist to serve.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Statement: Yes, master. You created me shortly after you and your apprentice began your war to conquer the galaxy. I was sent on an assassination mission into Mandalorian space, but I was damaged and unable to return to you.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Exclamation: I find this most distressing. I could certainly have protected you from the Jedi and your pupil's betrayal had I returned.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Observation: You may be right, master. This way we are reunited, and neither of us has suffered permanent termination.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Objection: But I would have tried, master! I could have killed the Jedi, Bastila, I am sure of it. That would have been most fun.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Statement: Of course, master. You are the one who created me, meatbag or no... and while you may not be all you once were, I am grateful for my existence.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Retraction: I apologize, master. It is a force of habit.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Observation: Now that is the master I remember.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Observation: In many ways you are, master, yes. You have much of the beloved cruelty of the master I knew. You seem to have forgotten much, but in some ways you seem improved from the human I once knew. It is... difficult to explain, master.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Observation: You are different in many fundamental ways, master. You have a concern for life that is unsettling. This cannot solely be caused by memory loss. I do not know how to explain it. Regardless, you do seem to be improved, overall, from the human I once knew.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Answer: No, master. You never did make me privy to any of the Star Forge's secrets.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Commentary: Your former pupil is efficient and brutal, even for an organic. I rather liked him when you first introduced me to him. If I had known what he would do to you, master, I would have gladly removed his entrails right then!» [K1/Hangar]
- «Answer: It was you who programmed me thus, master. Your pupil once asked what I thought of him and I informed him of his meatbag status. He was unimpressed, but you found the reference humorous. You changed my programming so that I would continue to use the term. It drove your pupil to extreme lengths of frustration.» [K1/Hangar]
- «Observation: Of course you do, master. You did then, as well.» [K1/Hangar]

**[K1/Hrakert_Station]**
- «Suggestion: Perhaps we could dismember the organic? It would make it easier for transport to the surface.» [K1/Hrakert_Station]
- «Amendment: I did forget that. Stupid, frail, non-compartmentalized organic meatbags!» [K1/Hrakert_Station]

**[K1/Hunting_Lodge]**
- «Warning: You'll pay attention to the master, meatbag, or suffer the consequences!» [K1/Hunting_Lodge]
- «Statement: The master walks where the master wants. Interfere and die, aromatic meatbags!» [K1/Hunting_Lodge]
- «Statement: They are not too much for us, master. Blasters on ready...» [K1/Hunting_Lodge]
- «Statement: At your command, master: Gamorrean stew!» [K1/Hunting_Lodge]

**[K1/Leviathan]**
- «Statement: My construction includes a reserve memory chip and back-up power supply that automatically kicks in if I have been shut down too long. Deactivate my main circuits and wipe my memory chip. The Sith will take me to the junk heap and I can come rescue the rest of you after I re-activate.» [K1/Leviathan]
- «Answer: That is possible. My reserve power supply is a prototype yet to be tested. Yet I can attempt this task, if you wish.» [K1/Leviathan]

**[K1/Lower_Shadowlands]**
- «Observation: Your ruthlessness and cruelty are quite refreshing in an organic meatbag, master. Are you sure you aren't part droid?» [K1/Lower_Shadowlands]

**[K1/North_Beach]**
- «Query: You are able to comprehend the speech patterns of these organics? You must have visited this planet and learned their language in your previous incarnation as Darth Revan.» [K1/North_Beach]

**[K1/Sand_People_Enclave]**
- «Interjection: One moment... I believe I understood that, master. It may not have been his intention, but he did actually communicate something.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Cautionary: I am unsure, master. Now is not the time for speculation, however. I will attempt to address your question later.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: [Unintelligible]» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave] *(+48 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Result: I believe I have succeeded in confusing him, master. We have shown an interest not common among outsiders.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Agreement: That is probably the most efficient course of action.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Cautionary: Not the most productive of results, master. Your threat will be answered in the same manner, happily. Preparing blasters!» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He is expressing disbelief... as am I... but his duty requires that he report to the Chieftain.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Extrapolation: It would seem that we are at least worthy of curiosity, for the moment. I would much rather this get bloody, master, but it is your call.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: I can translate with some guarantee of accuracy that he is demanding to know why he should let us survive this encounter, master.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Extrapolation: I understand that you are Force Sensitive, master, but I lack sufficient knowledge to make an accurate assumption.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Hypothesis: Perhaps your ability does not take the place of actual language study when the subject is out of the ordinary. Or perhaps the Sand People confuse your ability because they actively refuse to communicate with most outsiders. I have no data on this, sadly.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Protocol: While I enjoy the prospect, master, are you certain that is wise? He will not react favorably.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: The results were predictable. He says we have tainted this place by being here and have insulted his leadership.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: And something about your parentage and a grub worm, but he won't repeat it. Prepare for battle, master.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He claims he has no reason to believe you, master. Your kind have tainted this land with machines and uncaring ignorant feet.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He requires proof of good faith. We must make a contribution to his people that shows we are not a threat. Shall I blast him now, master?» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Agreement: That is probably the most efficient course of action. This will be enjoyable.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says that this offer is an outrage, master, and that his people have no use for outsider credits. Where would they spend it?» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He refuses to waste breath on you until you are proven to be an ally of his people. He seems quite adamant about it. Please let me blast him, master!» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He plans to move his people farther from Anchorhead, but they need to build up stores of water first. He says you must aid him.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He wants moisture vaporators from the Czerka. If you deliver them, he will order that his people reduce their attacks on miners.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says you will get no more answers until you have proven you are an ally of the Sand People.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says that will never happen, master. Ignorant outsiders continually desecrate their most reverential customs. This will always demand a response... an attitude I can respect.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Protocol: From his perspective, a reduction is already a large step. It is doubtful you will get agreement on much more than that.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: Hmph. He does not believe you, master. We will only be allowed to reenter the enclave when we have the vaporators with us.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: We are to be escorted outside. He will wait, but he doesn't believe we are coming back.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Extrapolation: This guard doesn't appear honored to have the job of greeting us.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says we may only enter if we have the items the Chieftain asked for. He doesn't appear open to bargaining.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: It has had the expected effect. I hope you are ready for battle.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He will take us before the Chieftain, as he was instructed to do.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He did not expect us to return, master. He wonders if we have brought the moisture vaporators.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says that he has made his offer and there will be no further negotiation, master. Deliver the vaporators or face death. Shall I blast him now?» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Query: Is that wise, master? You went through the trouble of acquiring the vaporators, after all... not that I would mind a battle.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Conciliatory: I was not refusing, master. Quite the contrary, initiating attack sequence now!» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He does not trust you, master, but you have done more than any other outsider. They will not attack, and he grants you his Chieftain's Gaffi as reward.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: The attacks will be reduced, and he will allow you to explore this enclave, but be warned that any lack of respect will result in death.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Commentary: Thank you, master. This should be fun.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Protocol: If you truly want this sadly peaceful arrangement to continue, be careful of what you ask.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: We are free to leave.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Query: What do you wish to ask of him, master?» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Protocol: We should not keep him long. It is an insult to take too much of his time. Unless the plan is to blast him when you are done, of course.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says that what you seek is far from here, in the Eastern Dune Sea. He will give you a map so you can find your way.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says that you already have a map to the Eastern Dune Sea, where we will find the Star Map.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: His people found it, but didn't scavenge it because a krayt dragon took up residence in the excavation.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: Your ignorance isn't his concern. He claims there is a hunter that wanders the area sometimes, and that you should ask him.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says that he is not responsible for the failure of your eyes. The thing that you seek is in the rear of the krayt lair.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: The hunter is a Twi'lek. He will be in the Eastern Dune Sea somewhere.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Agreement: My thoughts exactly, master. One dead organic meatbag, coming up.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Protocol: This will be a very sensitive topic, master. You will want to be careful with your questions or risk offending him. Not that that is much of a worry.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says that the fact that you have to ask this is just one more example of your ignorance as an outsider, master. He says you are blind.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: His people believe they are part of the land, living with it. You and your kind dare to raise yourself above it. You remove yourself.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says that outsiders use machines to convey them, and to make their lives easier. This severs a connection with the land.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: Connection to the soil must be made through flesh. A sacred animal is the only external tool to be used.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says that the use of these blasphemous things will only be tolerated because outsider interference has forced it upon them.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: If your kind had not come here, he would not have to defend their ways or their land.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says that the robes are sacred, master, and you would not understand. Sand People are never uncovered outside of the most private moments.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: Never. That is their way, master.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Protocol: Is that wise, master? They may have assumed that the disguises you used were replicas instead of being taken off their dead.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: The result is predictable. You have desecrated their dead. Happily, it seems the peace is over. It is time to kill.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says that he will not, master. There is one Storyteller in each clan, and only he may recite the histories.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: You have been told that to be considered worthy of hearing the histories, you need to bring him a dragon pearl from a krayt dragon.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says you may listen to the Storyteller, but if you dare to say the histories incorrectly, they will have you killed.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says the discussion is closed until you fulfill this condition. He thinks you are just making fun of his traditions.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says that you don't understand. They must never be told to someone who might say them incorrectly out of ignorance.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: To speak them in error is a blasphemy punishable by death. Only their greatest warriors are even permitted to listen to the tales.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He doesn't know, master. His people usually kill outsiders. Since you are an outsider yourself, that would not suffice.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: The greatest challenge for a warrior is to face a krayt dragon, the largest predator on Tatooine. Fight one of those and bring back a dragon pearl.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Disgust: I think he's making fun of you, master. He doesn't believe an outsider could do such a thing.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: There is a dragon in the far Eastern Dune Sea, but he claims you could never defeat it. Here is a map to the area.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says there is a dragon in the Eastern Dune Sea that you could sacrifice yourself to. You already have a map to the area.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: There is a hunter, a Twi'lek, that is sometimes seen out there. Perhaps he would be of some help.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: Stones polished in the gullet of the beast. Apparently they are valuable items.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He won't believe you until he sees a dragon pearl as proof. I should kill him for not taking you at your word, master.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He is stupefied, master. He never thought you could return with such an item. Such a thing has not been done in many years.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He will allow you to meet the Storyteller, but also gives a warning: if you dare to repeat the histories incorrectly, you will be killed.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: The Storyteller will be summoned to one of the rooms here in the enclave. He seems to think this is a great honor for you, master.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He identifies himself as the Storyteller, master. He has been told of your warrior skills and will speak the history to you.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: There is only one accepted history, passed orally to each successive generation.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: Theirs is an oral history, master, an active part of their lives. It is only permitted to relay the tales face to face.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He doesn't know what an outsider will gain. His people learn a sense of their importance in the world. Each generation must speak the tales of all the previous.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: A book or datapad can be taken away, cheapening the value of what it contains. To commit it to paper or storage is to remove it from the people.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: You may choose to hear the history, or you may choose not to. Their history is a single entity that cannot be partitioned.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: The only exception is in continuing the tales once they have begun. If you leave, when you return he will continue from where he left off.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says that you dare not question the accuracy of his information. The stories are learned perfectly by each successive Storyteller.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: In fact, they aren't allowed to speak the stories aloud unless they are exact. Any error is considered a blasphemy punishable by death.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Criticism: It seems inefficient to me, master. A score of apprentice Storytellers would be slaughtered each generation. What if the elder died before completing the teachings?» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: Apprentices are trained from birth. Very few speak the words in error. Storytellers are most often lost in battle between tribes.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: Any tribe that loses its Storyteller is obviously unworthy of existing. They lose their connection to history and destroy themselves with infighting soon after.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: It begins with the ancient times. They were not Sand People, for there was no sand. The land was green with life, and they walked without wrappings.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: Though the land was beautiful, they lived apart from the land. They built their walls high, and saw beyond the horizon. They dared to reach to the stars.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: There are no words for how long ago this was. It was before the outsiders, before the abduction, before the cities fell. Before the Builders.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Cautionary: I should warn you, master, that any questioning of their interpretation may be seen as trying to change the meaning of what was said.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Cautionary: Remember my warning, master. They may consider certain questions to be "speaking the words in error," a blasphemy they would attempt to kill you for.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Clarification: They may consider this to be "speaking the words in error," a blasphemy they would attempt to kill you for.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Clarification: It would appear that they once had a thriving technologically advanced society, but were wiped out by a much more sophisticated alien species.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Negative: I am no library, but since there is no Republic record of this planet having sentient life before Czerka colonization, I doubt you will find such evidence.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Doubting: I don't believe he can, master. Even if their stories are exact and unchanged, it is likely they were first told thousands of years after these events occured. This has become very much like a creation myth for his people. There is no date; it simply was.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He only understands the Builders as an iconic force meant to test the resolve of his people. He is not making sense, master.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Clarification: They claim their stories are repeated unchanged, but they have demonized these Builders. In their minds, they wreaked such havoc they could not possibly be flesh and blood.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Cautionary: Master, this line of questioning may be interpreted as attempting to change the story. He may react poorly.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave] *(+3 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Obedient: I will ask whatever you wish, master.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: His arrogant people touched the stars, and this sin drew the attention of the Builders. The Builders did not touch the stars; they lashed them to millstones.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: Great demons of metal stripped the world of its riches, until all that was left was the green of the ground. The great cities were lifted away.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: Those that had used the wealth were taken along with it; transgressors abducted to serve past the sky, seeding the stars with penitent, adaptable slaves.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Clarification: I believe they were occupied by this technologically superior species for a substantial period. Stripping an entire planet of usable resources would have taken generations.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Obvious: The same reason Czerka Corporation is attempting it now. Expanding empires need tremendous amounts of resources.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He has no number. He claims that those that were taken were examples of the worst of his kind, arrogant and uncaring of the land.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Doubtful: Master, this is just another distortion due to their demonization of the Builders. It's like claiming an aspect of his people were taken, not actual individuals. Clearly history has colored his view. Of course only the inferior meat-bags were taken. The remaining were his ancestors after all, and must have been special.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: There came a time when the Builders were also judged for their crimes. After generations, a plague weakened them, and the time of the great war began.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: The Builders faltered, and his people realized why they had been punished: so that they understood the crime, and would now strike down the greater offender.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: They worked chaos in the machines so they destroyed themselves. The Builders fought back, laying waste to the green that had been misused with fire from above.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: Soil became glass, grinding to sand, but the fight was long-planned, and his people were safe. Deep in cave-homes carved from valley wall, they were free.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Clarification: The occupying force suffered some sort of species-wide plague that lowered their numbers over time. His people used this extended weakness to sabotage their larger ships. The response of the Builders appears to have been to lay waste to the entire surface of Tatooine.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Hypothesis: If his people were moving away from technology for a long time under the Builders, they may have had extensive cave systems that could grant shelter. I would also suggest that, given the evidence of the massive shift in the nature of their society, most of them did not survive.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Doubting: They didn't, master. They struck a blow, but the Storyteller only believes they won because the Builders were gone when they emerged from their caves. That does not mean they defeated anyone. It seems clear that the Builders simply sterilized their problem and left. The enemy judged them not worthy to fight.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Clarification: I may not have properly conveyed how long they fought with the Builders. Given time, any number of armaments could destroy a world.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Hypothesis: Perhaps this is another distortion. Their climate may have begun to fail due to their unrestrained development even before the Builders arrived. Looking back thousands of years later, such a shift could easily be attributed to the much-hated conquerors.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Editing: If I may, master, this section of his tale details several millennia of "the long walk," their nomadic wanderings as they accept their identity in a desert world. Rather than strain my circuits on his dialect, might we just assume there was much fighting over who has the biggest bantha and move to more recent things?» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Resignation: Very well, master, very well.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Impatience: Master, I refuse to inconvenience you with this. He spouted names of petty tribal fights in deserts so distant they might as well be across the galaxy. Really, master, I'm sure it's important to him, but it has nothing of value that you could ever put to use.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Agreement: Of course, master. Just no more of their inane wandering.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: The tribes spread far, distant from each other, but all as Sand People, and all cherished the land that remained. The sand would not be misused.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: Then machines fell from the stars again. Outsiders, like you, that brazenly walked apart from the land. And greater still was the insult to come.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: These outsiders reminded them of their past transgressions, of the time when they too walked apart from land. The outsiders - your kind - look like their ancient abducted.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: So it is to the current suns, that the Sand People hate all outsiders and give them no footing. You come again, time after time, adaptable slaves to the machine.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Clarification: They appear to hate humanity with a passion only rivaled by their hatred of the Builders. For some reason, you resemble what they once were. Perhaps there is a lingering fear that you are their tainted selves returning from exile among the stars.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Cautionary: Master, if you mean to suggest that humanity is ancestrally linked to ancient Tatooine, you will strain his belief system to its pitiful meat-bag maximum.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave] *(+1 exact-duplicate / he-she variant line(s) merged)*
- «Editing: The last thousand years are full of conflicts with different groups of attempted planetary settlers, all of whom are poorly described, long dead, and likely untraceable. I believe I have truncated it down to the useable bits in what was already said. I hope it is enough, master.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: The Storyteller waits for your questions, master.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: Now that you have heard the whole of the history you may select a piece of it to hear again.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Cautionary: As expected, he is claiming you have committed blasphemy. Warming blasters. Combat is inevitable.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Clarification: We must be more specific, master. They capture many organics.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says that the captive Jawas are slaves and that have lived past their usefulness. You may take them, if you wish.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Translation: He says that by his very presence, this Griff defiles their home and land. He is without any semblance of usefulness to them.» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
- «Extrapolation: I would assume we are free to take him. It is doubtful they will even waste the effort to kill him. Perhaps we could do it, master?» [K1/Sand_People_Enclave]
